n-m-h2-explog-07.title: Kana tichiziva kukosha kwe logarithm imwe, tinogona kutsvaga log₆12 here?
n-m-h2-explog-07.goal: Ongorora kuti ruzivo rupi rwunodiwa kutsvaga logarithm yakatarwa, uye utsvage iwe pachako expression nenzira yekukosha kumwe p.
n-m-h2-explog-07.material: Eunseo anoda kutsvaga log_6 12 pasina calculator. Kana ukamuudza rimwe chete remakosha ari pazasi, anoda kutarisa kuti anogona kuratidza log_6 12 nenzira yekukosha iyoyo uchishandisa maitiro e logarithm nema operation mana e arithmetic chete. (log_6 12 ndiyo logarithm ye12 ne base 6.)
n-m-h2-explog-07.thinking.1: Kudzikisa kukosha kumwe chete nekushandura base
n-m-h2-explog-07.prereq.2: Hukama pakati pema reciprocal nema logarithm
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza makosha ose akadai kuti kuziva kukosha kumwe chete kuchikubvumira kuratidza log_6 12 nenzira yekukosha iyoyo uchishandisa maitiro e logarithm nema operation mana e arithmetic chete.
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s1.hint.0: Edza kushandura base ye log_6 12 kuita 2 kana 3, kana kunyora 12 ne6 sema product e2 ne3, kuti uone kuti logarithm imwe chete ipi inogona kuiratidza.
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s1.hint.1: Tarisa rimwe rimwe kuti sarudzo imwe neimwe ine ruzivo rwakafanana nelogarithm imwe iyoyo here (kuti inogona kushandurwa kuita iyo nefomula here).
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s1.r.a: Ne log_10 2 oga, haugoni kuziva log_10 3, saka haugoni kuratidza zvose 12 ne6.
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s1.r.b: Wakarasikirwa neruzivo rwunoshandurwa kuita logarithm imwe chete, senge mu log_2 6=1+log_2 3.
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s1.r.c: Wakarasikirwa nechokwadi chekuti kushandisa log_6 3=1−log_6 2 kunokubvumira kuratidza log_6 12.
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s1.r.e: Wakarasikirwa nechokwadi chekuti log_3 2 ndiyo reciprocal ye log_2 3.
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s1.r.f: Wakarasikirwa nechokwadi chekuti kushandura log_6 12 kuita base 2 kunosiya log_2 3 chete.
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s1.explain: log_6 12=log_2 12/log_2 6=(2+log_2 3)/(1+log_2 3), saka p=log_2 3 oga inokwana. log_2 6=1+p, log_3 2=1/p, ne log_6 2=1/(1+p) zvinogonawo kushandurwa kuenda ku p nekudzoka. log_10 2 haishande kunze kwekuti uzive log_10 3, uye log_5 7 haina hukama ne 2 ne 3.
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s2.prompt: Rega p=log_2 3. Taura log_6 12 nemashoko e p.
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s2.hint.0: Shandura base kuva 2 uye unyore numerator nedenominator sekukosha kwe log_2.
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s2.hint.1: Nyora log_2 12 ne log_2 6 sezvibereko ze 2 ne 3, uye ushandise zvimiro zvema logarithm kuzviratidza nemashoko e p.
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Muchirevo chako chine p, wakaisa here numerator nedenominator zvakarurama?
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Wakatsiva here p=1.585 uye ukatarisa kuti log_6 12≈1.387?
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s2.model.1: Kushandura base kuva 2 kunopa log_2 12 / log_2 6 = (2+p)/(1+p).

n-m-h2-explog-09.title: Kutonga kuenzana pakati pemagirafu emabasa e exponential ne logarithmic
n-m-h2-explog-09.goal: Tarisa zvirevo zvekuenzana pakati pemagirafu akati wandei uchishandisa mafomula kusarudza kuti ndezvipi zvechokwadi uye ndezvipi nhema, uye uratidze chikonzero chechirevo chimwe nefomula imwe chete.
n-m-h2-explog-09.material: Seungwoo akapfupisa hukama hwekuenzana pakati pemagirafu emabasa e exponential ne logarithmic ane ma base 2 ne 1/2. Logarithm ine base 1/2 inonyorwa log_{1/2}x.
n-m-h2-explog-09.thinking.1: Kushandura hukama pakati pemagirafu kuva mafomula
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza zvirevo zvese zvakarurama pakati pezvakapfupiswa naSeungwoo.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s1.hint.0: Kune maviri emagirafu ega ega, sarudza poindi imwe uye uwane ma coordinate ayo, wobva watarisa kuti poindi iyoyo inofanira kufambiswa sei kuti isvike pagirafu rimwe.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s1.hint.1: Tanga wanyora kuti kuenzana pa y-axis nekuenzana pamutsetse y=x zvega zvinoshandura sei ma coordinate epoindi.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s1.o.a: Magirafu e y=2^x ne y=(1/2)^x ane kuenzana pa y-axis
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s1.r.a: Sezvo (1/2)^x=2^(−x), ndiro girafu rine chiratidzo che x chakashandurwa. Wakashaya chirevo chakarurama.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s1.o.b: Magirafu e y=log_2 x ne y=log_{1/2} x ane kuenzana pa y-axis
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s1.r.b: Mabasa e log anotsanangurwa kune x>0 chete, saka haagoni kuva neakuenzana pa y-axis.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s1.o.c: Magirafu e y=2^x ne y=log_2 x ane kuenzana pamutsetse y=x
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s1.r.c: Mabasa akapesana, saka ane kuenzana pa y=x. Wakashaya chirevo chakarurama.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s1.o.d: Magirafu e y=2^x ne y=log_{1/2} x ane kuenzana pamutsetse y=x
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s1.r.d: Basa rakapesana re 2^x ndi log_2 x, kwete log_{1/2} x.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s1.explain: Sezvo (1/2)^x=2^(−x), y=2^x ne y=(1/2)^x ane kuenzana pa y-axis. y=2^x ne y=log_2 x mabasa akapesana, saka ane kuenzana pa y=x. log_{1/2} x ine domain x>0, saka haigoni kuva neakuenzana pa y-axis, uye hairi basa rakapesana re 2^x zvakare.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s2.prompt: Nyora mutsetse unoita kuti magirafu e y=log_2 x ne y=log_{1/2} x ave neakuenzana, uye uratidze chikonzero nefomula.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora log_{1/2} x seyelogarithm ine base 2. Enzanisa makosha e y emafomula maviri pa x imwe chete.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s2.hint.1: Tarisa kuti makosha e y anobatana sei, uye utaure kuti hukama uhwo hunofambisa poindi nenzira yeaxis ipi.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakawana here log_{1/2} x=−log_2 x nekushandura base?
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Uchishandisa ma coordinate epoindi, wakataura here kuti pa x imwe chete makosha maviri e y anosiyana nechiratidzo chete?
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Wakataura here kuti kuenzana pa x-axis kunofambisa poindi sei?
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s2.model.0: log_{1/2} x=log_2 x / log_2(1/2)=−log_2 x. Pa x imwe chete makosha e y anosiyana nechiratidzo chete, saka magirafu ane kuenzana pa x-axis.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s2.model.1: Ane kuenzana pa x-axis. Kushandura base kunoshandura log_{1/2} x kuva −log_2 x, saka ndiro girafu apo poindi (x, y) yafambiswa kuenda ku (x, −y).
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s2.model.2: Ane kuenzana pa x-axis. y=log_{1/2} x yakafanana ne y=−log_2 x, saka makosha e y emagirafu maviri ane zviratidzo zvakapesana.

n-m-h2-explog-05.title: Kutsanangurira shamwari kuti nei tichirasa t=−1
n-m-h2-explog-05.goal: Kana uchigadzirisa exponential equation nekutsiva, shandisa renji yemavara akatsiviwa kuisa chikonzero chekurasa solution mumashoko anonzwisiswa neshamwari.
n-m-h2-explog-05.material: Heano manotsi aJiho ekugadzirisa 4^x−3·2^x−4=0. "Ngatitii 2^x=t. Ipapo t²−3t−4=0, (t−4)(t+1)=0, saka t=4 kana t=−1. t=−1 haina kururama, saka tinoirasa, uye kubva ku 2^x=4, x=2." Sora akaona manotsi aya akabvunza, "Nei uchingorasa t=−1? Ndinofunga pangava ne x ine 2^x=−1."
n-m-h2-explog-05.thinking.1: Kushandura mutsara wemhinduro yakaomarara kuita mashoko akapfava
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s1.prompt: Kana ukati 2^x=t, sarudza renji yakarurama yemakosha anogona kutorwa ne t.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s1.hint.0: Isa ma integer, nhamba negative, ne0 pa x uye unyore makosha mashoma anotorwa ne 2^x.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s1.hint.1: Tarisa kuti makosha awakanyora ari mu renji ipi, uye funga kuti pane x inopa 0 here.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s1.r.a: Wakafunga kuti 0 inogonekawo. Funga kuti pane x ine 2^x=0 here.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s1.r.b: Wakaziva kuti 2^x inotora makosha akakura kupfuura 0 chete.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s1.r.c: Wakarasikirwa nenyaya apo 2^x iri pasi pe1 kana x iri negative.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s1.r.d: Wakarasikirwa nechokwadi chekuti exponential function haigoni kutora makosha negative.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s1.explain: Kune real number x chero ipi, 2^x inotora makosha akakura kupfuura 0 chete. Kana x yava diki zvikuru, 2^x inosvika padhuze ne0 asi haina kumbova 0. Saka renji ye t=2^x ndi t>0.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s2.prompt: Nyora mhinduro kuna Sora. Taura zvakare "t=−1 haina kururama, saka tinoirasa" zvekuti Sora anzwisise, uye utsanangure kuti nei pasina x ine 2^x=−1. (Anenge mitsara 3)
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga namashoko anozivikanwa naSora. Zvingaita sei kupa mienzaniso yemakosha aunowana kana ukaisa makosha mashoma e x mu 2^x?
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s2.hint.1: Panzvimbo peshoko rekuti "haina kururama," isa mumutsara wako renji yemakosha anogona kutorwa ne 2^x.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakashandisa mashoko anozivikanwa naSora here (semuenzaniso, makosha aunowana kana ukaisa makosha mashoma e x mu 2^x)?
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakapa chikonzero chaicho panzvimbo peshoko rekuti "haina kururama" here?
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Wakacherekedzawo here kuti nei t=4 ichigona kushandiswa?
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s2.model.0: Sora, kana ukaisa x=1, 0, −3 mu 2^x, unowana 2, 1, 1/8, uye dzose dzakakura kupfuura 0. Chero kuchinja x sei, 2^x haimbova negative, saka pasina x ine 2^x=−1. Saka tinorasa t=−1 uye tinoshandisa t=4 chete.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s2.model.1: Chero kuwedzera kana kuparadzanisa 2 kangani, unogara uchiwana nhamba yepositive. 2^x inotora makosha akakura kupfuura 0 chete, saka 2^x=−1 hazvigoneki. t=4 ipositive, saka inopa x=2.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s2.model.2: t=2^x inogara iri positive. Saka kana ukawana nhamba negative senge t=−1, hapana x yakadaro. Izvo hazvisi kukanganisa mukugadzirisa, ndezvekuti 2^x inongova nenzira iyoyo.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s3.prompt: Sarudza huwandu hwema real solution e equation 9^x−2·3^x−3=0.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s3.hint.0: Ngatitii 3^x=t, gadzirisa equation mu t, uye utsvage makosha ose e t.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s3.hint.1: Pakukosha kwe t kwega kwega kwawakawana, tarisa kuti pane x inogutsa 3^x=t here.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s3.r.a: Wakabatanidza makosha ose maviri e t ku x.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s3.r.b: Wakarasikirwa nenyaya apo t iri positive. Tarisa makosha e t awakawana rimwe rimwe.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s3.r.c: Wakaona kuti t=−1 haipi solution uye t=3 chete ndiyo inoshandiswa.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s3.r.d: Verenga zvakare hukama pakati pehuwandu hwema solution e t nehuwandu hwema solution e x.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s3.explain: Kana tikati 3^x=t, ipapo t²−2t−3=(t−3)(t+1)=0. t=3 inopa x=1 kubva ku 3^x=3, uye t=−1 haipi solution nekuti 3^x>0. Saka pane real solution imwe chete, x=1.

n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.prompt: Ruzivo runoratidzwa chidimbu nechidimbu. Panhanho imwe neimwe, sarudza kutonga kunobva pane zvaunoziva kusvika zvino chete.
n-m-h2-diff-04.title: Huwandu hwema real root hunotarwa sei?
n-m-h2-diff-04.topic: Chimiro che graph ye cubic function nema real root e equation
n-m-h2-diff-04.goal: Nguva imwe neimwe ruzivo ruchiwedzerwa, gadzirisa kutonga kwako nezve huwandu hwema distinct real root e cubic equation, uye utsanangure muganhu apo zviratidzo nehuwandu hwema extreme value zvinochinja.
n-m-h2-diff-04.material: Funga huwandu hwema distinct real root e cubic equation x³−3x²+k=0 (k iconstant). Ngatitii f(x)=x³−3x²+k, uye utonge nguva imwe neimwe ruzivo ruchiratidzwa.
n-m-h2-diff-04.thinking.0: Kuramba uchitonga kana ruzivo rusina kukwana
n-m-h2-diff-04.thinking.1: Kuverenga huwandu hwema real root kubva pachimiro che graph
n-m-h2-diff-04.thinking.2: Kuongorora zvakaparadzana makosha emuganhu apo huwandu hunochinja
n-m-h2-diff-04.prereq.0: Local maximum ne minimum ye cubic function nechimiro che graph yayo
n-m-h2-diff-04.prereq.1: Ma real root e equation nemapoinzi apo graph inosangana ne x-axis
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.hint.0: Nguva imwe neimwe ruzivo rutsva rwunobuda, funga kuti kutonga kwako kunofanira kuchinja here.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.hint.1: Fungidzira kuti graph inoyambuka x-axis kangani zvichienderana nezviratidzo ze local maximum ne local minimum.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.0.info: f(x)=x³−3x²+k ifunction ye cubic ine leading coefficient ye positive, uye kukosha kwe k hakusati kwazivikanwa.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Equation f(x)=0 ine ma distinct real root mangani?
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Magumo maviri e graph ye cubic akatarwa, rimwe richikwira rimwe richidzika, saka inosangana ne x-axis kamwe kana kupfuura. Asi kuti inosangana kangani zvinoenderana nekuti local maximum ne local minimum value dziri papi.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Inogara iri 3, chero k iri chii
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Yakasanganisa chokwadi che algebra chekuti cubic equation ine ma root 3 nehuwandu hwema distinct real root.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Inogona kuva 1, 2, kana 3 zvichienderana ne k
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Yakaona kuti huwandu hwenguva dzinosangana graph ne x-axis hunogona kusiyana ne k.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Nguva dzose 1, zvisinei kuti k ndeipi
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Yakataura kuti girafu inoyambuka x-axis kamwe chete.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Hatigoni kutaura chinhu nokuti hatizivi k
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Haina kunyange kutaura huwandu hunogoneka henhamba. Pane chinogona kuzivikanwa kubva pachimiro chebasa recubic.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.1.info: f'(x)=3x(x−2), saka pane local maximum pa x=0 uye local minimum pa x=2. Kukosha kwelocal maximum ndi f(0)=k uye kukosha kwelocal minimum ndi f(2)=k−4.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Kana k=1, pane midzi chaiyo yakasiyana mingani?
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Kana k=1, kukosha kwelocal maximum ndi 1 (kwakanaka) uye kukosha kwelocal minimum ndi −3 (kusina kunaka). Girafu inokwira kubva kumagumo ekuruboshwe, inoyambuka x-axis, inosvika pa local maximum, inodzika, inoyambuka x-axis, inosvika pa local minimum, uye inokwira zvakare kuyambuka x-axis, saka pane midzi chaiyo yakasiyana 3.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Yakangoona kuti kukosha kwelocal maximum 1 kwakanaka ikafunga kuti girafu inosangana neaxis kamwe chete.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Yakange ichifunga nezvenyaya apo girafu inobata x-axis. Izvo zvinoshanda kana kukosha kwemuganho kuri 0 chaizvo chete.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Yakaona kuti local maximum yakanaka uye local minimum haina kunaka, saka girafu inoyambuka x-axis katatu.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Kana k=1, kukosha kwelocal maximum nekwelocal minimum zvese zvinosarudzwa.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.2.info: Kushandura k kunosimudza kana kudzikisa girafu, saka zviratidzo zvekukosha kwelocal maximum k nekwelocal minimum k−4 zvinoenderana ne k, uye pane nguva apo rimwe racho rinova 0.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Kune k ipi pane midzi chaiyo yakasiyana 2 chaizvo?
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Kana k=0, f(x)=x²(x−3), saka midzi ndi x=0 (poindi yekubata) ne x=3; kana k=4, f(x)=(x+1)(x−2)², saka midzi ndi x=−1 ne x=2 (poindi yekubata). Mune nyaya dzese mbiri pane midzi chaiyo yakasiyana 2. Girafu inobata x-axis chaizvo kana kukosha kwemuganho kuri 0.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Yakatarisa nyaya apo kukosha kwelocal maximum kuri 0 chete. Pane nyaya apo kukosha kwelocal minimum kuri 0 zvakare.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Yakatarisa nyaya apo kukosha kwelocal minimum kuri 0 chete. Pane nyaya apo kukosha kwelocal maximum kuri 0 zvakare.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Huwandu uhu ndihwo apo kukosha kwemuganho kune zviratidzo zvakapesana, saka pane midzi chaiyo 3.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.reflect: Pakutanga, nokuti hatina kuziva k, zvese zvataiziva ndezvokuti huwandu hwemidzi chaiyo hunogona kusiyana. Kana takawana kukosha kwemuganho, takakwanisa kusarudza huwandu kune k=1, uye takaona muganho apo huwandu hunoshanduka kubva pa 3 kuenda ku 2 panguva apo kukosha kwemuganho kunova 0. Huwandu hwemidzi chaiyo yeequation hunogona kusarudzwa negirafu nezviratidzo zvekukosha kwemuganho.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s2.prompt: Nyora kuti k inofanira kuva muhuwandu hupi kuti pave nemidzi chaiyo yakasiyana mitatu, uye utsanangure kuti sei kukosha kwemuganho k=0 ne k=4 kusingasanganisirwi.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora kuti kukosha kwelocal maximum nekwelocal minimum rimwe nerimwe rinofanira kuva nechiratidzo chipi kuti girafu iyambuke x-axis katatu.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s2.hint.1: Gadzira zvinhu ze f(x) kana k=0 uye kana k=4, uye uwane midzi zvakananga.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakanyora here mamiriro echiratidzo ekukosha kwelocal maximum nekwelocal minimum?
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakatarisa here zvakananga kuti pane midzi mingani chaizvo pakukosha kwemuganho?
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s2.model.0: Kukosha kwelocal maximum k kunofanira kuva kwakanaka uye kukosha kwelocal minimum k−4 kunofanira kuva kusina kunaka, saka 0<k<4. Kana k=0 kana k=4, kukosha kwemuganho kuri 0, saka girafu inobata x-axis uye pane midzi chaiyo yakasiyana 2 chete.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s2.model.1: 0<k<4. Local maximum inofanira kuva pamusoro pe x-axis uye local minimum pasi payo kuti girafu iyambuke katatu. Pakukosha kwemagumo 0 ne 4, mudzi wakapetwa kaviri unoonekwa uye pane midzi miviri yakasiyana chete, saka yasiiwa.

n-m-h2-limit-03.title: Hukama pakati pezviratidzo zvekukosha kwemagumo nemudzi uri mukati mechikamu
n-m-h2-limit-03.topic: Miganho nekuenderera kwemabasa: converse yeIntermediate Value Theorem
n-m-h2-limit-03.goal: Paradzanisa zvinopiwa neIntermediate Value Theorem (mamiriro anokwana) nezvisingapiwi, uye vaka uye utarise muenzaniso apo converse yetheorem isingashande.
n-m-h2-limit-03.material: Kune basa continuous f, Intermediate Value Theorem inoti, "Kana f(0)f(4)<0, saka pane x muchikamu (0, 4) ine f(x)=0." Doyun anoti, "Ipapo kana f(0)f(4)>0, hapazovi nemudzi muna (0, 4)."
n-m-h2-limit-03.thinking.1: Kugadzira mienzaniso yakati wandei inosangana nemamiriro
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s1.prompt: Kuti uratidze kuti chirevo chaDoyun chiri nhema, unofanira kutsvaga basa continuous rerudzi rupi?
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora chirevo chaDoyun chakapatsanurwa kuva "pfungwa → mhedziso."
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s1.hint.1: Funga kuti pfungwa nemhedziso zvimwe nezvimwe zvinofanira kuva chii kuti chirevo chive nhema.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s1.o.a: Basa continuous ne f(0)f(4)<0 uye risina mudzi muna (0, 4)
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s1.r.a: Nekuda kweIntermediate Value Theorem, basa rakadai haringagoni kuvapo. Kana theorem iri yechokwadi, haugoni kuriwana.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s1.o.b: Basa continuous ne f(0)f(4)>0 uye risina mudzi muna (0, 4)
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s1.r.b: Muenzaniso uyu unowirirana nechirevo chaDoyun, saka haupunzi chirevo.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s1.o.c: Basa continuous ne f(0)f(4)<0 uye rine mudzi muna (0, 4)
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s1.r.c: Iyi nyaya inovimbiswa netheorem, saka haina chekuita nechirevo.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s1.o.d: Basa continuous ne f(0)f(4)>0 uye rine mudzi muna (0, 4)
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s1.explain: Kuratidza kuti chirevo chechimiro che "kana ..., saka ..." chiri nhema, unoda muenzaniso unosangana nepfungwa asi unotadza mhedziso, kureva, muenzaniso une mudzi muna (0, 4) kunyange f(0)f(4)>0.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s2.prompt: Rega f(x)=(x−a)(x−b). Nyora maviri maviri akasiyana (a, b) kuti f(0)f(4)>0 uye f(x)=0 ive nemidzi chaiyo yakasiyana miviri muchikamu (0, 4). (a<b)
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora f(0) ne f(4) nemashoko e a ne b, uye ushande kuti midzi inofanira kuva kupi kuti makosha maviri ave nechiratidzo chimwe chete.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s2.hint.1: Sarudza mudzi mumwe muchikamu (0, 4), nhamba yakazara kana decimal, wobva wasarudza mumwe mudzi pakati pemudzi iwoyo nemucheto wechikamu, uye utarise nekuverenga zvakananga.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s2.ok.c3: Midzi yese miviri iri mukati mena (0, 4).
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s2.explain: f(0)=ab uye f(4)=(4−a)(4−b), uye kana midzi yese miviri iri pakati pe 0 ne 4, zvese zvakanaka. Saka kunyange f(0)f(4)>0, pane midzi miviri muna (0, 4). Girafu inodzika pasi pe x-axis wobva wakwirazve.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s2.because.prompt: Kunyange nemuenzaniso wakadai, Intermediate Value Theorem haina kunganisa. Tsanangura kuti sei mumutsara mumwe kana miviri.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s2.because.hint.0: Nyora patsva kuti theorem inotaura nzira ipi: chii chinoreva chii.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s2.because.hint.1: Funga kana mutsara une nzira yakadzoserwa shure uchireva chinhu chimwe chete.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Wakataura here nzira yetheorem zvakarurama nemazwi?
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Wakaratidza here kuti muenzaniso hauna kupokana netheorem?
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s2.because.model.0: Intermediate Value Theorem inongoti kana zviratidzo zvakasiyana, pane mudzi. Haitauri kuti hapana mudzi kana zviratidzo zvakafanana, saka girafu inoyambuka x-axis kaviri haipokani netheorem.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s2.because.model.1: Converse yetheorem haivimbisiwi. Kunyange kukosha kwemagumo kuine chiratidzo chimwe chete, girafu inogona kuyambuka x-axis pakati ichidzoka, saka mudzi unogona kuvapo.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s2.because.model.2: Theorem inongoti "kana zviratidzo zvakasiyana, pane mudzi." Haiti "kana pane mudzi, zviratidzo zvakasiyana."
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s2.because.model.3: Zvinotaurwa netheorem zvinongosvika pa "kana zviratidzo zvakasiyana, pane mudzi." Hazvireve kuti iyi ndiyo nyaya yega apo mudzi uripo.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s3.prompt: Sarudza mabasa ese ari pazasi apo Intermediate Value Theorem oga inokubvumira kupedza zvechokwadi kuti pane x muchikamu (0, 4) ine f(x)=0.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s3.hint.0: Kune basa rega rega, tarisa zviratidzo zvese zve f(0) ne f(4) nekana pane kutyoka kupi zvako mu [0, 4].
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s3.hint.1: Nyora kuti zvinhu zviviri zvipi zvinodikanwa netheorem kuti zvivimbise mudzi, uye uenzanise sarudzo imwe neimwe nazvo.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s3.r.a: f(0)=4 ne f(4)=4 dzine chiratidzo chimwe chete, saka pfungwa yetheorem haina kusangana. Kunyange x=2 iri mudzi, theorem iyi haina kuuvimbisa.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s3.r.c: Zviratidzo zve f(0) ne f(4) zvakasiyana, asi f haisi continuous pa x=2, saka theorem haigoni kushandiswa. Chaizvo, hapana mudzi zvakare.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s3.explain: Kune b, f(0)=−1 ne f(4)=3, uye ibasa repolynomial, saka continuous, saka theorem inovimbisa mudzi. Zvakafanana kune d, apo f(0)=−3 ne f(4)=5 uye f iri continuous. Kune a, f(0)=4 ne f(4)=4 dzine chiratidzo chimwe chete, saka theorem haigoni kushandiswa (mudzi x=2 uripo, asi theorem haivimbise). Kune c, zviratidzo zvakasiyana, asi f inoputsika pa x=2 uye haisi continuous, saka theorem haigoni kushandiswa.

n-m-h2-trig-10.title: Hukuru hwekona nehukuru hwema trigonometric ratio mu triangle
n-m-h2-trig-10.goal: Pasi pemamiriro ekuti A, B, C ndema interior angle e triangle, tonga kuti kuenzanisa hukuru hwekona kunoenderera kuenda kukuenzanisa makosha e sin, cos, tan munzira ipi, uye ipa zvikonzero uchishandisa law of sines ne obtuse angle.
n-m-h2-trig-10.material: Vadzidzi vana vakaita zvirevo zvinotevera nezve makona matatu e mukati A, B, C e triangle ABC. Funga nyaya apo makosha e trigonometric ratio akatsanangurwa chete.
n-m-h2-trig-10.thinking.0: Tonga kuti chirevo chechokwadi kana chenhema mukati memamiriro acho
n-m-h2-trig-10.thinking.1: Batanidza makona nemativi ne law of sines
n-m-h2-trig-10.prereq.1: Maitiro ekuti divi riri pamberi pekona hombe ndiro divi refu
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza zvirevo zvose zvinogara zvakarurama mu triangle ABC.
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s1.hint.0: Isa makona akatarwa (30°, 100°, zvichingodaro) pa A ne B muchirevo chimwe nechimwe.
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s1.hint.1: Shandisa law of sines kushandura sinA ne sinB kuita hurefu hwemativi, uye unyore kuti kuenzanisa hukuru kunobuda sei.
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s1.r.a: Uku kutonga kwekuti kona huru ine sine value huru. Unogona kuzvitarisa nekuenzanisa hurefu hwemativi akatarisana nemakona maviri uchishandisa law of sines.
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s1.r.b: Uku kutonga kwekuti cosine huru inoreva kona huru. Tarisa kuti cosine value inochinja sei kana kona ichikura kubva ku0° kusvika ku180°.
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s1.r.c: Wakashandura hukuru hwema sine value kuita hurefu hwemativi kuti uzvienzanise uye wakashandisa chokwadi chekuti divi refu riri pamberi pekona hombe.
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s1.r.d: Wakarasikirwa nechokwadi chekuti kona ye triangle inogona kuva obtuse. Enzanisa ma tan value maviri kana A=30° ne B=100°.
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s1.explain: Ne law of sines, a=2R·sinA ne b=2R·sinB, saka sinA>sinB ndiyo yakaenzana ne a>b, uye sezvo divi refu riri pamberi pekona hombe, zvakaenzanawo ne A>B. Saka a ne c dzose dzakarurama. Kana cosA>cosB, ipapo A<B, saka b yakapesana, uye tan ndeye negative kune obtuse angle, saka kana A=30° ne B=100°, tanA>tanB asi A<B, izvo zvinoita kuti d ive yenhema.
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s2.prompt: Tsanangura kuti nei "kana sinA>sinB, ipapo A>B" inoshanda mu triangle (c), uye upe muenzaniso mumwe unopikisa unoratidza kuti (d) haishandi.
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora zvakare sinA ne sinB sehurefu hwemativi uchishandisa law of sines.
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s2.hint.1: Tora imwe ye A ne B se obtuse uye ufunge chiratidzo che tan value.
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s2.placeholder: semuenzaniso. Ne law of sines ... Muenzaniso unopikisa: A=..., B=...
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakashandura here kuenzanisa ma sine value kuita kuenzanisa hurefu hwemativi?
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakaenzanisa here chaizvo makosha e tan A ne tan B?
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Wakaratidza here mumuenzaniso wako unopikisa kuti A<B asi tanA>tanB?
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s2.model.0: Ne law of sines, a=2R sinA ne b=2R sinB, saka kana sinA>sinB ipapo a>b. Divi refu riri pamberi pekona hombe, saka A>B. Muenzaniso unopikisa: A=30°, B=100°. tan30° ipositive uye tan100° inegative, saka tanA>tanB asi A<B.
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s2.model.1: Kana sinA>sinB, ipapo ne law of sines divi a rakareba kupfuura divi b, uye ipapo A yakakura kupfuura B. tan inegative kune obtuse angle, saka semuenzaniso kana A=45° ne B=120°, ipapo tanA=1>tanB=−√3 asi A<B.

n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsetse wekutanga usina kururama mugadziriso yaJiho.
n-m-h2-diff-01.title: Kuongorora chigadziriso chinowana tangent line iri perpendicular kumutsetse
n-m-h2-diff-01.topic: Equation yetangent line: slope yemutsetse weperpendicular
n-m-h2-diff-01.goal: Muchigadziriso chinowana tangent kucurve iri perpendicular kumutsetse wakapiwa, tsvaga mutsara wekutanga unoenda kwakaipa, ugadzirise, uye utarise uchishandisa product yemaslopes.
n-m-h2-diff-01.material: Ichi chigadziriso chaJiho chekuwana, pakati petangent lines dzakadhirowa papoinzi dziri pacurve y=x²−4x+5, iyo iri perpendicular kumutsetse y=x/2+1. (x² inoreva x squared, uye x/2 inoreva x pamusoro pe2.)
n-m-h2-diff-01.thinking.0: Kutevera chigadziriso mutsara nemutsara kuwana mutsara wekutanga unoenda kwakaipa
n-m-h2-diff-01.thinking.1: Kushandura mamiriro e perpendicular kuita hukama pakati pe slope
n-m-h2-diff-01.prereq.0: Kuti kukosha kwe derivative ndiyo slope ye tangent line
n-m-h2-diff-01.prereq.1: Hukama pakati pe slope kana mitsetse miviri iri perpendicular
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s1.hint.0: Tarisa rimwe nerimwe kuti mutsara mumwe nemumwe wakabva sei kumutsara wakamberi chaipo.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s1.hint.1: Tsvaga kuti shoko "perpendicular" rakashandurwa sei kuita hukama mu equation.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s1.line.1: Sezvo iri perpendicular kumutsetse y=x/2+1, slope ye tangent line ndi−1/2.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s1.line.3: Poinzi yekubata ndi(7/4, 17/16), uye tangent line ndi y=−(1/2)(x−7/4)+17/16.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s1.explain: Mutsara 2 ndiwo wekutanga unokanganisa. Kana mitsetse miviri iri perpendicular, product ye slope dzayo ndi−1. Slope yemutsetse perpendicular kumutsetse une slope 1/2 haisi −1/2, iyo inongochinja chiratidzo, asi nhamba ine product ne1/2 ndi−1. Kuverenga kwemitsara 3 ne4 kunotevera mutsara 2, saka kuverenga pacharo kwakarurama, asi mhedzisiro inochinja.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s2.prompt: Gadzirisa mutsara usina kururama uye utsvage x-coordinate yepoinzi yekubata ne equation ye tangent line.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s2.hint.0: Dhirowa mutsetse perpendicular kumutsetse une slope 1/2, wobva wasarudza nhamba mashoma dzinogona kuva slope iyoyo uye uidzive nekuverenga ne1/2.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s2.hint.1: Isa slope itsva yakaenzana ne f'(x) uye utsvage x, wobva watsvaga y-coordinate yepoinzi iyoyo kubva ku f(x).
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakanyora here mamiriro e perpendicular se product ye slope?
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakatsvaga here y-coordinate yepoinzi yekubata kubva pa equation ye curve?
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Wakaisa here equation ye tangent line mufomu y=…?
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s2.model.0: Kana mitsetse iri perpendicular, product ye slope ndi−1, saka (1/2)×m=−1 uye m=−2. Kubva ku 2x−4=−2, x=1, uye f(1)=2, saka poinzi yekubata ndi(1, 2) uye tangent line ndi y=−2x+4.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s2.model.1: Mutsetse perpendicular kumutsetse une slope 1/2 une slope −2. x ine f'(x)=−2 ndi1, uye poinzi yekubata ndi(1,2). Kupfupisa y−2=−2(x−1) kunopa y=−2x+4.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s3.prompt: Mumhinduro yaJiho, kutarisa kupi kwaizobata kukanganisa uku nekukurumidza zvikuru?
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s3.hint.0: Kutanga rangarira equation inoshanda pakati pe slope dzemitsetse miviri ye perpendicular.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s3.hint.1: Isa sarudzo imwe neimwe zvakananga mu slope mbiri dzaJiho, 1/2 ne−1/2.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s3.o.a: Wedzera ma slope maviri uye utarise kuti anoita 0 here
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s3.r.a: Kuwedzera kusvika ku0 hukama apo ma slope anongova nezviratidzo zvakapesana. Zvakaenzana nekuratidzira pamusoro pe x-axis kupfuura perpendicular.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s3.o.b: Tarisa kuti ma slope maviri ane zviratidzo zvakapesana chete here
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s3.r.b: Zviratidzo zvakapesana zvinodiwa asi hazvikwani. Hukuru hwe slope hunofanirawo kuenderana kuti mitsetse ive perpendicular.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s3.o.c: Wedzera ma slope maviri uye utarise kuti anoita −1 here
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s3.r.c: Izvi zvinotarisa zvakananga zvinoreva perpendicular uchishandisa kuwedzera.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s3.o.d: Tarisa kuti y-coordinate yepoinzi yekubata iri pa curve here
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s3.r.d: Kunyangwe poinzi yekubata iri pa curve, kutarisa uku hakugoni kuudza kuti slope inogutsa mamiriro e perpendicular here.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s3.explain: (1/2)×(−1/2)=−1/4, iyo isiri −1. Kutarisa kuti product ndi−1 here kunoratidza kukanganisa kwemutsara 2 pakarepo.

n-m-h2-diff-02.title: Kana average rate of change iri positive, function inoramba ichikwira pa interval here?
n-m-h2-diff-02.topic: Average rate of change nema function anokwira/anodzika
n-m-h2-diff-02.goal: Simbisa, nequadratic function yawakagadzira iwe pachako, kuti kunyangwe average rate of change pa interval iri positive, chimwe chikamu che function mukati me interval iyoyo chingadzikira.
n-m-h2-diff-02.material: Youngwoo anoti, "Kana average rate of change ye function f pa interval [0, 4] iri positive, ipapo f inokwira pa interval iyi." Unoda kuyedza izvi ne function dzemufomu f(x)=x²−bx (b iconstant).
n-m-h2-diff-02.thinking.0: Kuparadzanisa chirevo kuita hypothesis ne conclusion
n-m-h2-diff-02.thinking.1: Kunyora mamiriro emuenzaniso unopikisa se equation
n-m-h2-diff-02.thinking.2: Kuparadzanisa kuenzanisa magumo maviri kubva pashanduko iri mukati me interval
n-m-h2-diff-02.prereq.0: Zvinoreva nekuverenga average rate of change
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s1.prompt: Kuratidza kuti chirevo chaYoungwoo chiri chenhema, tinofanira kutsvaga function yerudzi rupi?
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s1.hint.0: Paradzanisa chirevo chaYoungwoo kuita fomu "kana hypothesis, ipapo conclusion" uye uchinyore.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s1.hint.1: Funga kuti hypothesis ne conclusion imwe neimwe inofanira kuva chii kuti chirevo chive chenhema.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s1.o.a: Function ine average rate of change iri negative uye inokwira pa interval yose
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s1.r.a: Function yakadaro haigoni kuvapo. Hainawo chekuita nechirevo.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s1.o.b: Function ine average rate of change iri positive uye ine chikamu chinodzika mukati me interval
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s1.o.c: Function ine average rate of change iri positive uye inokwira pa interval yose
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s1.r.c: Uyu muenzaniso unowirirana nechirevo, saka hauzogoni kuchiputsa.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s1.o.d: Function ine average rate of change iri 0 uye iri constant pa interval yose
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s1.r.d: Average rate of change haisi positive, saka haigutsi hypothesis yechirevo.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s1.explain: Kuratidza kuti chirevo chemufomu "kana ~, ipapo ~" chiri chenhema, unoda muenzaniso unogutsa hypothesis (average rate of change ipositive) asi usingagutsi conclusion (inokwira pa interval).
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s2.prompt: Kune f(x)=x²−bx, isa b ne p dzakadai kuti average rate of change pa [0, 4] ipositive, uye papoinzi p imwe mukati me (0, 4) f'(p)<0 (f iri kudzika padhuze nepoinzi iyoyo). Gadzira mienzaniso 3 ine makosha akasiyana e b.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s2.hint.0: Kutanga ratidza f(0) ne f(4) nenzira ye b, uye utsvage renji ye b apo average rate of change ipositive.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s2.hint.1: Sarudza kukosha kumwe kwe b uye utsvage kuti f'(x)=2x−b ine negative papi mukati me interval.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s2.fail.c1: Average rate of change (f(4)−f(0))/4 haisi positive.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s2.fail.c2: p inofanira kuva huru kupfuura 0 uye diki kupfuura 4.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s2.ok.c3: f'(p)=2p−b ine negative, saka f iri kudzika padhuze ne p.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s2.explain: f(4)−f(0)=16−4b, saka average rate of change ndi4−b. Kuti iyi ive positive, b<4, uye kuti f'(x)=2x−b ive negative pane imwe nzvimbo mu interval, b>0 inodiwa. Saka b imwe neimwe ine 0<b<4 inopa muenzaniso unopikisa. Semuenzaniso, kana b=2, ipapo f(x)=x²−2x iri kudzika pa [0, 1] uye ichikwira pa [1, 4].
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Kunyangwe mienzaniso yakadaro iripo, chokwadi chekuti average rate of change ipositive hachisi ruzivo rwenhema. Tsanangura mumutsara mumwe kana miviri zvaunogona nezvausingagoni kuziva kubva pa average rate of change ipositive.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s2.because.hint.0: Tarisa zvakare kuti mapoinzi api emakosha e interval anoshandiswa kana uchiverenga average rate of change.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s2.because.hint.1: Enzanisa makosha e f(1), f(0), ne f(4), uye udhirowe graph yakafamba sei.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Wakataura here kuti makosha chete anoshandiswa ne average rate of change ndiwo magumo maviri?
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Wakaparadzanisa here shanduko iri mukati me interval kubva pakuenzanisa magumo?
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s2.because.model.0: Average rate of change inobva pakuenzanisa makosha emagumo maviri chete, saka inongotiudza kuti f(4)>f(0). Kunyangwe graph ichidzika imwe nzvimbo pakati, ipositive kana ikakwira zvakanyanya kusvika pakupera.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s2.because.model.1: Kana average rate of change ipositive, unogona kuziva kuti kukosha kwepamucheto kwakakura kupfuura kukosha kwekutanga, asi haugoni kuziva kuti inodzika nguva pfupi pakati pe interval here.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s3.prompt: Kana ukangoziva kuti average rate of change ye f pa [0, 4] ipositive, chii chinogona kutaurwa chiri chechokwadi nguva dzose?
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s3.hint.0: Nyora fomula ye average rate of change uye ufunge chiratidzo che denominator.

n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s3.r.b: Pangava nechikamu chinodzika, semuenzaniso wawakagadzira mu s2.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s3.o.c: f(x)>0 kune x imwe neimwe mu interval

n-m-h2-diff-03.title: Zvinoreva kwema curve maviri kubata papoinzi
n-m-h2-diff-03.topic: Mamiriro ekuti ma curve maviri abate

n-m-h2-diff-03.material: Curve y=f(x)=x³ ne curve y=g(x)=x²+ax+b (a ne b ndema constant) anobata papoinzi (1, 1). (Izvi zvinoreva kuti ma curve maviri anopfuura papoinzi imwe uye ane tangent line imwe chete ipapo.) Unoda kutsvaga a ne b.
n-m-h2-diff-03.thinking.0: Kushandura mamiriro akapiwa kuita ma equation
n-m-h2-diff-03.thinking.1: Kuparadzanisa mamiriro anodiwa kubva kune asingakwani
n-m-h2-diff-03.thinking.2: Kuenzanisa huwandu hwema unknown nehuwandu hwema equation
n-m-h2-diff-03.prereq.0: Kukosha kwe derivative ne slope ye tangent line
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s1.prompt: Ndeapi ma equation e g aunofanira kugadzira kuti usarudze a ne b?
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora se equation zvokwadi zviviri (nzvimbo, slope) zvinodiwa kuti ma curve maviri abate papoinzi.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s1.hint.1: Isa x=1 mu f(x)=x³ kutsvaga y-coordinate yepoinzi ne slope ye tangent line.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s1.r.a: Mamiriro ekupfuura papoinzi (1, 1) akarurama, asi g(0)=0 mamiriro asiri mudambudziko.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s1.r.b: Mamiriro ekupfuura (1, 1) akarurama, asi slope inofanira kutarisirwa papoinzi yekubata x=1, kwete x=0.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s1.r.d: Yakachinjanisa makosha e f(1) ne f'(1). Unofanira kuparadzanisa y-coordinate yepoinzi kubva ku slope ye tangent line.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s1.explain: Curve g inofanira kupfuura papoinzi (1, 1), saka g(1)=1, uye kuti ma tangent line ave imwe chete, ma slope pa x=1 anofanirawo kuenzana, saka g'(1)=f'(1)=3.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s2.prompt: Tsvaga makosha e a ne b, uye unyore mumutsara mumwe kuti wakatarisa sei kuti makosha awakawana anogutsa ma equation maviri akagadzirwa mu s1.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s2.hint.0: Kutanga tsvaga g'(x), wobva waisa kukosha kwayo pa x=1 kuenzana ne3.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s2.hint.1: Isa a yawakawana mu equation yekupfuura papoinzi kuti utsvage b.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakanyora here mamiriro e slope nemamiriro epoinzi imwe neimwe se equation?
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakadzorera here a ne b dzawakawana mu equation dzose mbiri?
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s2.model.0: g'(x)=2x+a, saka g'(1)=2+a=3 inopa a=1. Kuisa a=1 mu g(1)=1+a+b=1 kunopa b=−1. Kutarisa, g(1)=1 ne g'(1)=3, saka zvakarurama.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s2.model.1: Kubva pamamiriro e slope 2+a=3, a=1, uye kubva pamamiriro ekupfuura papoinzi, 1+1+b=1, saka b=−1. Ndakatarisa nekudzorera mu equation dzose mbiri.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s3.prompt: Panguva ino hauzivi poinzi yekubata, uye unoziva chete kuti ma curve maviri y=x³ ne y=x²+ax+b "anobata papoinzi imwe." Munyaya iyi, a ne b dzinotarwa here?
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s3.hint.0: Ngatitii t ndiyo x-coordinate yepoinzi yekubata uye unyore ma equation maviri ekubata.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s3.hint.1: Verenga huwandu hwema unknown nehuwandu hwema equation uye uzviwenzanise.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s3.o.a: Hazvitarwi. X-coordinate t yepoinzi yekubata inewo unknown, saka pane ma unknown 3 uye ma equation 2 chete
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s3.o.b: Zvinotarwa. Mamiriro ekubata anopa ma equation maviri, saka a ne b dzinogona kutsvagwa
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s3.r.b: Wakarasikirwa nechokwadi chekuti, sezvo poinzi yekubata isingazivikanwi, x-coordinate yayo inovawo unknown itsva.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s3.o.c: Hazvitarwi. Mamiriro ekubata anopa equation imwe chete
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s3.r.c: Mamiriro ekubata anopa nzvimbo ne slope, ndiko kuti, ma equation maviri. Wakaverenga ma equation zvisina kururama.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s3.o.d: Zvinotarwa. Kuti ibate b inofanira kuva 0, uye ipapo a inotarwawo kuva imwe chete
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s3.r.d: Hapana hwaro mudambudziko hwekuti b inofanira kuva 0. Kana poinzi yekubata isingazivikanwi, b inogona kusiyanawo.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s3.explain: Kana x-coordinate yepoinzi yekubata iri t, ipapo t³=t²+at+b uye 3t²=2t+a, saka pane ma equation maviri uye ma unknown matatu, a, b, ne t. Semuenzaniso, t=1 inopa (a, b)=(1, −1) uye t=2 inopa (a, b)=(8, −12); nguva imwe neimwe t ichichinja, (a, b) yakasiyana inobuda.

n-m-h2-diff-05.title: Tangent inosangana nekakombama papoindi yekubata chete here?
n-m-h2-diff-05.goal: Edza chirevo chokuti "Tangent inosangana nekakombama papoindi yekubata chete" nekakombama y=x³, uye gadzirisa zvinoreva tangent semutsetse une slope iri kukosha kwederivative.
n-m-h2-diff-05.material: Hajun anoti, "Tangent mutsetse unosangana nekakombama papoindi yekubata chete. Kana ukadhonza tangent ikasangana nekakombama papoindi yakasiyana zvakare, wakadhonza tangent zvisizvo." Unoda kuedza chirevo ichi nekakombama y=x³. (x³ zvinoreva x cubed.)
n-m-h2-diff-05.thinking.1: Kutsvaga mapoindi ekusangana etangent nekakombama pamapoindi ekubata akati wandei
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s1.prompt: Nzira yakakodzera zvakanyanya yekuedza chirevo chaHajun ndeipi?
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s1.hint.0: Tsanangura nemazwi kuti muenzaniso unoputsa chirevo waizoratidzika sei.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s1.hint.1: Kana ukatora poindi yekubata se (a, a³), unogona kunyora equation yetangent nemashoko e a.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s1.o.a: Dhonza tangent pakatanga (0, 0) chete uye utarise kuti inosangana nekakombama papi
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s1.r.a: Kutarisa poindi imwe chete kunogona kuratidza mienzaniso inowirirana nechirevo chete. Kuedza kunofanira kutarisa mienzaniso apo chirevo chingaputsika.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s1.o.b: Tsvaga tangent pamusoro pepoindi apo slope yayo iri 0 chete
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s1.r.b: Poindi ine slope 0 poindi imwe chete yakasarudzika, saka haimiriri poindi yekubata yakajairika.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s1.o.c: Dhonza mufananidzo uye utarise nenziso kana tangent nekakombama zvichioneka zvakanamatira
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s1.r.c: Chimiro chinoonekwa nenziso chete hachigoni kuziva kana zvichisangana zvakare kure.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s1.o.d: Tsvaga matangent pamapoindi ekubata (a, a³) akati wandei uye uongorore mamwe mapoindi ekusangana
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s1.explain: Kana chirevo chiri nhema, panofanira kuva netangent inosangananewo nekakombama papoindi isiri poindi yekubata. Kuti uwane imwe, unofanira kugadzira equation yetangent pamapoindi ekubata akati wandei, kwete rimwe kana maviri chete, uye uigadzirise pamwe chete nekakombama.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s2.prompt: Tsvaga unyore maviri maviri enhamba dzakazara (a, b) 3, ane makosha akasiyana e a, apo tangent papoindi yekubata (a, a³) inosangana zvakare nekakombama y=x³ papoindi (b, b³) isiri poindi yekubata. (a iri kubva pa −5 kusvika pa 5)
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora slope neequation yetangent papoindi yekubata (a, a³) nemashoko e a.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s2.hint.1: Nyora kuti equation ye b yakadini inofanira kushanda kuti poindi (b, b³) ive patangent iyoyo.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s2.hint.2: Isa kukosha kwenhamba yakazara imwe ye a panguva imwe uye uwane b, uye uchaona muenzaniso we b.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s2.ok.c1: a ne b ndi nhamba dzakazara mukati mehuwandu.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s2.fail.c1: a inofanira kuva nhamba yakazara kubva pa −5 kusvika pa 5, uye b inofanirawo kuva nhamba yakazara.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s2.fail.c2: Kana b yakaenzana ne a, ndiyo poindi yekubata pachayo.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s2.explain: Tangent papoindi yekubata (a, a³) ndi y=3a²x−2a³. Kuigadzirisa pamwe chete nekakombama kunopa x³−3a²x+2a³=(x−a)²(x+2a)=0, saka x=a (poindi yekubata, mudzi wakapetwa kaviri) ne x=−2a. Kana a≠0, saka −2a yakasiyana ne a, saka tangent inosangana zvakare nekakombama papoindi isiri poindi yekubata.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s3.prompt: Pindura Hajun. Chirevo chaHajun chakarurama here? Tsanangura uchishandisa muenzaniso uri pamusoro sehumbowo, uye utaure zvakarurama kuti tangent chii.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s3.hint.0: Sarudza muenzaniso mumwe wawakagadzira mu s2 uye unyore mapoindi ese apo tangent inosangana nekakombama.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s3.hint.1: Taura "tangent" nemashoko eslope, kwete nehuwandu hwemapoindi ekusangana.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakapa here muenzaniso chaiwo (poindi yekubata neimwe poindi yekusangana yakasiyana)?
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Wakadzivisa here kunzwisisa izvi sezvinoitika kukakombama kuno chete?
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s3.model.0: Hazvina kururama. Semuenzaniso, pa y=x³, tangent y=3x−2 pa (1, 1) inosanganawo nekakombama pa x=−2. Tangent mutsetse une slope iri kukosha kwederivative papoindi yekubata, uye ichiri tangent kunyange ichisangana nekakombama papoindi yakasiyana zvakare.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s3.model.1: Kwete. Tangent mutsetse unobata kakombama padyo nepoindi yekubata (slope yayo ndiyo derivative papoindi iyoyo), saka unogona kuyambuka kakombama zvakare kure. Semuenzaniso, tangent pa (1, 1) inopfuurawo napoindi (−2, −8).

n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s2.ok.c1: a ne b ndi nhamba dzakazara mukati mehuwandu.
n-m-h2-diff-06.title: Kugadzira basa recubic ine kukosha kwemuganho kuviri kwese kunoitika pa x>0
n-m-h2-diff-06.topic: Kukosha kwemuganho kwebasa recubic nemidzi yederivative yaro
n-m-h2-diff-06.goal: Shandura mamiriro enzvimbo dzekukosha kwemuganho kuva mamiriro emidzi yederivative, uye gadzira iwe pachako mabasa ecubic akati wandei anosangana nemamiriro ese.
n-m-h2-diff-06.material: Unoda kugadzira basa f(x)=x³+ax²+bx (a ne b ndi nhamba dzakazara) rine local maximum ne local minimum, apo makosha e x anopa kukosha kwemuganho ese akanaka. (ax² zvinoreva a nguva x squared.)
n-m-h2-diff-06.thinking.0: Kushandura mamiriro egirafu kuva mamiriro emidzi yederivative
n-m-h2-diff-06.thinking.1: Kutsvaga kuti sei mamiriro rimwe oga haakwani
n-m-h2-diff-06.prereq.1: Discriminant yequadratic equation nezviratidzo zvemidzi yayo
n-m-h2-diff-06.prereq.2: Mabasa ecubic ane ma coefficient enhamba dzakazara
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s1.prompt: Mamiriro aya anova chii kana atauriwa semamiriro ederivative f'(x)=3x²+2ax+b?
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora kuti derivative inotora kukosha kupi pa x apo kukosha kwemuganho kunoitika, uye kuti chiratidzo chayo chinofamba sei pamberi nepashure.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s1.hint.1: Verenga kuti x dzakadaro dzinodikanwa dzingani kuti pave ne local maximum ne local minimum.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s1.o.a: Equation f'(x)=0 ine midzi chaiyo yakanaka yakasiyana miviri
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s1.o.b: Equation f'(x)=0 ine mudzi chaiyo wakanaka mumwe kana kupfuura
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s1.r.b: Kana pane mudzi chaiyo wakanaka mumwe chete, pane kukosha kwemuganho kumwe chete, kana mumwe mudzi ungasava wakanaka.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s1.o.c: f'(x) inogara yakanaka kune x yakanaka
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s1.r.c: Ipapo f inoramba ichikura pachikamu chakanaka uye haina kukosha kwemuganho.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s1.o.d: Equation f'(x)=0 ine mudzi wakapetwa kaviri wakanaka
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s1.r.d: Nemudzi wakapetwa kaviri, chiratidzo chederivative hachishanduki, saka hapana kukosha kwemuganho kunoitika.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s1.explain: X inopa kukosha kwemuganho mudzi we f'(x)=0 apo chiratidzo che f' chinoshanduka pamberi nepashure. Kuti pave ne local maximum ne local minimum, midzi chaiyo miviri yakasiyana inodikanwa, uye midzi iyoyo yese miviri inofanira kuva yakanaka.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s2.prompt: Nyora maviri maviri akasiyana 3 enhamba dzakazara (a, b) kuti kune f(x)=x³+ax²+bx, f'(x)=0 ive nemidzi chaiyo yakanaka miviri yakasiyana. (Makosha akazara e a ne b ndi 20 kana pasi.)
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora huwandu nechibereko chemidzi miviri yequadratic equation 3x²+2ax+b=0 nemashoko e a ne b.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s2.hint.1: Funga kana zviratidzo zvehuwandu nechibereko zvega zvakakwana kutaura kuti midzi iri chaiyo.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s2.hint.2: Sarudza a isina kunaka kutanga, wobva wasiyanisa b uye utarise zvakananga kana pane midzi.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s2.fail.c1: a ne b dzinofanira kuva nhamba dzakazara dzine kukosha kwakazara kwe 20 kana pasi.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s2.ok.c2: Midzi miviri ye 3x²+2ax+b=0 ndi nhamba chaiyo dzakasiyana.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s2.ok.c3: Huwandu nechibereko chemidzi miviri zvese zvakanaka.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s2.fail.c3: Huwandu (−2a/3) nechibereko (b/3) chemidzi miviri hazvisi zvese zvakanaka.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s2.explain: Kuti midzi miviri ye 3x²+2ax+b=0 ive nhamba dzakanaka dzakasiyana, discriminant inofanira kuva yakanaka (a²−3b>0), huwandu hwemidzi −2a/3 hunofanira kuva hwakanaka (a<0), uye chibereko chemidzi b/3 chinofanira kuva chakanaka (b>0). Semuenzaniso, (a, b)=(−3, 1), (−4, 2), (−6, 3).
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s2.because.prompt: (a, b)=(−1, 1) ine a<0 ne b>0 asi haisangani nemamiriro. Tsanangura kuti sei kwete, uchishandisa f'(x) nechimiro che f.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s2.because.hint.0: Nyora f'(x)=3x²−2x+1 mufomu yakazadzwa square, kana uverenge discriminant.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s2.because.hint.1: Tarisa kana chiratidzo che f'(x) chichishanduka x painoshanduka.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Wakafunga here kana f'(x)=0 ine midzi?
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Wakabatanidza here izvi nechokwadi chokuti hapana kukosha kwemuganho kana chiratidzo che f' chisingashanduki?
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s2.because.model.0: f'(x)=3x²−2x+1, uye discriminant ndi 4−12<0, saka f'(x)=0 haina midzi chaiyo. f'(x) inogara yakanaka, saka f inongokwira uye haina kukosha kwemuganho.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s2.because.model.1: Kunyange a<0 ne b>0, discriminant (−2)²−4·3·1 haina kunaka, saka f'=0 haina midzi chaiyo; saka chiratidzo che f' hachishanduki uye hapana kukosha kwemuganho kunoitika.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s3.prompt: Sarudza (a, b) dzese dzinotevera apo f(x)=x³+ax²+bx ine kukosha kwayo kwemuganho kuviri kwese pa x>0.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s3.hint.0: Isa (a, b) imwe neimwe mu 3x²+2ax+b=0 uye utanga watarisa chiratidzo che discriminant.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s3.hint.1: Kune dzine midzi chaiyo chete, funga zviratidzo zvehuwandu nechibereko chemidzi miviri.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s3.r.a: a<0 ne b>0, asi discriminant a²−3b=0, saka f'(x)=0 ine mudzi wakapetwa kaviri. Hapana kukosha kwemuganho kunoitika pamudzi wakapetwa kaviri.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s3.r.c: Kana a>0, huwandu hwemidzi miviri husina kunaka, saka hapagoni kuva nemidzi miviri yakanaka.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s3.explain: (−5, 2): discriminant 25−6>0, a<0, uye b>0, saka inoshanda. (−2, 1): 4−3>0, saka kubva pa 3x²−4x+1=(3x−1)(x−1)=0, x=1/3 ne 1, zvese zvakanaka. (−3, 3) ine mudzi wakapetwa kaviri, uye kune (3, 1) midzi yese miviri isina kunaka.

n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsetse wekutanga wakanganisa mumhinduro yaEunseo.
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s1.hint.0: Maka mamiriro ese mumutsara wedambudziko uye utarise kana mutsetse wega wega wemhinduro wakaashandisa.
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s1.hint.1: Tsvaga mutsetse apo huwandu hwe x hunotanga kuoneka uye uuenzanise nemamiriro edambudziko.
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s1.line.0: Nheyo isikweya ine rutivi rwe 12−2x uye kukwirira ndi x, saka huwandu ndi V(x)=x(12−2x)².
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s1.line.2: Kubva pa V'(x)=0, x=2 kana x=6.
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s1.line.3: Kuti nheyo ivepo, 12−2x>0, saka 0<x<6, uye muhuwandu uhu muvanokwanisa wega ndi x=2.
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s1.line.4: Sezvo chiratidzo che V'(x) chichishanduka kubva pakunaka kuenda kusina kunaka padyo ne x=2, V(2) ndiyo huru zvakanyanya.
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s1.line.5: Saka huwandu hukuru zvakanyanya ndi V(2)=128 cm³.
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s1.explain: Mutsetse 4 ndiwo unotanga kukanganisa. Dambudziko rakati sikweya inogona kuchekwa kana x iri 1.5 kana pasi, asi mhinduro yakatora huwandu 0<x<6 kubva pamamiriro ekuti nheyo ivepo chete. Mitsetse 5 ne 6 inotevera huwandu hwemutsetse 4, saka mhedzisiro inoshanduka. Zvirevo nekuverenga zvomumitsetse 1 kusvika ku 3 zvakarurama.
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s2.prompt: Muhuwandu hwakarurama hwe x, kukosha kwe x kupi kunoita V(x) kuva huru zvakanyanya?
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora huwandu hwakarurama hwe x uye ufunge chiratidzo che V'(x) muhuwandu uhwo.
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s2.hint.1: Kana V ichikura, funga kuti kukosha kukuru muhuwandu kuchaitika papi.
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s2.r.a: I poinzi apo derivative i 0, asi iri kunze kwerenji yedambudziko, saka haigone kugadzirwa chaizvo.
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s2.r.b: I poinzi iri mukati merenji, asi haisi apo maximum inoitika.
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s2.r.d: Yakasarudza mutengo wepakati werenji. Unofanira kuongorora kukwira nekudzikira kuti uziwe kuti maximum inoitika kupi.
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s2.explain: Kune 0<x≤1.5, V'(x)=12(x−2)(x−6)>0, saka V inoramba ichikwira. Saka maximum i pagumo rerudyi rerenji, x=1.5.
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s3.prompt: Wana maximum volume negadziriso yakarurama, uye unyore mumutsara mumwe kana miviri kuti nei maximum ichiitika papoinzi isiri iyo apo V'(x)=0.
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s3.hint.0: Isa x=1.5 mufomula uye uverenge volume.
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s3.hint.1: Tarisa kana x ine V'(x)=0 iri mukati merenji inobvumirwa.
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakanyora zvakare renji inobvumirwa se 0<x≤1.5 here?
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakatarisa kana V ichikwira kana kudzikira mukati merenji here?
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s3.model.0: Kune 0<x≤1.5, V'(x)>0, saka V inoramba ichikwira, uye maximum i pagumo rerudyi x=1.5. V(1.5)=1.5×81=121.5 cm³. x=2 i kunze kwerenji.
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s3.model.1: Kana x=3/2, volume (3/2)×9²=243/2=121.5 cm³ i maximum. Mu renji iyi V inoramba ichikwira, saka poinzi apo V'(x)=0 haisi mu renji.

n-m-h2-diff-08.title: Panguva apo acceleration i 0, poinzi inochinja direction here?
n-m-h2-diff-08.topic: Velocity nedirection yekufamba: kuchinja kwenzvimbo nedistance yakafamba
n-m-h2-diff-08.goal: Siyanisa nguva apo direction yekufamba kwepoinzi inofamba pa number line inochinja nenguva apo acceleration i 0, uye utonge uchishandisa kuchinja kwechiratidzo che velocity.
n-m-h2-diff-08.material: Nzvimbo yepoinzi P inofamba pa number line panguva t (0≤t≤4) i x(t)=t³−6t²+9t. Velocity i x'(t) uye acceleration i x''(t). Jimin anoti, "Pa t=2 acceleration i 0. Panguva apo acceleration i 0, P inochinja direction." (t³ zvinoreva t cubed.)
n-m-h2-diff-08.thinking.0: Kusarudza chiratidzo (chiratidzo che velocity) chinogona kuyedza chirevo
n-m-h2-diff-08.thinking.1: Kusiyanisa nguva apo acceleration i 0 nenguva apo direction inochinja
n-m-h2-diff-08.prereq.0: Hukama pakati penzvimbo, velocity, ne acceleration (derivative yenzvimbo, derivative ye velocity)
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s1.prompt: Kuyedza kana chirevo chaJimin chakarurama, unofanira kuongorora chii pakutanga?
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s1.hint.0: Funga kuti chiratidzo che velocity chinosiyana sei kana poinzi ichienda kurudyi nekana ichienda kuruboshwe.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s1.hint.1: Siyanisa x(t) kuti uwane velocity, uye uise mitengo pamberi napashure pe t=2 chete.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s1.o.a: Tarisa kana average rate of change pa interval [0, 4] i positive
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s1.r.a: Average rate of change inongoenzanisa nzvimbo mbiri dzemagumo, saka haitiudze nezvekufamba pakati.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s1.o.b: Wana kuti nzvimbo x(2) pa t=2 i chii
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s1.r.b: Kuziva mutengo wenzvimbo hakutiudze kana direction yekufamba inochinja pamberi napashure payo.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s1.o.c: Tarisa kana zviratidzo zve velocity v(t)=x'(t) pamberi napashure pe t=2 zvakasiyana
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s1.o.d: Verenga kamwe zvakare kana acceleration x''(2)=0 yakarurama chaizvo
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s1.r.d: Kuti acceleration i 0 kwatopiwa. Chinofanira kuyedzwa i kana izvozvo zvichireva kuchinja kwe direction.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s1.explain: Direction iyo poinzi inofamba inosarudzwa nechiratidzo che velocity. Kuti direction ichinje, chiratidzo che velocity chinofanira kusiyana pamberi napashure, uye chokwadi chekuti acceleration i 0 oga hachitiudze izvozvo.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s2.prompt: Sarudza nguva dzose mu 0≤t≤4 apo direction yekufamba kwepoinzi P inochinja.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s2.hint.0: Wana velocity v(t)=x'(t) iwe pachako uye uverenge chiratidzo chayo pa t=0, 2, ne 4.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s2.hint.1: Tarisa kana chiratidzo chinochinja pamberi napashure penguva apo velocity i 0.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s2.r.b: Pa t=2 acceleration i 0, asi velocity i −3, saka poinzi inoramba ichienda kuruboshwe. Direction haichinji.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s2.r.d: Ndiyo nguva yekupedzisira yeinterval, uye velocity panguva iyoyo i 9, iri positive. Haisi nguva apo direction inochinja.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s2.explain: x'(t)=3t²−12t+9=3(t−1)(t−3), saka velocity i 0 pa t=1 ne 3, uye chiratidzo chinochinja pamberi napashure penguva idzodzo (positive kuenda negative kuenda positive). t=2 inongova nguva apo acceleration x''(t)=6t−12 yakaenzana ne 0.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s3.prompt: Pindura Jimin. Tsanangura, uchishandisa mutengo we velocity, nei P ichirega kuchinja direction kunyange acceleration i 0 pa t=2, uye utaure kuti direction inochinja riini.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s3.hint.0: Verenga mutengo we velocity v(2) pa t=2 iwe pachako.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s3.hint.1: Wana nguva apo velocity i 0 uye uenzanise kuti chiratidzo che velocity chinosiyana sei pamberi napashure pazvo.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakaverenga velocity pa t=2 iwe pachako uye wakatarisa chiratidzo chayo here?
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakasiyanisa nguva apo chiratidzo che velocity chinochinja nenguva apo acceleration i 0 here?
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Wakatsanangura nemitengo kuti nei chirevo chisina kururama here?
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s3.model.0: Zvechokwadi kuti acceleration i 0 pa t=2, asi velocity v(2)=3·4−12·2+9=−3 i negative, saka P inoramba ichienda kuruboshwe. Direction inochinja kana chiratidzo che velocity chinochinja, uye sezvo v(t)=3(t−1)(t−3), inochinja pa t=1 ne t=3.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s3.model.1: Kana acceleration i 0, inongova nguva apo velocity isiri kudzikira kana kukwira. Pa t=2 velocity i −3, saka direction haichinji, uye direction inochinja pa t=1 ne t=3, apo velocity inova 0 uye chiratidzo chayo chichichinja.

n-m-h2-diff-09.title: Renji ye a yekuti function igare ichikwira
n-m-h2-diff-09.topic: Derivatives nekukwira: muganhu apo kuenzana kunosanganisirwa
n-m-h2-diff-09.goal: Kana uchishandura mamiriro ekuti function ikwire pa real numbers dzose kuita mamiriro pachiratidzo che derivative, edza mitengo yemuganhu (apo derivative i 0 papoinzi imwe chete) zvakaparadzana, uye unyore mhedzisiro seyakanyorwa kumudzidzi mudiki.
n-m-h2-diff-09.material: Iyi i gadziriso yaSoeun, mudzidzi mudiki, akawana renji ye constant a kuti function f(x)=x³+ax²+3x ikwire pa real numbers dzose. Soeun akaratidza gadziriso iyi nekuzvikudza. (x³ zvinoreva x cubed uye ax² zvinoreva a yakawanzwa ne x square.)
n-m-h2-diff-09.thinking.0: Kuwana mutsetse apo mamiriro akashandiswa zvakasimba zvakanyanya mugadziriso
n-m-h2-diff-09.thinking.2: Kunyora zvakare kuti mudzidzi mudiki atevere
n-m-h2-diff-09.prereq.0: Chiratidzo che derivative nekukwira/kudzikira kwe function
n-m-h2-diff-09.prereq.1: Mamiriro (discriminant) ekuti quadratic inequality ishande kune real numbers dzose
n-m-h2-diff-09.prereq.2: Chimiro che perfect-cube che cubic expression
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsetse wekutanga usina kururama mugadziriso yaSoeun.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s1.hint.0: Tarisa rimwe nerimwe kuti mutsetse mumwe nemumwe wakabva sei kumutsetse wakamberi pakarepo.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s1.hint.1: Funga kana "iri kukwira" ne "derivative i positive" zvichireva zvakafanana.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s1.line.1: Kuti f ikwire pa real numbers dzose, f'(x)>0 inofanira kushanda kune real x yose.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s1.line.2: Kana D i discriminant ye f'(x)=0, D/4=a²−9<0 inodiwa.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s1.explain: Mutsetse 2 ndiwo wekutanga unokanganisa. Kuti function ikwire, f'(x)≥0 yakakwana; haisi kudikanwa kuti ive f'(x)>0. Kana f'(x) i 0 papoinzi imwe chete uye i positive kumwe, function ichiri kukwira kupfuura poinzi iyoyo. Mitsetse 3 ne 4 inotevera mutsetse 2, saka muganhu wakashaikwa mu renji inobuda.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s2.prompt: Unoda kutarisa kana f ichikwira pa real numbers dzose kana a=3, iri pamuganhu. Nzira yakakodzera zvakanyanya i ipi?
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s2.hint.0: Isa a=3 mu f(x) uye uifactor, kana uinyore zvakare muchimiro che perfect-square kana perfect-cube.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s2.hint.1: Nyora kuti chiratidzo che f' i chii pamberi napashure papoinzi apo f'(x) i 0.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s2.o.a: Tonga kuti haikwiri, nekuti pa a=3 kune x ine f'(x)=0
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s2.r.a: Kunyange derivative i 0 papoinzi imwe, function inokwira kana chiratidzo chayo chisingachinji pamberi napashure. Unofanira kutarisa usati watonga.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s2.o.b: Fungidzira kuti hapana kutarisa kwakaparadzana kunodiwa, nekuti i mutengo uri kunze kwe −3<a<3
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s2.r.b: Kuti i mutengo wemuganhu kana kwete ndiyo mubvunzo chaiwo, saka kutarisa kunodiwa.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s2.o.c: Verenga chiratidzo che f' pa x=0 chete
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s2.r.c: Chiratidzo papoinzi imwe hachigone kusarudza kana f ichikwira pa real numbers dzose.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s2.o.d: Isa a=3, ita f(x) nyore, uye utarise chimiro che graph
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s2.explain: Kana a=3, ipapo f(x)=x³+3x²+3x=(x+1)³−1. Graph yechimiro che (x+1)³ ine slope 0 pa x=−1 asi inoramba ichikwira. f'(x)=3(x+1)²≥0, uye poinzi yega apo i 0 i x=−1.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s3.prompt: Nyora note yekutumira kuna Soeun. Taura chinhu chimwe chakanaka chebasa raSoeun, uye utsanangure chikamu chekugadzirisa nenzira yacho, uchishandisa muenzaniso a=3, kuti upe renji yakarurama ye a.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s3.hint.0: Tanga wawana chinhu chimwe chakaitwa zvakanaka naSoeun.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s3.hint.1: Kana ukanyora mu note kuti f'(x) ine chimiro chei kana a=3, zvichava nyore kuna Soeun kunzwisisa.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakaratidza mutsetse upi wakanga usina kururama uye nei, uchishandisa muenzaniso a=3 here?
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s3.model.0: Soeun, zvaiva zvakanaka kuti wakanyora discriminant! Asi f'(x)≥0 yakakwana, kwete f'(x)>0. Kana a=3, f(x)=(x+1)³−1, saka f'(x)=0 papoinzi imwe chete, x=−1, uye function inoramba ichikwira. Saka −3≤a≤3.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s3.model.1: Wakanyora mhinduro se −3<a<3, handizvo? Tarisa kana magumo a=±3 anoshandawo. Kana ukaisa a=3, f(x)=(x+1)³−1, iyo i increasing function. Kunyange f' i 0 papoinzi imwe, function ichiri kukwira chero chiratidzo chisingachinji kumativi ose, saka unofanira kusanganisira chiratidzo chekuenzana uye unyore −3≤a≤3.

n-m-h2-diff-10.prereq.2: Mabasa ecubic ane ma coefficient enhamba dzakazara
n-m-h2-diff-10.title: Tinogona kuwana local maximum value kana tichiziva derivative chete here?
n-m-h2-diff-10.topic: Zvatinogona nezvatisingagone kudzidza kubva pa derivative: basa re constant term
n-m-h2-diff-10.goal: Tarisa kuti kuziva derivative chete kunokuudza chimiro che function (kwainokwira nekudzikira nekwainoitika extreme values) asi kwete nzvimbo yayo yakamira (hukuru hwe extreme values), uye ziva ruzivo rwakawedzerwa runodiwa.
n-m-h2-diff-10.material: Derivative ye cubic function f(x) inozivikanwa se f'(x)=3x²−12. Tinoda kuwana local maximum value ye f, asi hatizive f(x) pachayo. (3x² zvinoreva ka3 x square.)
n-m-h2-diff-10.thinking.1: Kutonga kuti ruzivo rwakawedzerwa runobatsira zvakadini
n-m-h2-diff-10.thinking.2: Kushandisa ruzivo kuwana local maximum value
n-m-h2-diff-10.prereq.0: Chiratidzo che derivative ne local maxima ne minima
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza zvidimbu zvose zveruzivo zvekuti, kana ukaziva chimwe chazvo pamwe chete, unogona kusarudza local maximum value ye f.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s1.hint.0: Kubva ku f'(x), nyora kuti f(x) ine chimiro chei. Pane chikamu chisina kusarudzwa here?
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s1.hint.1: Tarisa, sarudzo imwe panguva imwe, kana inosarudza chikamu chisina kusarudzwa ichocho.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s1.r.a: Kana uchiziva mutengo wefunction mumwe, constant term inosarudzwa, saka f yose inosarudzwa.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s1.r.d: Kana uchiziva mutengo wefunction mumwe, constant term inosarudzwa, saka f yose inosarudzwa.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s1.r.b: Mutengo uyu unogona kutowanikwa nekuisa x=1 mu f'(x)=3x²−12, saka hazvisi ruzivo rutsva.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s1.r.c: Ruzivo urwu runogonawo kutowanikwa kubva pa f'(x)=3x²−12 oga, saka hazvisi ruzivo rutsva.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s1.explain: Kana f'(x)=3x²−12, ipapo f(x)=x³−12x+C (C i constant). Ma x-coordinates e local maximum ne minimum (x=−2, 2) anosarudzwa, asi local maximum value f(−2)=16+C inosarudzwa chete kana C yasarudzwa. Kusarudza C, unoda mutengo we f (function value). Ruzivo nezve derivative i rwakafanana neruzivo watinatoruva.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s2.prompt: Unopiwa ruzivo rwakawedzerwa rwekuti local minimum value ye f i −10. Wana local maximum value ye f uye unyore kuti wakaiwana sei.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s2.hint.0: Shandisa chiratidzo che derivative kusarudza kuti local minimum inoitika pamutengo upi we x.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s2.hint.1: Isa x iyoyo mufomula ye f(x) uye useta equation mu constant C.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakatanga wawana mitengo ye x apo local maximum ne minimum zvinoitika here?
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakashandisa local minimum value kusarudza constant term here?
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s2.model.0: Tinogona kunyora f(x)=x³−12x+C (C i constant). Local minimum i pa x=2, uye f(2)=C−16=−10, saka C=6. Local maximum i pa x=−2, uye f(−2)=16+C=22.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s2.model.1: Kuita integrate f' hakusarudze constant term, asi kushandisa chokwadi chekuti local minimum value i −10 kunosarudza constant term se 6. Local maximum inoitika pa x=−2, uye f(−2)=−8+24+6=22.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s3.prompt: Ma cubic functions maviri f ne g ane derivative imwechete, uye f(0)−g(0)=6. Local maximum value ye f bvisa local maximum value ye g i chii?
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s3.hint.0: Kana f'=g', nyora zvinoitika kana ukasiyanisa f(x)−g(x).
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s3.hint.1: Funga kana musiyano uyu unochinja ne x kana i constant.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s3.r.a: Wakafungidzira kuti ma derivatives akaenzana anoreva ma local maximum values akaenzana. Kana ma constant terms akasiyana, hukuru hwe extreme values hunosiyanawo.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s3.r.c: Wakawedzera musiyano wema constant terms kaviri. Pa local maximum, musiyano wacho uchiri 6.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s3.r.d: Inogona kusarudzwa, nekuti mutengo we f(0)−g(0) wakapiwa.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s3.explain: Kana f'=g', ipapo f(x)−g(x) i constant, uye sezvo f(0)−g(0)=6, f(x)−g(x)=6 kune x yose. Local maximum inoitika pa x imwechete kune zvose, saka musiyano wema local maximum values i 6 zvakare.

n-m-h2-diff-11.title: Kugadzira inequality inoshanda kune x>0
n-m-h2-diff-11.topic: Kuratidza inequalities: kuganhurira interval nemamiriro ekuenzana
n-m-h2-diff-11.goal: Wana minimum value uchishandisa differentiation kuvaka iwe pachako inequality inogutsa mamiriro, uye utsanangure nei kuganhurira domain kuchichinja mhedzisiro.
n-m-h2-diff-11.material: a i positive integer uye k i integer. Tinoda kusarudza a ne k kuti inequality x³+k≥3a²x igare ichishanda kune x i positive, uye kuenzana kuitike kune imwe x i positive. (3a²x zvinoreva ka3 a square x.)
n-m-h2-diff-11.thinking.0: Kushandura inequality kuita mamiriro pa minimum value ye function imwechete
n-m-h2-diff-11.thinking.2: Kutsanangura chii chinochinja kana interval ichichinja
n-m-h2-diff-11.prereq.0: Extreme values ne minimum values uchishandisa derivatives
n-m-h2-diff-11.prereq.1: Chimiro che graph ye cubic function
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s1.prompt: Kana tikatora h(x)=x³−3a²x+k, mamiriro aya anova nhaka ipi ye h(x) pa x>0?
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s1.hint.0: Taura zvakare "inequality inogara ichishanda" sechirevo nezve mutengo mudiki zvikuru we h(x).
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s1.hint.1: "Kune x apo kuenzana kunoitika" kunoti chii nezve mutengo mudiki iwoyo?
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s1.r.a: Kana maximum value i 0, ipapo h(x)≤0, saka inequality inoenda nenzira yakapesana.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s1.r.b: Ipapo kune x ine h(x)<0, saka inequality inokundikana.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s1.r.c: Izvo zvinotarisa nhaka ye h', kwete ye h. Inequality i nezve mitengo ye h.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s1.explain: Kuti h(x)≥0 igare ichishanda pa x>0, minimum value inofanira kuva 0 kana kupfuura, uye kuti pave ne x apo kuenzana kunoitika, minimum value inofanira kuva 0 chaizvo.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.prompt: Isa mapeya matatu (a, k) anogutsa mamiriro, ane mitengo yakasiyana nhatu ye a. (a i integer kubva ku 1 kusvika ku 10.)
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.hint.0: Wana x i positive apo h'(x)=0, uye utarise chiratidzo che h' kumativi ose maviri ayo.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.hint.1: Nyora mutengo we h pa x iyoyo maererano ne a ne k, uye uwane k inoita kuti ive 0.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.ok.c1: a inhamba yakazara kubva ku1 kusvika ku10, uye k inhamba yakazara futi.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.fail.c1: a inofanira kuva nhamba yakazara kubva ku1 kusvika ku10, uye k inofanira kuva nhamba yakazara futi.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.ok.c2: Kukosha kwakaderera zvikuru kwe h pa x>0 i0 chaizvo.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.fail.c2: Kukosha kwakaderera zvikuru kwe h(x) pa x>0 hakusi 0.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.explain: h'(x)=3x²−3a²=3(x−a)(x+a), uye pa x>0, h inochinja kubva pakudzika kuenda pakukwira pa x=a, saka ine kukosha kwakaderera zvikuru h(a)=k−2a³. Kana kukosha uku kuri 0, inequality inogara ichishanda uye kuenzana kunoshanda pa x=a. Saka k=2a³.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.because.prompt: Tsanangura mumutsara mumwe nemumwe kuti chii chinoitika kana k iri pazasi pe2a³ nekana iri pamusoro pe2a³.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.because.hint.0: Fananidza kuti kukosha kwe h pa x=a kunochinja sei ne k, uchishandisa k=2a³ sereferensi.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.because.hint.1: Inequality kugara ichishanda nekuenzana kuchishanda zvinhu zvakasiyana.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Wakatsanangura nyaya diki nenyaya huru zvakasiyana here?
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.because.model.0: Kana k iri pazasi pe2a³, h inegative pa x=a, saka inequality inokundikana. Kana k iri pamusoro pe2a³, kukosha kwakaderera zvikuru kwakakura kupfuura 0, saka inequality inoshanda, asi hapana x apo kuenzana kunoshanda.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.because.model.1: Kana k<2a³, kukosha kwakaderera zvikuru kuri pazasi pe0, saka pane x apo inequality isingashande. Kana k>2a³, inogara ichishanda, asi kukosha kwakaderera zvikuru kwakakura kupfuura 0, saka hapana positive x apo kuenzana kunoshanda.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s3.prompt: Pane pairi (a, k) rinoita kuti inequality imwe chete x³+k≥3a²x ishande kwete kune positive x chete asi kune real x dzose here?
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s3.hint.0: Fungidzira chiratidzo che h(x) kana x i nhamba negative diki zvikuru, seye−10 kana −100.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s3.hint.1: Funga kana mhedzisiro yakaongororwa kune nhamba dzepositive chete ichiwedzerwa pachayo kunhamba dzenegative.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s3.o.a: Kwete. Kana x ichiita diki zvikuru (negative), divi rekuruboshwe rinova pazasi pe3a²x
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s3.o.b: Hongu. Ne k=2a³ yawakawana pamusoro, inoshanda kune real x dzose
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s3.r.b: Wakaongorora k=2a³ kune x>0 chete uye haina kuongorora kana ichishanda kune x<0. Inokundikana kana x i nhamba negative diki zvikuru.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s3.o.c: Hongu. Kana ukasarudza k huru zvakakwana, inoshanda kune real numbers dzose
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s3.r.c: Kana x ichiita diki zvikuru (negative), x³ inodzikira nekukurumidza zvikuru kupfuura k, saka inokundikana pasinei nekuti wakaita k huru zvakadini.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s3.o.d: Kwete. Kana ukaisa x=0, inequality inotoshaya kushanda
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s3.r.d: Kana x=0, tinoda k≥0, uye sezvo k=2a³>0, inoshanda.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s3.explain: h(x)=x³−3a²x+k inoenda ku −∞ kana x ichiramba ichiita negative. Saka kunyange wakasarudza k sei, pane x dzine h(x)<0. Nokuti takaganhurira kune positive x, pairi (a, k) rinogutsa mamiriro rakavapo.

n-m-h2-explog-01.title: Kuongorora chigadziriso chakaverenga square root uchishandisa mitemo yeexponents
n-m-h2-explog-01.goal: Tsvaga mutsara wekutanga unoenda kwakaipa muchigadziriso chinoshandisa mitemo yeexponents, uye uongorore mamiriro apo mutemo iwoyo unogona kushandiswa kuwana kukosha kwakarurama.
n-m-h2-explog-01.material: Hayun akawana kukosha kwe √((−3)²) achishandisa mitemo yeexponents. ((−3)² isquare ye−3, uye kukwidza kumupowers 1/2 kunoreva zvakafanana nekutora square root. Ngatibvumirane kuti fractional exponent inotsanangurwa chete kana base iri positive.)
n-m-h2-explog-01.thinking.0: Kutevera chigadziriso kusvika kumugumo uye kuwana mutsara wekutanga unoenda kwakaipa
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsara wekutanga usina kururama muchigadziriso chaHayun.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s1.hint.0: Tanga mukati memabhurakiti, verenga kukosha zvakananga kutanga, uye ufananidze nemhedzisiro yekupedzisira yaHayun.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s1.hint.1: Famba mitsara imwe nenguva uye utarise kuti makoshero maviri anotanga kusiyana pamutsara upi.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s1.explain: Mutsara 2 ndiwo wekutanga unoenda kwakaipa. (a^m)^n=a^(mn) ine fractional exponent mutemo webase ipositive, asi base −3 inegative. Chaizvo, ((−3)²)^(1/2)=9^(1/2)=3. Mitsara 3 ne4 kuverenga kunotevera mutsara 2.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s2.prompt: Nyora kukosha kwakarurama, uye ushandise chiratidzo chebase kutsanangura kuti nei mutsara umo Hayun akashandisa mutemo weexponents wakanga usingagone kushandiswa.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s2.hint.0: Verenga (−3)² kutanga, wobva wakwidza kukosha iko kumupowers 1/2.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s2.hint.1: Verenga zvakare chibvumirano chekuti base yaifanira kuva nhamba yemhando ipi kana uchishandisa mutemo.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakatanga wawana (−3)²=9 wobva wawana kukosha 3 here?
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakataura kuti mutemo weexponents unogona kushandiswa chete kana base iri positive here?
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Unogona kutaura kuti nei −3 yaHayun isingagoneki sekukosha kwesquare root here?
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s2.model.0: √((−3)²)=√9=3. (a^m)^n=a^(mn) kune fractional exponents inogona kushandiswa chete kana base iri positive, asi pano base −3 inegative, saka haina kugona kushandiswa, uye kuishandisa zvakadaro kunopa kukosha kwakaipa −3.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s2.model.1: Kutanga, (−3)²=9, uye positive square root ye9 i3, saka kukosha i3. Hayun akashandisa mutemo kunyange base iri negative, saka chiratidzo chakabuda chakasiyana.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s2.model.2: Mhinduro: 3. Chiratidzo chesquare root chinopa kukosha kwe0 kana kupfuura, saka hachigoni kuva −3. Dambudziko ndiro kuti mutemo wefractional exponents wakashandiswa panhamba ine base negative.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s3.prompt: Sarudza dzose (a, m, n) dzinoita kuti mativi ose maviri e (a^m)^n=a^(mn) atsanangurwe uye ave nekukosha kumwe chete.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s3.hint.0: Kune sarudzo imwe neimwe, verenga divi rekuruboshwe nedivi rekurudyi zvakasiyana, uye utanga watarisa kuti ose ane makoshero.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s3.hint.1: Kana ose ane makoshero, fananidza kana akaenzana. Funga zvakasiyana nyaya apo exponent iri integer nenyaya apo iri fraction.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s3.r.a: Divi rekuruboshwe ((−3)²)^(1/2) i3, uye divi rekurudyi (−3)^1 i−3. Pane fractional exponent, saka mutemo haushande.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s3.r.b: Wakasiya kuti kana maexponents ari integers kumativi ose maviri mutemo unoshanda kunyange base iri negative. Mativi ose maviri i729.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s3.r.c: Wakasiya kuti kana base iri positive, mutemo unoshanda kunyange nefractional exponents. Mativi ose maviri i25.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s3.r.d: Divi rekuruboshwe (−4)^(1/2) harina kutsanangurwa. Unofanira kutanga waongorora kana mativi ose maviri atsanangurwa.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s3.r.e: Wakasiya kuti negative exponent iinteger exponent futi, saka mutemo unoshanda. Mativi ose maviri i1/64.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s3.explain: (−3, 2, 3) inoshanda nokuti 9³=729=(−3)⁶, (5, 1/2, 4) inoshanda nokuti (√5)⁴=25=5², uye (−2, 3, −2) inoshanda nokuti (−8)^(−2)=1/64=(−2)^(−6). Kune (−3, 2, 1/2), makoshero akasiyana, 3 ne−3, uye kune (−4, 1/2, 2), divi rekuruboshwe harina kutsanangurwa. Musiyano mukuru ndewekuti integer exponents dzinogona kushandiswa kana base isiri 0, uye fractional exponents dzinogona kushandiswa kana base iri positive.

n-m-h2-explog-02.title: Makoshero e x apo logarithm ine mabhii mubase nemuargument yakatsanangurwa
n-m-h2-explog-02.goal: Tsvaga iwe pachako makoshero e x apo logarithm ine x mubase nemuargument zvose inonzwisisika, uye urongedze mamiriro imwe nenguva kuwana range ye x.
n-m-h2-explog-02.material: Logarithm log_a N ine kukosha chete kana base a neargument N zvichigutsa mamiriro akati. Panguva ino, tarisa mutauro log_{x−1}(5−x), une x mubase nemuargument zvose. (Base i x−1 uye argument i 5−x.)
n-m-h2-explog-02.thinking.1: Kurongedza kuti nei makoshero akakundikana asingabvumirwi
n-m-h2-explog-02.thinking.2: Kubatanidza mamiriro awakawana kuita range imwe chete
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s1.prompt: Tsvaga uye uise makoshero matatu akasiyana e x apo log_{x−1}(5−x) ine kukosha. (Madecimal akanaka.)
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s1.hint.0: Isa kukosha kwe x uye unyore kuti base x−1 neargument 5−x zvinova chii imwe neimwe.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s1.hint.1: Tarisa zvose kuti base neargument ndiwo makoshero anobvumirwa netsanangudzo yelogarithm. Kana ukawana kukosha kusingabvumirwi, nyora kuti chii chakakonzera.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s1.fail.c2: Base x−1 i1. Base haigoni kuva 1.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s1.explain: Semuenzaniso, x=3 inopa log_2 2, x=4 inopa log_3 1, uye x=1.5 inopa log_{0.5} 3.5; muimwe neimwe, base ipositive uye isiri 1, uye argument ipositive. x=2 haibvumirwi nokuti base i1, x=0 nokuti base inegative, uye x=5 nokuti argument i0.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s2.prompt: Sarudza chikonzero chakarurama chekuti nei log_{x−1}(5−x) isina kukosha kana x=2.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s2.hint.0: Isa x=2 mubase x−1 nemuargument 5−x uye unyore kukosha kwega kwega.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s2.hint.1: Nyora zvakasiyana makoshero asingagone kuva base nemakoshero asingagone kuva argument, uye uafananidze nemakoshero aya.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s2.r.b: Kana x=2, x−1 haisi negative. Isa kukosha uone.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s2.r.c: Kana x=2, 5−x i3. Isa kukosha uone.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s2.r.d: Kana x=2, 5−x haisi negative. Isa kukosha uone.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s2.explain: Kana x=2, base i1 uye argument i3. 1 yakakwidzwa kumupowers upi zvawo i1, saka haigoni kuva 3, zvinoreva kuti log_1 3 haina kukosha. Ndosaka base isingafaniri kuva 1.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s3.prompt: Nyora range ye x apo log_{x−1}(5−x) inonzwisisika.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s3.hint.0: Nyora mamiriro maviri ebase nemamiriro mamwe ega eargument zvakasiyana seinequalities.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s3.hint.1: Dhirowa mamiriro matatu panumber line, tsvaga apo anoyambukirana, uye pakupedzisira tarisa kuti hapana kukosha kunoshaikwa pakuyambukirana.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakanyora mamiriro ose maviri ebase here?
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Wakarangarira poinzi yakabviswa mukutaura range here?
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s3.model.0: Kubva pamamiriro ebase x−1>0 ne x−1≠1, x>1 ne x≠2. Kubva pamamiriro eargument 5−x>0, x<5. Saka 1<x<5 ne x≠2.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s3.model.1: x inofanira kuva huru kupfuura 1 uye diki kupfuura 5, asi 2 inofanira kusiiwa. Izvi nokuti kuisa 2 kunoita kuti base ive 1.

n-m-h2-explog-03.title: Chirevo che 'log x²=2 log x' chinogara chakarurama
n-m-h2-explog-03.goal: Ongorora range umo chivakwa chelogarithms chinoshanda, tsvaga counterexample kuchirevo, uye ugadzirise mutauro kana uwedzere mamiriro.
n-m-h2-explog-03.material: Mina akataura izvi: "log x²=2 log x chivakwa chelogarithms, saka inoshanda kune x ipi zvayo." (log icommon logarithm.)
n-m-h2-explog-03.thinking.1: Kufananidza marange apo mativi ose maviri akatsanangurwa
n-m-h2-explog-03.prereq.0: Chivakwa chelogarithms log a^n=n log a
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza x pakati pezvinotevera inoratidza kuti chirevo chaMina hachirurami.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s1.hint.0: Kune x imwe neimwe, verenga divi rekuruboshwe log x² nedivi rekurudyi 2 log x zvakasiyana, uye utanga watarisa kuti ose ane makoshero.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s1.hint.1: Kana makoshero ose maviri aripo, fananidza kana akaenzana. Tarisawo kana divi rimwe risina kukosha.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s1.r.a: log 100²=4 ne2 log 100=4, dzakaenzana, saka haisi counterexample.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s1.r.b: Wakawana nyaya apo divi rekuruboshwe rine kukosha asi divi rekurudyi harina kutsanangurwa nokuti argument yaro inegative.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s1.r.c: Kunyange kana x iri pazasi pe1, log 0.01=−2 ne2 log 0.1=−2 dzakaenzana. Logarithm kuva negative kwakasiyana nekusatsanangurwa.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s1.r.d: Mativi ose maviri akaenzana ne0, saka haisi counterexample.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s1.explain: Kana x=−10, divi rekuruboshwe log (−10)²=log 100=2 rine kukosha, asi divi rekurudyi 2 log (−10) harina kutsanangurwa nokuti argument inegative. Saka hatigoni kutaura kuti mitauro miviri yakaenzana.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s2.prompt: Gadzirisa mutauro waMina, kana uunyore nemamiriro pa x apo unoshanda, uye unyore kuti nei uchiugadzirisa nenzira iyoyo.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s2.hint.0: Fananidza zviratidzo zveargument kumativi ekuruboshwe nekurudyi kana x ipositive nekana x inegative.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s2.hint.1: Tarisa kuti argument yekuruboshwe x² inotora kukosha kupi kunyange kana x iri negative, uye utsvage nhamba ipositive inogona kushandiswa kurudyi panzvimbo ye x.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakaongorora kana divi rekurudyi rakatsanangurwa kana x iri negative here?
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakaongorora nekukosha kumwe chete kuti mutauro wako wakagadziriswa unoshandawo kana x iri negative here?
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s2.model.0: Unofanira kugadziriswa kuita log x²=2 log|x| (x≠0). Kana x iri negative, log x haina kutsanangurwa, asi x² ipositive, saka log x² yakatsanangurwa.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s2.model.1: log x²=2 log x inoshanda chete kana x>0. Kana x iri negative, argument yekurudyi inegative, saka haina kukosha.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s2.model.2: Kana x isiri 0, log x² = 2 log|x|. Kana ukashandisa absolute value, argument inogara iri positive.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s3.prompt: Sarudza range ye x apo log (x−1)²=2 log (x−1) inoshanda.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s3.hint.0: Tsvaga x dzinoita kuti divi rekuruboshwe ritsanangurwe uye x dzinoita kuti divi rekurudyi ritsanangurwe.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s3.hint.1: Pakati pe x dzose apo mativi ose maviri akatsanangurwa, tsvaga range apo mitauro inopa kukosha kumwe chete chaizvo.
