n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s3.r.a: Inosanganisirawo range apo divi rekurudyi ritsanangurwa.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s3.r.b: Divi rekuruboshwe ritsanangurwa kune x≠1, asi divi rekurudyi harina kutsanangurwa kune x<1.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s3.r.d: Kana x<1, argument x−1 yekurudyi inegative, saka haina kutsanangurwa.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s3.explain: Divi rekurudyi 2 log (x−1) rinotsanangurwa chete kana x−1>0, ndiko kuti, x>1, uye munyaya iyoyo rinoenzana nedivi rekuruboshwe. Kune x<1 divi rekurudyi haripo, saka hatigoni kutaura kuti akaenzana.

n-m-h2-explog-04.title: Ndeipi huru, log₂3 kana log₃4?
n-m-h2-explog-04.goal: Gadzirisa kutonga kwako nezvehukuru hwemalogarithms kana uchiwana ruzivo rwakawanda, uye ufananidze malogarithms maviri pasina calculator uchishandisa benchmark yepakati.
n-m-h2-explog-04.material: Pasina calculator, tinoda kuziva kuti ndeipi huru, log_2 3 kana log_3 4. Ruzivo runoratidzwa chidimbu nechidimbu. (log_2 3 ilogarithm ye3 ine base 2.)
n-m-h2-explog-04.thinking.1: Kushandura kutonga kwako zvichienderana neruzivo rutsva
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.prompt: Padanho rimwe nerimwe, sarudza kutonga kunovakirwa pane zvaunoziva izvozvi chete.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.hint.0: Nguva imwe neimwe ruzivo rutsva rwuchioneka, funga kuti uchengete kana kuchinja kutonga kwako.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.hint.1: Kana base ne argument zvose zvakasiyana, funga kuti zvinobvumirwa here kutonga uchitarisa imwe chete yazvo.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.0.info: log_2 3 ndiyo x inogutsa 2^x=3, uye log_3 4 ndiyo x inogutsa 3^x=4. Sezvo 2<3<4, log_2 3 iri pakati pe1 ne2, uye sezvo 3<4<9, log_3 4 iri pakati pe1 ne2 zvakare.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Kuziva chete kuti dzose dziri pakati pe1 ne2 hakutibvumiri kusarudza kurongeka. Tinoda benchmark yepakati inonyatsorurama zvakanyanya.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.0.o.a: log_2 3: base idiki, saka pamwe ichada exponent huru kuti isvike pa3
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Wakashandisa intuition yekuti kana base iri diki, exponent inofanira kuva huru. Ihanho rakanaka mberi, asi harisati rasimbiswa.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.0.o.b: log_3 4: argument 4 yakakura kupfuura 3, saka pamwe logarithm ichava huru
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Wakatarisa argument chete. Wakarasikirwa nechokwadi chekuti base inochinjawo.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Hapana chokwadi zvino: tinongoziva kuti dzose dziri pakati pe1 ne2
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Uku ndiko kutonga kwekuti benchmark inonyatsorurama zvakanyanya inodiwa.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.1.info: Ngatiyerei nebenchmark yepakati 3/2. 2^(3/2)=√8≈2.83 idiki kupfuura 3, saka log_2 3 yakakura kupfuura 3/2. 3^(3/2)=√27≈5.20 yakakura kupfuura 4, saka log_3 4 idiki kupfuura 3/2.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Wakatonga zvakapesana neruzivo rutsva. Tarisa zvakare kuti ndeipi yakakura kupfuura 3/2.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Wakaparadzanisa makosha maviri ne3/2 ichiri pakati pawo.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Makosha maviri ari kumativi akasiyana e 3/2, saka haagoni kuenzana.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.2.info: Uchifungidzira nenzira imwe chete, log_2 3≈1.585, log_3 4≈1.262, log_4 5≈1.161, uye log_5 6≈1.113.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: log_n(n+1) inochinja sei kana n ichikura?
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Sezvo n+1>n, log_n(n+1) inogara iri huru kupfuura 1, uye kukosha kwayo kunova kudiki uye kusvika padhuze ne1.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Inova diki, asi haidzikiri pasi pe1
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Wakatarisa mutsara wemakosha nechokwadi chekuti argument yakakura kupfuura base.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Inova diki uye pakupedzisira inodzika pasi pe1
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Kana argument iri huru kupfuura base, logarithm inogara iri huru kupfuura 1.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.reflect: Pakutanga hatina kugona kusarudza nekuti dzose dziri pakati pe1 ne2, asi kana taisa benchmark yepakati 3/2, kurongeka kwakatarwa. Kana nhamba mbiri dzichiita sedzakasiyana, tsvaga nhamba yekutarisa inogona kuiswa pakati pazvo uye uienzanise nemumwe nemumwe.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s2.prompt: Ratidza, uchishandisa 3/2 uye pasina calculator, kuti log_2 3>log_3 4.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s2.hint.0: Unogona kutonga hukuru hwe log_2 3 zvichienzaniswa ne3/2 nekuenzanisa ma power maviri e2. Isa 2^(3/2) ne3 pa exponent imwe chete.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s2.hint.1: Nenzira imwe chete, enzanisa log_3 4 ne3/2. Ita square mativi ose maviri uye uenzanise ma integer.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakaratidza here kuti nei log_2 3 yakakura kupfuura 3/2 nekuenzanisa ma integer?
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakaratidzawo here kuti nei log_3 4 idiki kupfuura 3/2?
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Wakabatanidza here mhedzisiro mbiri uye wakapedzisa log_2 3>3/2>log_3 4?
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s2.model.0: 2^(3/2)=√8 idiki kupfuura 3, saka log_2 3>3/2, uye 3^(3/2)=√27 yakakura kupfuura 4, saka log_3 4<3/2. Saka log_2 3>3/2>log_3 4.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s2.model.1: Enzanisa nekuita square mativi ose maviri. Sezvo 3^2=9>8=2^3, log_2 3>3/2, uye sezvo 4^2=16<27=3^3, log_3 4<3/2. Saka log_2 3 yakakura.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s2.model.2: Kuenzanisa log_2 3 ne1.5: 2^3=8<9=3^2, saka yakakura kupfuura 1.5. Kune log_3 4, 3^3=27>16=4^2, saka idiki kupfuura 1.5. Saka yekutanga yakakura.

n-m-h2-explog-06.title: Kugadzira exponential function y=aˣ+b kuti ienderane nemamiriro akapiwa
n-m-h2-explog-06.goal: Gadzira iwe pachako exponential function ine graph inopfuura papoinzi uye inosangana ne x-axis, uye utonge mamiriro uchishandisa nzvimbo ye asymptote ne x-intercept.
n-m-h2-explog-06.material: Ngatigadzireyi graph ye y=a^x+b (a inatural number kubva ku2 kusvika ku10, uye b iinteger). Tinotonga tichishandisa fomula nemamiriro chete, pasina kudhirowa mufananidzo.
n-m-h2-explog-06.thinking.0: Kugadzira fomula inogutsa mamiriro iwe pachako
n-m-h2-explog-06.thinking.1: Kutsvaga muenzaniso unopfuura papoinzi asi unoputsa rimwe mamiriro
n-m-h2-explog-06.thinking.2: Kurongedza hukama pakati pe asymptote ne x-intercept
n-m-h2-explog-06.prereq.0: Graph ne asymptote ye exponential function y=a^x
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.prompt: Isa mapeya maviri akasiyana (a, b) akadai kuti graph ye y=a^x+b inopfuura papoinzi (2, 7) uye inosangana ne x-axis.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora mamiriro ekupfuura papoinzi (2, 7) se equation uye utsvage hukama pakati pe a ne b.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.hint.1: Sarudza a, tsvaga b, wobva watarisa kuti graph iyoyo inosangana ne x-axis here. Kana isingasangani, chinja a.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.ok.c1: a inatural number kubva ku2 kusvika ku10.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.fail.c1: a inofanira kuva natural number kubva ku2 kusvika ku10.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.ok.c4: Asymptote y=b iri pasi pe x-axis, saka graph inosangana ne x-axis.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.fail.c4: Graph haisangani ne x-axis. Tarisa nzvimbo ye asymptote y=b ne graph.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.explain: Kubva ku a²+b=7, b=7−a². Semuenzaniso, a=3 inopa b=−2 uye a=4 inopa b=−9; kana b<0, asymptote y=b iri pasi pe x-axis, saka graph inosangana ne x-axis. Ne a=2, b=3, saka graph inopfuura papoinzi (2, 7) asi iri pamusoro pe y=3 chete.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.because.prompt: Graph yakagadzirwa ne a=2, b=3 inopfuura papoinzi (2, 7) asi haigutsi mamiriro. Nyora chikonzero.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.because.hint.0: Tarisa asymptote ye graph iyi uye kuti graph iri pamusoro kana pasi payo.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.because.hint.1: Tsvaga renji yemakosha anogona kutorwa ne y=2^x+3, uchitanga ne renji ye 2^x.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.because.selfAssess.0: Wakataura here kuti kukosha kwe y kunogara kuri kukuru kupfuura 3?
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.because.selfAssess.1: Wakataura here kuti, saka, y haigoni kuva 0?
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.because.model.0: 2^x inogara iri positive, saka 2^x+3 inogara iri huru kupfuura 3. Saka y haigoni kuva 0, uye graph haisangani ne x-axis.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.because.model.1: Asymptote ye graph iyi ndi y=3, uye graph iri pamusoro payo chete. Saka haisangani ne x-axis.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.because.model.2: y=2^x+3 inogara ichitora makosha akakura kupfuura 3, saka haimbosvika pa x-axis.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s2.prompt: Kune a>1, sarudza mamiriro e b ekuti graph ye y=a^x+b isangane ne x-axis.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s2.hint.0: Kutanga nyora renji ye a^x, wobva watsvaga kuti renji ye y inova chii kana ukawedzera b pairi.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s2.hint.1: Funga kuti b inofanira kuva chii kuti 0 ive mukati merenji iyoyo.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s2.r.a: Kana b=0, ipapo y=a^x, iyo inogara iri positive, saka haisangani ne x-axis.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s2.r.b: Kana b iri positive, graph iri pamusoro pe b, saka haisangani ne x-axis.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s2.r.c: Inosanganisirawo nyaya apo b iri positive. Tarisa nyaya apo asymptote iri pamusoro pe x-axis.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s2.r.d: Wakaziva kuti makosha e y=a^x+b ose ndemakosha akakura kupfuura b, saka b inofanira kuva negative kuti 0 ibatanidzwe.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s2.explain: Makosha e a^x ose ndema real number akakura kupfuura 0, saka makosha e a^x+b ose ndema real number akakura kupfuura b. Kuti 0 ive mu renji iyi, b<0 inodiwa. Izvi zvinoreva kuti asymptote y=b iri pasi pe x-axis.

n-m-h2-explog-08.title: Kuongorora mhinduro yakashandisa common logarithms kuverenga nhamba dzenhamba
n-m-h2-explog-08.goal: Tsvaga mutsetse wakanganisa mumhinduro inoshandisa common logarithms kuwana huwandu hwenhamba, uye utarise kuti huwandu hwenhamba hunoshanduka sei pamakosha emuganho.
n-m-h2-explog-08.material: Seoyeon akashandisa common logarithms kuwana kuti 3^50 ine nhamba dzingani. (log 3=0.4771, uye 3^50 ndi 3 kusimba rechi 50.)
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsetse wekutanga wakanganisa mumhinduro yaSeoyeon.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s1.hint.0: Tarisa nenhamba diki. 10^2=100 ine nhamba dzingani?
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s1.hint.1: Enzanisa mhedzisiro iyoyo padivi pechikamu chenhamba yakazara yelogarithm, uye utarise kana mhedziso ye 4 yaSeoyeon yakarurama.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s1.line.0: Kuwana huwandu hwenhamba dze 3^50, tora common logarithm yemativi ese maviri.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s1.line.3: Sezvo 10^23≤3^50<10^24, chikamu chenhamba yakazara 23 ndihwo huwandu hwenhamba.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s1.explain: Mutsetse 4 ndiwo unotanga kukanganisa. 10^23 ndi 1 inotevedzwa nema zero 23, une nhamba 24. Saka N ine 10^23≤N<10^24 ine nhamba 24, uye unofanira kuwedzera 1 kuchikamu chenhamba yakazara 23 kuti uwane huwandu hwenhamba. Mutsetse 5 ndiyo mhedzisiro inotevera kubva pamutsetse 4.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s2.prompt: Nyora huwandu hwakarurama hwenhamba dze 3^50, uye unyore kutonga kwaSeoyeon kupi kunofanira kugadziriswa uye sei.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora huwandu hwenhamba dze 10^1, 10^2, 10^3 uye uwane musiyano pakati pe exponent nehuwandu hwenhamba.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s2.hint.1: Shandisa muenzaniso wawakawana ku N ine log N=23.855.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakataura here kuti 1 inofanira kuwedzerwa kuchikamu chenhamba yakazara?
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Wakataura here kuti N ine nhamba mbiri here kana N iri 10^23 kana kupfuura uye iri pasi pe 10^24?
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s2.model.0: Sezvo log 3^50=23.855, 10^23≤3^50<10^24. 10^23 ine nhamba 24, saka 3^50 ine nhamba 24. Unofanira kuwedzera 1 kuchikamu chenhamba yakazara 23.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s2.model.1: 10 kusimba rechi 23 ine nhamba 24, saka 3^50 inewo nhamba 24. Seoyeon akanyora chikamu chenhamba yakazara zvakananga sehuwandu hwenhamba, asi aifanira kuwedzera 1.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s2.model.2: Chikamu chenhamba yakazara ndi 23, uye huwandu hwenhamba ndi 23+1=24.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s3.prompt: Pakati penhamba dzakanaka N dzine common logarithms dzakapiwa pazasi, sarudza dzese dzine nhamba 8.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s3.hint.0: Nyora N imwe neimwe sehuwandu pakati pemasimba e 10. Semuenzaniso, kana log N=7.2, iri pakati pemasimba api maviri?
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s3.hint.1: Kana logarithm iri nhamba yakazara, nyora chaizvo kuti N isimba rei re 10, uye uverenge nhamba.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s3.r.a: Waiziva kuti kana logarithm iri nhamba yakazara, N=10^7, ine nhamba 8.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s3.r.b: N=10^8 ine nhamba 9. Kana chikamu chenhamba yakazara chiri 8, huwandu hwenhamba ndi 9.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s3.r.c: Uku ndiko kutonga kwekuwedzera 1 kuchikamu chenhamba yakazara 7 kuwana nhamba 8.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s3.r.d: 6.99 ine chikamu chenhamba yakazara 6, saka ine nhamba 7. Kuva padyo ne 7 kwakasiyana nekuva 7 kana kupfuura.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s3.explain: Kana chikamu chenhamba yakazara che log N ndi n, saka N ine nhamba n+1. Kana log N=7.0, saka N=10^7, ine nhamba 8, uye kana iri 7.2, saka 10^7≤N<10^8, saka ine nhamba 8. 6.99 inopa nhamba 7 uye 8.0 inopa nhamba 9.

n-m-h2-explog-10.title: Kutsvaga maviri akanaka apo log(a+b)=log a+log b inoshanda
n-m-h2-explog-10.goal: Tarisa nekugadzira mienzaniso iwe pachako kana chokwadi chakajairika chokuti "logarithm yehuwandu haisi huwandu hwema logarithm" chine zvakasiyana, uye urongedze mamiriro seformula.
n-m-h2-explog-10.material: log(a+b)=log a+log b iequation inowanzova isingashande. Asi pakati penhamba dzakanaka a ne b, pane maviri apo inoshanda here? (log ndiyo common logarithm.)
n-m-h2-explog-10.thinking.0: Kugadzira mienzaniso apo inoshanda iwe pachako
n-m-h2-explog-10.thinking.1: Kushandura huwandu hwema logarithm kuva logarithm yechibereko
n-m-h2-explog-10.prereq.0: Chimiro chema logarithm log a+log b=log ab
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.prompt: Nyora maviri matatu akasiyana enhamba dzakanaka a, b apo log(a+b)=log a+log b inoshanda. (Maviri ane a ne b dzakachinjaniswa anoverengwa semaviri akafanana. Ma decimal anobvumirwa.)
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.hint.0: Batanidza huwandu hwema logarithm kurutivi rwekurudyi kuva logarithm imwe uye uienzanise nedivi rekuruboshwe.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.hint.1: Nyora kuti ma argument anofanira kuva chii kana ma logarithm maviri akaenzana, wobva wasarudza a uye uwane b.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.fail.c1: a ne b dzinofanira kuva dzakanaka dzese.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.ok.c2: a+b ne ab zvakaenzana, saka log(a+b)=log a+log b inoshanda.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.fail.c2: a+b ne ab zvakasiyana, saka ma logarithm maviri haaenzani.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.explain: Sezvo log a+log b=log ab, equation inoshanda kana log(a+b)=log ab, kureva, kana a+b=ab. (2, 2), (3, 1.5), ne (5, 1.25) dzese dzinoshanda. Takashandisa chokwadi chokuti ma logarithm maviri akaenzana kana ma argument awo akaenzana chete.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.because.prompt: Nyora seformula hukama pakati pe a ne b hunoshanda mumaviri awakawana, uye unyore kuti sei hukama uhwo hunoita kuti zvirevo zviviri zvienzane.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.because.hint.0: Kune maviri ega ega awakawana, verenga a+b ne ab uye uzvinyore padivi pedzimwe.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.because.hint.1: Batanidza log a+log b kuva logarithm imwe uye unyore kuti argument ndeyei.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.because.selfAssess.0: Wakanyora here log a+log b=log ab?
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.because.selfAssess.1: Wakataura here kuti kana ma logarithm akaenzana, ma argument akaenzana?
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.because.model.0: Sezvo log a+log b=log ab, kuti log(a+b)=log ab tinoda a+b=ab. Izvi nokuti kana ma logarithm maviri akaenzana, ma argument awo akaenzana.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.because.model.1: Huwandu nechibereko che a ne b zvinofanira kuenzana (ab=a+b). Izvi nokuti huwandu hwema logarithm hwakaenzana nelogarithm yechibereko chema argument, uye kana ma logarithm akaenzana, ma argument awo akaenzana.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.because.model.2: Zvinokwana kuti (a−1)(b−1)=1. Kuwedzera kunopa ab−a−b+1=1, saka ab=a+b, uye log a+log b=log ab=log(a+b).
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s2.prompt: Sarudza chirevo chakarurama pamusoro penhamba dzakanaka a, b apo log(a+b)=log a+log b inoshanda.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s2.hint.0: Kana a iri 1 kana pasi, tora b seyakanaka uye uenzanise kuti ab kana a+b ndiyo huru.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s2.hint.1: Pakati pemaviri anosangana ne a+b=ab, enzanisa saizi dze a ne b.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s2.o.a: Imwe pa a ne b inogona kuva pasi pe 1
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s2.r.a: Kana a≤1, saka ab≤b<a+b, saka a+b haigoni kuenzana ne ab.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s2.o.b: a ne b zvese zvakakura kupfuura 1
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s2.r.b: Waiziva kuti kana a≤1 kana b≤1, chibereko chinova chidiki kupfuura huwandu, saka hazvigoni kuenzana.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s2.o.c: a ne b zvese ziri pasi pe 1
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s2.r.c: Kana zvese zviri pasi pe 1, chibereko chidiki zvikuru kupfuura huwandu.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s2.o.d: Imwe pa a ne b inofanira kuva 2
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s2.explain: Kana a≤1, saka ab≤b<a+b, saka a+b haigoni kuenzana ne ab. Zvakafanana kana b≤1. Saka mumaviri anoshanda, a ne b zvese zvakakura kupfuura 1. Sezvo (a−1)(b−1)=1, kana imwe ichiswedera padyo ne 1, imwe inova huru.

n-m-h2-limit-01.title: Tinoda kuziva chii kuti titaure kuti function icontinuous?
n-m-h2-limit-01.topic: Ma limit nekuenderera kwema function: mamiriro e continuity
n-m-h2-limit-01.goal: Ronga ruzivo rupi rwunodiwa uye rwunokwana kuita mhedziso yekuti function icontinuous pa x=a, sarudza iwe pachako kuti function icontinuous here, uye ronga chiyero ichocho nemashoko ako pachako.
n-m-h2-limit-01.material: Tinoda kuziva kuti function f icontinuous pa x=1 here. Left-hand limit ndiko kukosha kunosvikwa ne f(x) kana x ichisvika ku1 kubva kudivi apo x iri pasi pe1, uye right-hand limit ndiko kukosha kunosvikwa kubva kudivi apo x iri pamusoro pe1. Funga kuti tinogona kuita mhedziso "icontinuous" kana tichiziva chikamu cheruzivo chete here.
n-m-h2-limit-01.thinking.0: Kuparadzanisa ruzivo runotibvumira kuita mhedziso neruzivo rusingakwani
n-m-h2-limit-01.thinking.1: Kuongorora hukama pakati pe function value, left-hand limit, ne right-hand limit
n-m-h2-limit-01.prereq.1: Ruzivo rwekuparadzanisa function value nemakosha e limit
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza ruzivo rumwe chete pakati pezvinotevera nezve f runokubvumira kuva nechokwadi kuti f icontinuous pa x=1 kana uchiziva ruzivo irworwo chete.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s1.hint.0: Kutanga nyora zvaunofanira kutarisa kuti utaure kuti icontinuous, wobva wacherechedza kuti sarudzo imwe neimwe inogutsa zvose here.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s1.hint.1: Paradzanisa "kukosha kwakatsanangurwa" ne "kukosha iko kunoenzana nekukosha kwe limit" seruzivo rwakasiyana.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s1.o.a: f(1)=3, uye f(x) inosvika pa3 kana x ichisvika ku1 kubva kudivi rakakura
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s1.r.a: Wakatarisa limit yedivi rimwe chete chete. Hatisati taziva kukosha kana tichisvika kubva kune rimwe divi.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s1.o.b: f(1)=3, uye left-hand ne right-hand limit zvose zviripo uye zvakaenzana
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s1.r.b: Unoziva kuti limit iripo, asi haugoni kuziva kuti kukosha kwe limit iyoyo kunoenzana ne f(1)=3 here.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s1.o.c: f(1)=3, uye left-hand ne right-hand limit zvose ndi3
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s1.o.d: Left-hand ne right-hand limit zvose ndi3, uye f(1) yakatsanangurwa sekukosha kumwe
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s1.r.d: Kuziva chete kuti f(1) yakatsanangurwa, haugoni kuziva kuti kukosha ikoko ndi3 here.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s1.explain: Kuti pave nekuenderera, f(1) inofanira kutsanangurwa, limit kana x→1 inofanira kuvapo, uye kukosha kwe limit iyoyo kunofanira kuenzana ne f(1). Sarudzo c inogutsa zvose zvitatu. Sarudzo a ine limit yedivi rimwe chete, b haibatanidzi limit ne f(1), uye d haiziva kukosha kwe f(1), saka hatigoni kuziva kuti rinoenzana nekukosha kwe limit here.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s2.prompt: Sarudza ma function ose mana anotevera ari continuous pa x=1.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s2.hint.0: Kune function imwe neimwe, tsvaga nenzira yakarongeka function value pa x=1, left-hand limit, ne right-hand limit, uye uzvironge mutafura.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s2.hint.1: Kune fractional expression, ipfupise kune x≠1, wobva watsvaga kukosha kana x ichisvika ku1.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s2.r.b: Kana x→1, (x²−1)/(x−1)=x+1 inosvika pa2, asi f₂(1)=1, saka kukosha kwe limit nekwe function zvakasiyana.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s2.r.c: Kana pasina function value pa x=1, hatigoni kuiti continuous kunyangwe limit iripo.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s2.explain: f₁ inoenzana ne x+1 kune x≠1, saka limit yayo ndi2, uye f₁(1)=2 inosangana. Kune f₄, left-hand limit ndi2, right-hand limit ndi3·1−1=2, uye f₄(1)=2, saka zvose zvakaenzana. Kune f₂, kukosha kwe limit 2 nekwe function 1 zvakasiyana, uye f₃ haina f₃(1).
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s3.prompt: Mu s2, ma function asiri continuous akabviswa nezvikonzero zvakasiyana. Nemashoko ako pachako, ronga zvaunofanira kutarisa kuti utaure kuti function icontinuous pa x=a.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s3.hint.0: Nyora zvakare kuti f₂ ne f₃ imwe neimwe yakabviswa pachinhu chipi.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s3.hint.1: Kana zvikonzero zvekuraswa zvakasiyana, verenga kuti unofanira kutarisa zvinhu zvingani kuti uzvibvise zvose.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakataura mamiriro ose matatu pasina kusiya here?
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Zvirevo zvako zvinosanganisira zvikonzero zvekuraswa kwe f₂ ne f₃ here?
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s3.model.0: f icontinuous pa x=a kana f(a) yakatsanangurwa, limit iripo nekuti left-hand ne right-hand limit zvakaenzana kana x→a, uye limit iyoyo inoenzana ne f(a).
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s3.model.1: Kutanga, function value inofanira kuvapo. Chechipiri, limit inofanira kuvapo, zvichireva kuti ma limit kubva kumativi ose maviri akaenzana. Chechitatu, limit iyoyo inofanira kuenzana ne function value.

n-m-h2-limit-02.title: Kutarisa chirevo chekuti root iripo ne Intermediate Value Theorem
n-m-h2-limit-02.topic: Ma limit nekuenderera kwema function: Intermediate Value Theorem
n-m-h2-limit-02.goal: Kana uchishandisa Intermediate Value Theorem, usatarise zviratidzo chete: tarisa kuti mamiriro e theorem akagutswa, uye uratidze nemuenzaniso unopikisa kuti chirevo chiri chenhema.
n-m-h2-limit-02.material: Seojin aida kuziva kuti equation 1/x=0 ine real root mu interval (−1, 2) here, saka akaisa f(x)=1/x akashanda seizvi.
n-m-h2-limit-02.thinking.1: Kutsvaga mutsara apo mamiriro e theorem akashaikwa
n-m-h2-limit-02.prereq.0: Ma continuous function nechirevo che Intermediate Value Theorem
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsara wekutanga usina kururama mumhinduro yaSeojin.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s1.hint.0: Paradzanisa mutsara mumwe nemumwe kuita "kuverenga" kana "kutonga kunoshandisa theorem."
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s1.hint.1: Kune mutsara unoshandisa theorem, enzanisa mamiriro anodiwa ne theorem nezvakatariswa, rimwe nerimwe.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s1.line.0: Ngatitii f(x)=1/x. Ipapo f(−1)=−1 uye f(2)=1/2.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s1.line.2: Nemutemo weIntermediate Value Theorem, pane c pakati pe −1 ne 2 ine f(c)=0.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s1.line.3: Saka equation 1/x=0 ine mudzi chaiyo muchikamu (−1, 2).
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s1.explain: Mutsetse 3 ndiko kukanganisa kwekutanga. Intermediate Value Theorem inogona kushandiswa kana f iri continuous pachikamu chakavharwa [−1, 2] chete, asi f(x)=1/x haina kutsanangurwa pa x=0, iri mukati mechikamu ichi. Kuverenga kwomumitsetse 1 ne 2 kwakarurama, uye mutsetse 4 unongotevera mhedziso yakanganisa yomumutsetse 3.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s2.prompt: Ratidza kuti mhedziso yaSeojin yakanganisa. Nyora mamiriro ayo basa rinofanira kusangana nawo kuti Intermediate Value Theorem ishandiswe, kuti sei f(x)=1/x isingasangani nawo, uye kuti midzi chaiyo ye 1/x=0 chaizvo ndeipi.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora theorem muchimiro che "kana ..., saka ..." uye uverenge kuti mamiriro mangani anouya mushure me "kana."
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s2.hint.1: Tarisa kana domain ye f(x)=1/x ichishaya poindi ipi neipi pakati pe −1 ne 2.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakanongedza here kuti x=0 iri mukati mechikamu?
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s2.model.0: Intermediate Value Theorem inogona kushandiswa kana f iri continuous pa [−1, 2] chete. Asi f(x)=1/x haina kutsanangurwa pa x=0, saka haisi continuous. Chaizvo, hapana x inosangana ne 1/x=0, saka hapana mudzi chaiyo.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s2.model.1: Kuti ushandise theorem, basa rinofanira kuva continuous pachikamu, asi 1/x inoputsika pa x=0, saka haigoni kushandiswa. Nokuti numerator ndi 1, hapana x apo 1/x iri 0, saka equation iyi haina mhinduro.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s3.prompt: Chengeta f(−1)<0<f(2) sezvazviri. Sarudza mamiriro anofanira kuwedzerwa kuti upedze zvechokwadi kuti f(x)=0 ine mudzi muchikamu (−1, 2).
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s3.hint.0: Fungidzira kana girafu inosvetuka kana ine kutyoka mukati mechikamu ingasiya 0 pasina kupfuura napo.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s3.hint.1: Sarudza kana sarudzo imwe neimwe iri pamusoro pemagumo kana pamusoro pechikamu chose.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s3.o.a: f iri continuous pa x=−1 uye pa x=2
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s3.r.a: Kunyange f iri continuous pamagumo maviri chete, kutyoka pakati pechikamu kunogona kukuita kuti ushaye mudzi.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s3.o.b: f(−1) ne f(2) zvese ndi nhamba dzakazara
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s3.r.b: Kuti kukosha kuri nhamba yakazara hakuna chekuita nokuti mudzi uripo here.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s3.o.c: f iri continuous pachikamu chose chakavharwa [−1, 2] pamapoindi ese
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s3.o.d: f(x) haisi zero kune x yega yega muchikamu (−1, 2)
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s3.r.d: Izvi zvinoreva kuti hapana mudzi, saka chaizvo zvinopokana nemhedziso.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s3.explain: Intermediate Value Theorem inoda continuity pachikamu chose chakavharwa. Nemamiriro aya, 0 inofanira kuitika pakati pekukosha kwemagumo ane zviratidzo zvakapesana.

n-m-h2-limit-04.title: Muganho webasa rakabatanidzwa: kuongorora chirevo chaMina
n-m-h2-limit-04.topic: Miganho nekuenderera kwemabasa: muganho webasa rakabatanidzwa
n-m-h2-limit-04.goal: Uchishandisa muenzaniso, simbisa kuti muganho webasa rakabatanidzwa unoshanduka zvichienderana nerutivi rwunosvikwa nebasa remukati kuenda ku 0, uye utsanangure kana chirevo chiri chokwadi kana nhema, uchipa zvikonzero.
n-m-h2-limit-04.material: Tsanangura basa f ne f(t)=1 (t>0), f(0)=0, f(t)=−1 (t<0). Kana t→0, muganho wekuruboshwe −1 nemuganho wekurudyi 1 zvakasiyana, saka muganho we f hauvapo. Fungidzira basa g rinosvika padyo ne 0 kana x→0. Mina anoti, "Ipapo muganho webasa rakabatanidzwa f(g(x)) kana x→0 hauvapowo." (Funga x chete ine g(x)≠0.)
n-m-h2-limit-04.thinking.1: Kutsanangura mamiriro ekusvika kubva kurutivi rumwe
n-m-h2-limit-04.thinking.2: Kurongera zvekutarisa pakutonga kana muganho uripo
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza sarudzo dzese dzinotevera dza g(x) apo muganho we f(g(x)) kana x→0 uripo.
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s1.hint.0: Tsiva x ne 0.1, −0.1, 0.01, −0.01 uye utarise chiratidzo che g(x).
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s1.hint.1: Kana chiratidzo che g(x) chasarudzwa, tarisa kana kukosha kwe f(g(x)) kwakasarudzwa sekukosha kumwe chete.
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s1.r.b: Kana x>0 saka g>0, uye kana x<0 saka g<0, saka f(g(x)) inochinjana pakati pe 1 ne −1.
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s1.r.d: Chiratidzo che g chinoshanduka nechiratidzo che x, saka f(g(x)) inochinjana pakati pe 1 ne −1.
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s1.explain: g(x)=x² (x≠0) inogara yakanaka, saka f(g(x))=1 uye muganho ndi 1. g(x)=−x⁴ (x≠0) inogara isina kunaka, saka f(g(x))=−1 uye muganho ndi −1. x³ ne 2x dzinoshandura chiratidzo, saka muganho hauvapo.
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s2.prompt: Chirevo chaMina chinogara chiri chechokwadi here? Tonga kana chiri chechokwadi kana kwete, uye utsanangure chikonzero uchichibatanidza nenzira yekusvika kwe g(x) ku 0.
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s2.hint.0: Isa g kubva ku s1 yaiva nemuganho padivi pe g isina, uye uenzanise kuti chiratidzo che g(x) chakasiyana sei.
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s2.hint.1: Funga kana ndiyo saizi ye t kana chimwe chimiro che t chinosarudza kukosha kwe f(t).
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakabatanidza here rutivi rwekusvika ku 0 nekukosha kwe f?
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s2.model.0: Chirevo chaMina hachigari chiri chechokwadi. Kana g(x)=x², saka g(x) inosvika ku 0 kubva kurutivi rwakanaka chete, saka f(g(x)) inoramba yakaenzana ne 1 uye muganho uripo uye wakaenzana ne 1.
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s2.model.1: Kwete. Kana g(x) ichisvika ku 0 kubva kurutivi rusina kunaka chete, saka f(g(x))=−1 yakamira, saka muganho uripo, uye g(x)=−x⁴ muenzaniso unopikisa.
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s3.prompt: Kuziva kana muganho we f(g(x)) kana x→0 uripo, unofanira kuongorora chii?
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s3.hint.0: Kana x ichisvika padyo ne 0, nyora kuti kukosha kupi kunotorwa nekupinza g(x) ku f padyo ne 0.
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s3.hint.1: Rongera kukosha uku kuva kunoenda kurutivi rwemuganho wekuruboshwe we f nekuri kurutivi rwemuganho wekurudyi.
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s3.o.a: Kana mimuganho yekuruboshwe nekurudyi ye f(t) kana t→0 inosvika kukosha kumwe chete here
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s3.r.a: Kutarisa izvi oga kunoita mhedziso imwe chete naMina. Hakutarisi rutivi runosvikwa nabasa remukati.
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s3.o.b: Kana f(0) ne g(0) zvakaenzana, uye kana zvese zvakatsanangurwa
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s3.r.b: Kukosha pa x=0 hakushandiswi kuwana muganho kana x→0.
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s3.o.c: Kuti g(x) inoshanduka nekukurumidza zvakadini x painosvika padyo ne 0, nesaizi yayo
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s3.r.c: Kukurumidza hakuna chekuita nokuti muganho uripo here.
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s3.o.d: Chiratidzo chekukosha kunotorwa ne g(x) padyo ne 0, uye kukosha kwe f pachiratidzo ichocho
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s3.explain: Kukosha kwe f(g(x)) kunosarudzwa nekuti kukosha kwe g(x) kuri kurutivi rupi padyo ne 0. Kana g(x) ichisvika kubva kurutivi rumwe chete, unoda muganho wekurutivi iroro. Kana ichisvika kubva kumativi ese maviri, unofanira kuenzanisa mimuganho yekuruboshwe nekurudyi.

n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.prompt: Ruzivo runoratidzwa chidimbu nechidimbu. Panhanho imwe neimwe, sarudza kutonga kunobva pane zvaunoziva kusvika zvino chete.
n-m-h2-limit-05.title: Kukosha kwe sin(π/x) apo x inosvika padyo ne 0
n-m-h2-limit-05.goal: Usapedze nezvemuganho kubva pamakosha mashoma akawanikwa patafura. Gadzirisa kutonga kwako pese paunowana makosha akawanda, uye utsanangure kuti sei muganho usingavapo.
n-m-h2-limit-05.material: Kune f(x)=sin(π/x) (x≠0), unoda kuwana kuti f(x) inosvika pakukosha kupi x painosvika padyo ne 0 zvisingaperi. Wedzera makosha patafura rimwe panguva uye utonge. (Shandisa sin kπ=0, sin(π/2)=1, sin(3π/2)=−1.)
n-m-h2-limit-05.thinking.0: Kutonga kwenguva pfupi kubva pakukosha kwakaonekwa
n-m-h2-limit-05.thinking.1: Kugadzirisa kutonga kana makosha matsva aonekwa
n-m-h2-limit-05.prereq.1: Makosha e sin (sin kπ=0, sin(π/2)=1, nezvimwewo)
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.hint.0: Pese painoonekwa kukosha kutsva, enzanisa kana kuchisvika pakukosha kumwe chete nekwekare.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.hint.1: Funga kana nzira yawakasarudza nayo x ichimirira nzira dzese dzekusvika ku 0.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.0.info: Pa x=1, 1/2, 1/4, 1/10, makosha e f(x) ese ndi 0. (x inosvika padyo ne 0 zvichikura.)
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.0.ask: Unofungei pamusoro pemuganho we f(x) kana x→0?
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.0.after: Pa x yechimiro 1/n, sin(nπ)=0, saka kukosha ndi 0. Asi izvi zvinogona kuva mhedzisiro yekusarudza x nenzira yakasarudzika.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Ndinofungidzira ndi 0: nokuti makosha anoramba ari 0
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Uku ndiko kutonga kwekutanga kunouya kubva pakukosha kwaonekwa zvino chete.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Kuchakurumidza kupedza usati waona makosha akawanda e x
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Wakafunga kuti une makosha mashoma chete.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Hapana muganho: nokuti makosha ose akafanana
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Kukosha kuri kugara kwakamira, kana chiri chose, chinhu chinoratidza kuti muganho uripo.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.1.info: Panguva ino, pa x=2/5, 2/9, 2/13, 2/101, makosha e f(x) ese ndi 1.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.1.after: Kunyange x painosvika padyo ne 0, f(x) dzimwe nguva ndi 0 uye dzimwe nguva ndi 1. Kana muganho uripo, f(x) inofanira kusvika pakukosha kumwe chete kana x ichisvika padyo ne 0.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Wakarasa ruzivo rutsva. Kunyange x iri padyo ne 0, mapoindi ane kukosha 1 aonekwa.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Wakatevedza kukosha kwekupedzisira chete. 0 yakaonekwa kare yakabvawo pa x iri padyo ne 0, nenzira imwe chete.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Zvakaoma kutaura kuti kukosha kumwe chete: nokuti 0 ne 1 zvese zvakaonekwa kune x iri padyo ne 0
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Wakafunga kuti kukosha kuviri kwese kunooneka.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.2.info: Pa x=2/3, 2/7, 2/11, 2/103, makosha e f(x) ese ndi −1.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.2.ask: Pakupedzisira, ungataura chii pamusoro pemuganho we f(x) kana x→0?
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.2.after: Zvichienderana nokuti x yakasarudzwa sei padyo ne 0, f(x) inotora makosha 0, 1, ne −1, saka haigoni kutaurwa kuti inosvika pakukosha kumwe chete. Muganho hauvapo.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Muganho hauvapo: nokuti 0, 1, ne −1 zvinoramba zvichioneka kune x iri padyo ne 0
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Ndi −1: nokuti ndiko kukosha kwekupedzisira kwakaonekwa
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.reflect: Pakutanga makosha akaramba ari 0, saka muganho waiita sewe 0, asi kana ndakatarisa mamwe x anosvika ku 0, kutonga kwangu kwakashanduka. Muganho unofanira kutongwa kwete ne "makosha mashoma e x" asi nekuti f inosvika pakukosha kumwe chete kune x dzese dzinosvika ku 0.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s2.prompt: Nyora zvekungwarira paunofungidzira muganho kubva pamakosha mashoma patafura, nenheyo dzokuti sei basa iri risina muganho.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s2.hint.0: Fananidza padivi nedivi makoshero e x apo tebhura yakaratidza 0, 1, ne−1.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s2.hint.1: Nyora kuti chii chinofanira kuitika kumakoshero kana limit iripo, pasinei nekuti x inoswedera pedyo ne0 sei.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakapa makoshero chaiwo e x anoratidza kuti kukosha kunosiyana zvichienderana nekuti x inoswedera pedyo ne0 sei here?
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakatsanangura kuti nei makoshero mashoma mutebhura asingakwani here?
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s2.model.0: Kana ndakasarudza x yechimiro 1/n chete, ndaigara ndichiwana 0, asi kana x ichiswedera pedyo ne0 nenzira dzimwe, ndinowana 1 kana −1. Zvichienderana ne x inoswedera pedyo ne0, f inotora makoshero akasiyana, saka hapana limit. Haufanire kusarudza kubva pamakoshero mashoma chete.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s2.model.1: Kutonga kubva pamakoshero mashoma mutebhura kunogona kukutungamira zvisiri izvo. Zvichienderana nekuti x yakasarudzwa sei padhuze ne0, f(x) inotora makoshero akasiyana 0, 1, ne−1, saka haiswederi pedyo nekukosha kumwe chete uye hapana limit.

n-m-h2-limit-06.title: Kunyora tsananguro ye "girafu yakaputsika" kuna Seoyun
n-m-h2-limit-06.topic: Malimits nekuenderera kwefunctions: kuenderera pane domain
n-m-h2-limit-06.goal: Rongedza kuti pfungwa yekuti "girafu yakaputsika zvinoreva discontinuous" yakarurama rinhi uye rinhi isina kururama, uye utsanangurezve nemashoko akakodzera munin'ina wechikoro chepakati, uchiibatanidza nedomain.
n-m-h2-limit-06.material: Munin'ina wako wechikoro chepakati Seoyun akati, "Girafu ye f(x)=1/x yakaputsika pa x=0, saka idiscontinuous function. Continuous function ndiyo yaunogona kudhirowa pasina kusimudza pensera." Unoda kutsanangurira Seoyun kuti izvi zvinoenda kwakaipa kupi.
n-m-h2-limit-06.thinking.0: Kuziva kuti ma functions api anoenderera
n-m-h2-limit-06.thinking.1: Kunzwisisa hukama pakati pekuputsika kwegirafu nedomain
n-m-h2-limit-06.thinking.2: Kunyora patsva tsananguro kuti ienderane nemunhu anonzwa
n-m-h2-limit-06.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza ma functions ose ari pazasi anoenderera pamapoinzi ose edomain yawo.
n-m-h2-limit-06.s.s1.hint.0: Tanga wanyora domain, wobva washanda nenzira iyi: kune poinzi imwe neimwe mudomain, tarisa kana kukosha kwelimit kuchienzana nekukosha kwefunction.
n-m-h2-limit-06.s.s1.hint.1: Ziva kuti nzvimbo apo girafu inoita seyakaputsika ipoinzi iri mukati medomain kana kunze kwayo.
n-m-h2-limit-06.s.s1.r.d: Pa x=0 left-hand limit i0, right-hand limit i1, uye kukosha kwefunction i1, saka function haienderere pa x=0, poinzi iri mudomain.
n-m-h2-limit-06.s.s1.explain: Pamapoinzi ose x≠0, mutauro padhuze nepoinzi iyoyo wa 1/x ne x/|x| imutauro wakareruka mu x (1/x, kana maconstants 1 ne −1), saka anoenderera papoinzi imwe neimwe yedomain. |x| inoenderera pareal number imwe neimwe. k haienderere pa x=0, iri mudomain, nokuti left-hand ne right-hand limits dzayo dzakasiyana.
n-m-h2-limit-06.s.s2.prompt: Nyora tsananguro yaungatumira kuna Seoyun mumitsara 3 kusvika ku4. Seoyun ari muchikoro chepakati uye angave achinzwa mashoko seye "limit" ne "domain" kekutanga. Inofanira kusanganisira kuti nei kuputsika kwe 1/x kusiri kuenzana nekuva discontinuous function.
n-m-h2-limit-06.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wanyora, nemashoko aunogona kunzwisiswa naSeoyun, kuti chii chinoitika kana ukaisa x=0 mu 1/x.
n-m-h2-limit-06.s.s2.hint.1: Fananidza kana "girafu yakaputsika" ne "kukosha kunosvetuka papoinzi apo pane kukosha" zvichireva zvakafanana.
n-m-h2-limit-06.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakanyora nemashoko anogona kunzwisiswa nemudzidzi wechikoro chepakati here?
n-m-h2-limit-06.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakaratidza chikonzero chekuputsika zvakarurama (kunze kwedomain) here?
n-m-h2-limit-06.s.s2.model.0: Seoyun, 1/x haina kukosha chose pa x=0, saka girafu inoita seyakaputsika ipapo. Kuenderera kunobvunza, papoinzi imwe neimwe ine kukosha, kana kukosha kuchiputsika padhuze nepoinzi iyoyo. Kwose kune 1/x ine kukosha hairatsika, saka icontinuous function.
n-m-h2-limit-06.s.s2.model.1: Haugoni kuisa 0 mu 1/x, saka hapana girafu papoinzi iyoyo chose. Continuous function ndiyo ine kukosha kwelimit kwakaenzana nekukosha kwefunction pamapoinzi ose apo yakatsanangurwa, saka 1/x, isingaputsiki pamapoinzi apo ine kukosha, icontinuous function futi.
n-m-h2-limit-06.s.s2.model.2: Seoyun, haugoni kuisa 0 mu 1/x. Saka hapana poinzi yegirafu pa x=0 chose. Hapana kuputsika kwose kwegirafu yakadhirowa, saka icontinuous function.
n-m-h2-limit-06.s.s2.model.3: Seoyun, haugoni kupatsanura ne0, handizvo here? Saka 1/x haidhirowi pa 0. Kwose kunodhirowa hakuna kuputsika kwekukurumidza, saka tinoidaidza kuti continuous function.

n-m-h2-limit-07.title: Kuvaka kuenderera kwehuwandu hwema functions maviri iwe pachako
n-m-h2-limit-07.topic: Malimits nekuenderera kwefunctions: huwandu hwema continuous functions
n-m-h2-limit-07.goal: Tarisa nzira yechivakwa chekuti huwandu hwema continuous functions huri continuous, uye uvake iwe pachako pairi rema functions apo huwandu hwakaenderera asi imwe neimwe isingaenderere, wobva watsanangura kuti nei.
n-m-h2-limit-07.material: Wakadzidza kuti kana ma functions maviri f ne g akaenderera pa x=0, saka f+g yakaenderera pa x=0 futi. Unoda kuziva kana shanduro dzakasiyana dzakadzorerwa dzechivakwa ichi dziri dzose dzechokwadi.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s1.prompt: Kuma functions maviri f ne g, sarudza zvose zvinotevera zvinogara zviri chokwadi.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s1.hint.0: Mune chirevo chega chega, siyanisa fungidziro nemhedziso, uye ucherekedze kana ichinzira imwe chete nechivakwa chawakadzidza kana kupesana.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s1.hint.1: Unogona kuedza zvirevo zvakadzorerwa nema step functions maviri akareruka.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s1.o.a: Kana f ne g dzakaenderera pa x=0, saka f+g yakaenderera pa x=0
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s1.o.b: Kana f+g yakaenderera pa x=0, saka ose f ne g akaenderera pa x=0
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s1.r.b: Ichi chirevo chinzira yakapesana. Funga kana f ne g dzingagona kuzadzisana kusaenderera kwemumwe nemumwe.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s1.o.c: Kana f ne g dzisingaenderere pa x=0, saka f+g haienderere pa x=0
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s1.r.c: Funga kana kusaenderera kuviri kungashaika kana kwabatanidzwa.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s1.o.d: Kana f ne g dzakaenderera pa x=0, saka f·g yakaenderera pa x=0
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s1.explain: Huwandu neproduct yema continuous functions zvinoenderera, saka a ne d dzechokwadi. Kune b ne c, pane nyaya apo dzisingashande. Mu s2, vaka mienzaniso yakadaro iwe pachako uye utarise.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s2.prompt: Nema constants maviri p ne q, gadzira ma functions f(x)=1 (x≥0), f(x)=p (x<0) ne g(x)=1 (x≥0), g(x)=q (x<0). Isa mapairi maviri akasiyana (p, q) apo f ne g dzose dzisingaenderere pa x=0 asi f+g inoenderera pa x=0.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora left-hand limit, right-hand limit, nekukosha kwefunction kwe f+g pa x=0 nenzira ye p ne q.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s2.hint.1: Tsvaga hukama pakati pe p ne q hunoita kuti makoshero ose matatu aenzane, uye usarudze pairi risina p=1 kana q=1.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s2.var.p: Kukosha p kwe f kune x<0
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s2.var.q: Kukosha q kwe g kune x<0
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s2.fail.c3: Left-hand limit ye f+g yakasiyana nekukosha kwayo kwefunction.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s2.explain: Pa x=0, right-hand limit nekukosha kwefunction kwe f+g i1+1=2, uye left-hand limit i p+q. Saka f+g inoenderera kana p+q=2. Kana p=1 kana q=1, imwe yema functions yatoenderera, saka idzodzo dzinobviswa.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s2.because.prompt: Tsanangura mumutsara mumwe kana miviri kuti nei f+g ichienderera kunyange f ne g dzichisaenderera imwe neimwe.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s2.because.hint.0: Nyora musiyano pakati peleft-hand limit nekukosha kwefunction kwe f pa x=0, uye musiyano mumwe chete we g.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s2.because.hint.1: Tarisa chii chinoitika kana ukawedzera misiyano miviri.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Wakanyora hukuru hwekusawirirana kwefunction imwe neimwe semutauro here?
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Wakaratidza kuti kusawirirana kunova 0 kana kwabatanidzwa here?
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s2.because.model.0: Pa x=0, f inosvetuka ne p−1 kudzika uye g ne q−1, asi kana dzabatanidzwa dzinodzimana, saka left-hand limit ye f+g i2, uye right-hand limit nekukosha kwefunction zvakare i2, saka inoenderera.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s2.because.model.1: Kuwedzera maleft-hand limits kunopa p+q=2, saka left-hand limit, right-hand limit, nekukosha kwefunction kwe f+g zvose zvakaenzana ne2. Kusawirirana kwema functions maviri kunobatana ndokushaika.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s3.prompt: Uchishandisa chimiro chimwe chete seicho che s2 (1 kune x≥0, p kana q kune x<0), unoda kuvaka muenzaniso we "product f·g inoenderera pa x=0 asi f ne g dzose dzisingaenderere." Ndeipi mamiriro akakodzera?
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s3.hint.0: Tanga wawana right-hand limit nekukosha kwefunction kweproduct f·g pa x=0.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s3.hint.1: Nyora left-hand limit nenzira ye p ne q, wobva wagadzira equation inoti inoenzana nekukosha kwekare.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s3.r.a: Wakatamisa mamiriro ehuwandu. Kune product, left-hand limit i pq.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s3.r.c: Hauna kuongorora kuti right-hand limit nekukosha kwefunction keproduct i1·1=1.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s3.r.d: p=q yoga haipi pq=1. Semuenzaniso, kana p=q=2, saka pq=4.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s3.explain: Pa x=0, right-hand limit nekukosha kwefunction kwe f·g i1·1=1, uye left-hand limit i pq. Saka inoenderera kana pq=1. Kana p≠1, saka q=1/p≠1, saka ma functions ose maviri haaenderere (semuenzaniso, p=2, q=1/2).

n-m-h2-limit-08.thinking.0: Kutsvaga mutsara wekutanga unoenda kwakaipa muchigadziriso
n-m-h2-limit-08.title: Kuongorora chigadziriso chelimit chinosanganisira |x−1|
n-m-h2-limit-08.topic: Malimits nekuenderera kwefunctions: malimits emitauro ine absolute values
n-m-h2-limit-08.goal: Ziva kuti unofanira kufunga zviratidzo usati wadzima mumutauro une absolute value, uye ugadzirise chigadziriso nekuwana left-hand ne right-hand limits zvakasiyana.
n-m-h2-limit-08.material: Hyunwoo akawana kukosha kwe lim_{x→1} (x²−1)/|x−1| seizvi. (|x−1| iabsolute value ye x−1.)
n-m-h2-limit-08.thinking.1: Kugadzirisa chigadziriso neleft-hand ne right-hand limits
n-m-h2-limit-08.thinking.2: Kuongorora chiratidzo chemutauro uri mukati meabsolute value
n-m-h2-limit-08.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsara wekutanga usina kururama muchigadziriso chaHyunwoo.
n-m-h2-limit-08.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora |x−1| pasina chiratidzo cheabsolute value kune x diki kupfuura 1 uye kune x huru kupfuura 1.
n-m-h2-limit-08.s.s1.hint.1: Fananidza mhedzisiro iyoyo nemutauro wakadzimwa naHyunwoo.
n-m-h2-limit-08.s.s1.line.1: Kudzima x−1 munumerator nedenominator kunopa x+1.
n-m-h2-limit-08.s.s1.line.2: Saka kana x→1, x+1 inoswedera pedyo ne2.
n-m-h2-limit-08.s.s1.explain: Mutsara 2 ndiko kukanganisa kwekutanga. Denominator i |x−1|, kwete x−1, saka kune x<1, |x−1|=−(x−1). Saka haugoni kungodzima x−1 iri mudenominator ne x−1 iri munumerator. Mitsara 3 ne4 mhedzisiro yekutevera mutauro uyu wakaipa.
n-m-h2-limit-08.s.s2.prompt: Gadzirisa chigadziriso chaHyunwoo nekuwana left-hand limit ne right-hand limit zvakasiyana.
n-m-h2-limit-08.s.s2.hint.0: Kune x<1, dzima uye urerutse mutauro, wobva wawana kukosha kwawo kana x ichiswedera pedyo ne1. Shandisa nzira imwe chete kune x>1.
n-m-h2-limit-08.s.s2.hint.1: Fananidza makoshero maviri uye utarise kana achisangana nemamiriro ekuti limit ive nepo.
n-m-h2-limit-08.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakanyora patsva |x−1| zvakasiyana kune x<1 nekune x>1 here?
n-m-h2-limit-08.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakapedzisa kuti hapana limit nokuti malimits maviri akasiyana here?
n-m-h2-limit-08.s.s2.model.0: Kana x>1, saka |x−1|=x−1, saka kudzima kunopa x+1, uye right-hand limit i2. Kana x<1, saka |x−1|=−(x−1), saka inova −(x+1), uye left-hand limit i−2. Left-hand ne right-hand limits dzakasiyana, saka limit haipo.
n-m-h2-limit-08.s.s2.model.1: Right-hand limit i x+1→2 kune x huru kupfuura 1, uye left-hand limit i −(x+1)→−2 kune x diki kupfuura 1. Makoshero maviri akasiyana, saka limit haipo.
n-m-h2-limit-08.s.s3.prompt: Sarudza imwe yezvinotevera ine limit apo x→1.
n-m-h2-limit-08.s.s3.hint.0: Kune sarudzo imwe neimwe, tanga wanyatsotarisa kana mutauro uri mukati meabsolute value uchichinja chiratidzo padhuze ne x=1.
n-m-h2-limit-08.s.s3.hint.1: Funga kana, kana chiratidzo chisingachinji, unogona kungobvisa absolute value.
n-m-h2-limit-08.s.s3.r.a: Uyu mutauro wedambudziko rakashandwa. Left-hand ne right-hand limits dzakasiyana.
n-m-h2-limit-08.s.s3.r.c: Padhuze ne x=1, x+1 ipositive, saka |x²−1|=|x−1|(x+1), uye left-hand limit i−2 uye right-hand limit i2, dzakasiyana.
n-m-h2-limit-08.s.s3.r.d: Numerator inoswedera pedyo ne2 uye denominator inoswedera pedyo ne0, saka kune x>1 inokura pasina muganhu uye kune x<1 inodzikira pasina muganhu. Limit haipo.
n-m-h2-limit-08.s.s3.explain: Padhuze ne x=1, x+1>0, saka |x+1|=x+1, uye (x²−1)/|x+1|=x−1, saka limit i0. Chinokosha ndechekuti mutauro uri mukati meabsolute value unochinja chiratidzo padhuze ne1 here.

n-m-h2-limit-09.title: Inequalities nemalimits: kuongorora chirevo chaAyun
n-m-h2-limit-09.topic: Malimits nekuenderera kwefunctions: hukama hwekurongeka hwemalimits
n-m-h2-limit-09.goal: Shandisa counterexample kuona kuti chii chinoitika kustrict inequality kana uchitora malimits, uye utsanangure kana chirevo chiri chechokwadi kana chenhema nemhedziso yakarurama.
n-m-h2-limit-09.material: Ayun anotaura izvi. "Kana f(x)<g(x) kune x(≠0) yega yega padhuze ne x=0 uye ose lim f(x) ne lim g(x) aripo, saka malimits agutsawo lim f(x) < lim g(x). Inequality inoramba yakafanana."
n-m-h2-limit-09.thinking.1: Kutsanangura kuti nei inequality inova isina simba
n-m-h2-limit-09.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza pairi (f, g) rinoshanda secounterexample rinoratidza kuti chirevo chaAyun chenhema. (kana x→0)
n-m-h2-limit-09.s.s1.hint.0: Patsanura chirevo kuita "fungidziro → mhedziso," uye girai kuti counterexample inogutsa fungidziro asi inoputsa mhedziso.
n-m-h2-limit-09.s.s1.hint.1: Kune sarudzo imwe neimwe, tarisa nenzira kana f(x)<g(x) ichishanda chaizvo kune x≠0, uye ufananidze hukuru hwemalimits maviri.
n-m-h2-limit-09.s.s1.r.a: x²<0 haishande kune x ipi zvayo, saka haigutsi fungidziro yechirevo.
n-m-h2-limit-09.s.s1.r.b: Inogutsa fungidziro uye malimits anogutsa −1<1, izvo zvinowirirana nechirevo chaAyun, saka haisi counterexample.
n-m-h2-limit-09.s.s1.r.d: x<x+1 inoshanda uye malimits anogutsa 0<1, izvo zvinowirirana nechirevo chaAyun, saka haisi counterexample.
n-m-h2-limit-09.s.s1.explain: f(x)=0 ne g(x)=x² zvinogutsa f(x)<g(x) kune x≠0, asi malimits ose maviri akaenzana ne0. Inogutsa fungidziro uye inokundikana mhedziso, saka i counterexample.
n-m-h2-limit-09.s.s2.prompt: Nyora kuti chii chinoitika mulimit kuinequality f(x)<g(x) kana x ichiswedera pedyo ne0. Tsanangurawo mumutsara mumwe kuti nei izvozvo zvichiitika, uchishandisa counterexample.
n-m-h2-limit-09.s.s2.hint.0: Uchishandisa counterexample yawakasarudza mu s1, nyora kuti chii chinoitika ku g(x)−f(x) kana x ichiswedera pedyo ne0.
n-m-h2-limit-09.s.s2.hint.1: Funga kuti chii chinoitika kuhukama hwekurongeka hwemalimits maviri kana musiyano uyu wakava mudiki zvisina muganhu.
n-m-h2-limit-09.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakataura mumutsara kuti inequality inochinja sei here?
n-m-h2-limit-09.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakanyora f ne g yecounterexample yako zvakananga here?
n-m-h2-limit-09.s.s2.model.0: Mulimit, < inova isina simba kuita ≤. Kana f(x)=0 ne g(x)=x², saka f<g kune x≠0 yega yega, asi malimits maviri ose i0. Izvi nokuti musiyano g−f unoswedera pedyo ne0 zvisina muganhu.
n-m-h2-limit-09.s.s2.model.1: Kutora malimits kunogona kuita kuti aenzane. Semuenzaniso, 0 inogara iri diki kupfuura x², asi ose ane limit 0.
n-m-h2-limit-09.s.s3.prompt: Kana f(x)<g(x) kune x(≠0) yega yega padhuze ne x=0 uye ose malimits aripo, sarudza mhedziso inogara iri chokwadi.
n-m-h2-limit-09.s.s3.hint.0: Tarisa hukama hwekurongeka hwemalimits mucounterexample ye s1 nemumuenzaniso f=x, g=x+1 zvose.
n-m-h2-limit-09.s.s3.hint.1: Chengeta hukama hwakarurama mumienzaniso yose miviri chete.
n-m-h2-limit-09.s.s3.r.c: Kunyange f<g, limit ye f haigoni kuva iri huru.
n-m-h2-limit-09.s.s3.explain: Kana f(x)<g(x), ≤ chete ndiyo inovimbiswa mulimit. Pane muenzaniso apo kuenzana kunoshanda, saka < haisi chokwadi, uye > inhema munyaya dzose.

n-m-h2-limit-10.title: Kuongorora chigadziriso chekutsvaga a kuti g(x)=f(x)f(x−a) ienderere
n-m-h2-limit-10.topic: Malimits nekuenderera kwefunctions: kuenderera kwefunction yeproduct
n-m-h2-limit-10.goal: Tsvaga uye ugadzirise chigadziriso chinosiya nyaya yakasarudzika apo mapoinzi maviri ekusaenderera anofanana, uye utarise kuti nei function ichienderera kana akafanana.
n-m-h2-limit-10.material: Kune function f(x)=x+2 (x<0), f(x)=x−2 (x≥0), dambudziko ndere kutsvaga makoshero ose eiconstant a kuti g(x)=f(x)f(x−a) ienderere pareal number x yega yega. Tarisa chigadziriso chaEunwoo.
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsetse wekutanga usina kururama mugadziriso yaEunwoo.
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s1.hint.0: Pamutsetse mumwe nemumwe, tsvaga zvinotorwa segwaro negadziriso nezvemapoinzi maviri 0 ne a.
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s1.hint.1: Edza mitengo chaiyo ye a uye utarise kana zvirevo zvegadziriso zvichiramba zvakarurama.
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s1.line.0: f(x) i discontinuous pa x=0 chete, uye f(x−a) i discontinuous pa x=a chete.
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s1.line.1: Kuti g ive continuous pa x=0, tinoda f(−a)=0, saka a=2 kana a=−2.
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s1.line.2: Kuti g ive continuous pa x=a, tinoda f(a)=0, saka a=2 kana a=−2.
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s1.line.3: Saka mitengo ye a i −2 ne 2.
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s1.explain: Mutsetse 2 ndiwo kukanganisa kwekutanga. "Kuti g ive continuous pa x=0, tinoda f(−a)=0" i chokwadi chete kana f(x−a) i continuous padyo ne x=0. Kana a=0, ipapo f(x−a)=f(x) i discontinuous pa x=0 zvakare, saka chirevo ichi hachishandi. Mutsetse 3 unotora pfungwa imwechete, uye mutsetse 4 i mhedzisiro.
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s2.prompt: Wana mutengo we a wakashaikwa mugadziriso yaEunwoo, uye utarise kuti g i continuous chaizvo pamutengo iwoyo uchishandisa left-hand limit, right-hand limit, ne function value. Pakupedzisira, nyora mitengo yose ye a.
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s2.hint.0: Putsa pfungwa chidimbu chimwe panguva imwe: nyora kuti a ipi inoita kuti 0 ne a ive poinzi imwechete.
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s2.hint.1: Kune a iyoyo, nyora zvakare g seexpression, wobva wawana uye waenzanise left-hand limit yayo, right-hand limit, ne function value pa x=0.
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakanyora g seexpression chaiyo kana a=0 here?
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakawana left-hand limit, right-hand limit, ne function value here?
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s2.model.0: Kana a=0, mapoinzi maviri e discontinuity anopindirana papoinzi imwe x=0, uye g(x)=f(x)·f(x). Pa x=0 left-hand limit i 2²=4, right-hand limit i (−2)²=4, uye g(0)=4, saka g i continuous. Saka mhinduro i a=−2, 0, 2.
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s2.model.1: Gadziriso yakafungidzira kuti mapoinzi e discontinuity 0 ne a i mapoinzi akasiyana. Kana a=0, ipapo g i square ye f(x), uye left-hand limit 4, right-hand limit 4, ne function value 4 zvakaenzana, saka g i continuous. Saka a=−2, 0, 2.
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s3.prompt: Sarudza chikonzero chakanakisa nei g(x)=f(x)f(x) i continuous pa x=0 kana a=0.
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s3.hint.0: Tanga wanyora left-hand limit, right-hand limit, ne function value ye f pa x=0.
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s3.hint.1: Verenga kuti mitengo mitatu iyi inochinja sei kana yaitwa square.
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s3.o.a: Nekuti left-hand ne right-hand limits dze f dzinosiyana nechiratidzo chete, saka dzinova dzakaenzana kana dzaitwa square
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s3.o.b: Nekuti left-hand ne right-hand limits dze f i mutengo mumwechete
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s3.r.b: Pa x=0, f ine left-hand limit 2 ne right-hand limit −2, dzakasiyana.
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s3.o.d: Nekuti kuita function ipi neipi square kunogara kuchiiita continuous
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s3.r.d: Kune ma functions asingaiti continuous kana akaitwa square. Muenzaniso: left-hand limit 2, right-hand limit 3.
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s3.explain: Pa x=0, left-hand limit ye f i 2, right-hand limit i −2, uye f(0)=−2. Kuita square kunoita left-hand limit 4, right-hand limit 4, ne function value 4, zvose zvakaenzana, saka i continuous. Discontinuity inonyangarika pakuita square chete kana mativi maviri asiyana nechiratidzo chete.

n-m-h2-limit-11.title: Pane nguva imwechete nenzvimbo imwechete here? Dambudziko rekafambiro kegomo
n-m-h2-limit-11.topic: Limits nekuenderana kwe functions: kushandisa Intermediate Value Theorem
n-m-h2-limit-11.goal: Tsanangura iwe pachako function itsva inoenzanisa mamiriro maviri, shandisa Intermediate Value Theorem kuratidza kuvapo, uye utarise mamiriro anodiwa netheorem (continuity).
n-m-h2-limit-11.material: Munhu anotanga pamusoro pegomo pa 8 a.m. uye anosvika pamusoro pegomo pa 6 p.m. nenzira imwechete. Zuva rinotevera munhu anotanga pamusoro pegomo pa 8 a.m. uye anosvika pasi pegomo pa 6 p.m. nenzira imwechete. Pamazuva ose maviri munhu anogona kuzorora kana kuchinja kumhanya munzira, asi kune nzira imwe chete. Ngatitii u(t) i nzvimbo pazuva rekutanga panguva t uye d(t) i nzvimbo pazuva rechipiri, apo nzvimbo i distance yakayerwa kubva pasi pegomo (0 pasi, D pamusoro). Panofanira kuva nenguva apo munhu ari panzvimbo imwechete pamazuva ose maviri here?
n-m-h2-limit-11.thinking.1: Kunyora nharo uchishandisa Intermediate Value Theorem
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s1.prompt: Unoda kushandura "nzvimbo imwechete panguva imwechete" kuita equation uye ushandise Intermediate Value Theorem. Ndeipi function itsva yakakodzera pazvinotevera?
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora chiitiko chaunoda kuwana seequation "u(t) yakaenzana ne d(t)."
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s1.hint.1: Tsvaga, pakati pesarudzo, nzira yekushandura equation iyoyo kuita chimiro che "function imwe = 0."
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s1.r.a: Pa t=8 ne t=18 mutengo i D mumamiriro ose maviri, saka hapana kuchinja kwechiratidzo.
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s1.r.c: h(t)=0 inoitika kana imwe yemaviri i 0, izvo zvisingareve kuti nzvimbo mbiri dzakaenzana.
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s1.r.d: Kune nguva dzine d(t)=0, saka haina kutsanangurwa, uye kana dzakaenzana mutengo i 1 chete, kwete 0.
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s1.explain: Nzvimbo imwechete zvinoreva u(t)=d(t), ndiko kuti, u(t)−d(t)=0. Kana tikaseta h(t)=u(t)−d(t), ipapo h(8)=0−D<0 ne h(18)=D−0>0, saka zviratidzo zvakapesana.
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s2.prompt: Uchishandisa h, nyora tsananguro yekuti nei panofanira kuva nenguva apo munhu ari panzvimbo imwechete pamazuva ose maviri. Sanganisira mitengo ye h kumagumo maviri e interval, chikonzero chekuti h inogona kutorwa seiri continuous, netheorem yaunoshandisa.
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora mitengo ye u ne d panguva yekutanga nenguva yekupedzisira, uye uwane mitengo ye h.
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s2.hint.1: Kuti ushandise theorem pa h, taura nemashoko kuti nzvimbo inofanira kuchinja sei nenguva.
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakanyora mitengo yemagumo maviri zvakarurama here?
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakabatanidza chikonzero che continuity nenyaya here?
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s2.model.0: Ngatitii h(t)=u(t)−d(t). Ipapo h(8)=0−D=−D<0 ne h(18)=D−0=D>0. Munhu haatamiri nekukurumidza, saka nzvimbo inochinja pasina kuputsika, uye u, d, ne h i continuous. NeIntermediate Value Theorem kune c ine h(c)=0, uye ipapo u(c)=d(c).
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s2.model.1: Kuseta h=u−d, i mutengo negative −D pakutanga uye positive D pakupedzisira. Nzvimbo inochinja nenguva pasina kuputsika, saka h i continuous function, uye neIntermediate Value Theorem kune c pakati pe 8 ne 18 ine h(c)=0, saka kune nguva apo munhu ari panzvimbo imwechete panguva imwechete.
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s3.prompt: Fungidzira kuti pazuva rekutanga munhu akashandisa chishandiso chinomutamisa pakarepo kunzvimbo yepamusoro pane imwe nguva (saka nzvimbo inochinja nekuputsika). Tingatauriri kuti panofanira kuva nenguva panzvimbo imwechete panguva imwechete here?
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s3.hint.0: Fungidzira kuti graph ye h(t) inoratidzika sei kana nzvimbo ichisvetuka.
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s3.hint.1: Funga kana, kana graph ichisvetuka, inogona kupfuura 0 isina kuipfuura kunyange zviratidzo zvemagumo maviri zvakapesana.
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s3.o.a: Hongu: nekuti zviratidzo zvakapesana ze h kumagumo maviri zvinogara zvakakwana
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s3.r.a: Zviratidzo oga hazvina kukwana. Kana continuity yaputsika, theorem haigone kushandiswa.
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s3.o.b: Kwete: nekuti pazuva rekutamiswa, munhu haagone kusvika panzvimbo imwechete
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s3.r.b: Hapana hwaro hwekuti hagone kusvika panzvimbo imwechete. Vangasangana zvakadaro.
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s3.o.c: Haigone kutaurwa kuti panofanira kuva neimwe: nekuti kana continuity yaputsika, Intermediate Value Theorem haigone kushandiswa
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s3.o.d: Hongu: nekuti munhu akafamba nenguva yakareba yakafanana pamazuva ose maviri
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s3.r.d: Nguva yakatorwa kuva imwechete haina hukama chaihwo nekuvapo kwenzvimbo yakafanana.
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s3.explain: Kuti theorem ivimbise, h inofanira kuva continuous. Kana nzvimbo ichisvetuka, h inogona kupfuura 0. Semuenzaniso, kana pazuva rekutanga nzvimbo ichisvetuka kubva ku 0 kuenda ku D uye pazuva rechipiri ichisvetuka kubva ku D kuenda ku 0 panguva imwechete, nzvimbo mbiri dzingasambosangana.

n-m-h2-trig-06.title: Kugadzira triangle ine mativi ane integer neangle imwe ye 60°
n-m-h2-trig-06.goal: Shandisa cos60°=1/2 mu law of cosines kuseta hukama pakati pemativi e triangle ine angle ye 60°, uye uvake ma triangles asina kufanana ane kureba kwemativi kwose kuri integers.
n-m-h2-trig-06.material: Mu triangle ABC, a=BC, b=CA, c=AB ne ∠C=60°. Unoda kuvaka triangle ine kureba kwemativi matatu kwose kuri natural numbers.
n-m-h2-trig-06.thinking.0: Kuseta hukama kubva ku law of cosines
n-m-h2-trig-06.thinking.1: Kugadzira muenzaniso unogutsa mamiriro iwe pachako
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza hukama hwakarurama pakati pe a, b, c kana ∠C=60°.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s1.hint.0: Tanga wanyora law of cosines sezvayakaita, wobva waisa mutengo we cos60°.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s1.hint.1: Isa a=b=c=1 (equilateral triangle) mu equation imwe neimwe kuyedza kuti ipi yakarurama.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s1.r.a: Mu −2ab cosC ye law of cosines, wakatora cos60° se 1. Tarisazve mutengo we cos60°.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s1.r.b: Chiratidzo chakanyorwa zvakapesana. Funga kuti angle ipi inopa chiratidzo ichi.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s1.r.c: Wakaisa cos60°=1/2 mu −2ab cosC uye wakaverenga.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s1.r.d: Wakanyora hukama hwe right triangle. Tarisa kana ∠C i right angle.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s1.explain: Law of cosines i c²=a²+b²−2ab cosC uye cos60°=1/2, saka c²=a²+b²−ab. Kana chiratidzo chaiva +ab, ipapo ∠C=120°, uye kana c²=a²+b², ipapo ∠C=90°.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira ma triangles 2 asina kufanana ane ∠C=60° nemativi matatu ose ari natural numbers (40 kana pasi), uye uise a, b, c. (Bvisa equilateral triangle, a ne b hadzifaniri kuva ne common divisor kunze kwe 1, uye ma triangles anosiyana nekuchinjanisa a ne b chete anotorwa setriangle imwechete.)
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.hint.0: Sarudza a imwe uye uchinje b kuita 1, 2, 3, ... uchiverenga a²+b²−ab.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.hint.1: Tarisa kana mhedzisiro i square yenatural number imwe.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.ok.c1: Nhamba mbiri idzi i natural numbers dzine 40 kana pasi.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.fail.c1: Nhamba mbiri idzi dzinofanira kuva natural numbers kubva ku 1 kusvika ku 40.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.fail.c2: c² haienzani ne a²+b²−ab, saka ∠C haisi 60°.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.fail.c3: Kana a=b, triangle i equilateral. Ma equilateral triangles anobviswa.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.ok.c4: Common divisor chete ye a ne b i 1.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.fail.c4: a ne b zvine common divisor yakakura kupfuura 1, saka iyi i similar triangle yakakurwa kubva kune diki.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.because.prompt: Nyora mumutsara mumwe kana miviri kuti wakawana sei triangle iyoyo.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.because.hint.0: Gadzirisa mutengo mumwe we a, wobva wafunga kuti wakaverenga mutengo wei paunochinja b.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.because.hint.1: Taura kuti mutengo iwoyo unofanira kuva nhamba ipi kuti ive c².
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Wakaverenga uchichinja a ne b here?
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Wakatarisa kana mutengo waverengwa i perfect square here?
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.because.model.0: Ndakagadzirisa a=3 uye ndakaverenga a²+b²−ab ndichichinja b. Kana b=8, yaiva 49, square number. Saka c=7.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.because.model.1: Ndakaisa a ne b nenhevedzano mu hukama c²=a²+b²−ab uye ndakatsvaga mamiriro apo mhedzisiro i perfect square.

n-m-h2-trig-08.title: Hurefu hwetawa hunoonekwa kubva pamapoinzi maviri
n-m-h2-trig-08.goal: Nzwisisa kuti kuva neangle nedistance hazvireve kuti kune mutengo mumwe chete: verenga nzira mbiri dzinogoneka dzekurongeka nekuverenga, wobva wanyora zvakare dambudziko nemamiriro anogadzirisa imwe chete.
n-m-h2-trig-08.material: Tawa rakamira pasi pakaenzana. Pasi petawa P nemapoinzi A ne B zviri pamutsetse mumwe, uye AB=20 m. Angle yekukwira kumusoro petawa i 30° kubva ku A uye 45° kubva ku B. Siya kureba kwemeso. Seoyun akati, "Tine ma angles ose nedistance, saka hurefu hwetawa hunosarudzwa nenzira yega," uye Hajun akati, "Zvinogona kufungwa zvakasiyana."
n-m-h2-trig-08.thinking.0: Tonga kuti ruzivo rwakapiwa runosarudza mhinduro dzingani
n-m-h2-trig-08.prereq.1: Hukama pakati pehurefu nedistance mu right triangle
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza kutonga kwakarurama nezve chirevo chaani chakarurama.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s1.hint.0: Dhonza nzira dzose dzekurongeka dzinogoneka kana A, B, ne P zviri pamutsetse mumwe.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s1.hint.1: Mukurongeka kumwe nekumwe, tarisa kana unogona kutaura ma distances kubva ku P kuenda ku A nekubva ku P kuenda ku B maererano nehurefu h.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s1.o.a: Seoyun: Pane ma angles ekukwira maviri nedistance, saka hurefu hunosarudzwa nenzira yega zvechokwadi
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s1.r.a: Kunyange kuchioneka kuti kune ruzivo rwakawanda, unofanira kutarisa zvakaparadzana kana chimiro chinosarudzwa nenzira yega.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s1.o.b: Hajun: Hatizive distance kuchigadziko chetawa, saka hurefu hahusarudzwi muchero chipi nechipi
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s1.r.b: Izvi zvinotaura zvakanyanya kuti hazvisarudzwi. Verenga kana ma angles achikubvumira kuidzikisa kudistance imwe chete.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s1.o.c: Hajun: Hurefu hunosiyana zvichienderana nekuti mapoinzi maviri ari padivi rimwe here kana madivi akapesana echigadziko chetawa
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s1.r.c: Wakaratidza kuti chirevo chakapiwa hachisarudze kurongeka nenzira yega.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s1.o.d: Seoyun: Ma angles ekukwira maviri akasiyana, saka A ne B zvinofanira kuva madivi akapesana echigadziko chetawa
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s1.r.d: Wakapedza nzvimbo kubva pachokwadi chekuti ma angles akasiyana. Funga kana, kunyange padivi rimwe, poinzi iri padyo ichiona pamusoro neangle hombe.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s1.explain: Kana ari padivi rimwe, angle yekukwira kubva papoinzi iri padyo B (45°) i hombe, uye kunyange kana ari madivi akapesana, ma angles anogona kupiwa se 30° ne 45°. Zvimiro zviviri zvinogoneka uye hurefu hwakasiyanawo (hunoverengwa mudanho rinotevera), saka dambudziko rinofanira kutaura kurongeka kumwe. Izvo hazvireve kuti kuverenga hakugoneki. Kurongeka kukagadzirwa, hurefu hunosarudzwa.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s2.prompt: Ngatitii hurefu i h. Wana ① hurefu h1 kana A ne B zviri padivi rimwe rechigadziko P, ne ② hurefu h2 kana P iri pakati pe A ne B (madivi akapesana), uye uise imwe neimwe kusvika pa decimal places mbiri. (mu m)
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora hurefu se h uye utaure PA ne PB maererano ne h uchishandisa right triangles.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s2.hint.1: Shandisa chokwadi chekuti musiyano wema distances maviri i 20 kana ari padivi rimwe, uye huwandu i 20 kana ari madivi akapesana.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s2.var.h1: Hurefu h1 kana ari padivi rimwe
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s2.var.h2: Hurefu h2 kana ari madivi akapesana
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s2.fail.c2: Padivi rimwe, PA−PB=20. Seta equation ne PA=√3·h ne PB=h.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s2.fail.c3: Pamadivi akapesana, PA+PB=20. Seta equation ne PA=√3·h ne PB=h.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s2.explain: Kana angle kubva ku A i 30°, PA=h÷tan30°=√3·h, uye kana angle kubva ku B i 45°, PB=h. Padivi rimwe, PA−PB=20, saka h=20÷(√3−1)=10(√3+1)≈27.32. Pamadivi akapesana, PA+PB=20, saka h=20÷(√3+1)=10(√3−1)≈7.32.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s3.prompt: Nyora zvakare dambudziko iri nekuwedzera mutsara mumwe chete kuti hurefu hwunosarudzwe nenzira yega.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s3.hint.0: Rangarira zvakare kuti kwaiva nekurongeka kunogoneka kwakawanda sei.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s3.hint.1: Nyora mutsara mumwe unosarudza imwe pazvo.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakaverenga mutsara wawakawedzera kutarisa kuti unogadzirisa kurongeka nenzira yega here?
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakataura hukama hwenzvimbo dza A, B, ne P here?
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s3.model.0: Wedzera mutsara mumwe uchiti A ne B zviri padivi rimwe rechigadziko P chetawa.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s3.model.1: Chigadziko chetawa P chiri pakati pe A ne B.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s3.model.2: Chigadziko chetawa P chiri pa segment AB.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s3.model.3: Tinoudzwa kuti distance kubva ku A kuenda kuchigadziko chetawa P i 20√3 m.

n-m-h2-integ-06.title: Kuwana mitsetse yose inopoteredza area imwechete ne parabola
n-m-h2-integ-06.topic: Area pakati pe parabola nemutsetse: chiratidzo nekusiyanisa pamusoro napasi
n-m-h2-integ-06.goal: Nzwisisa kuti unofanira kubvisa expression yepasi kubva pa expression yepamusoro kuwana area, uye kuti mamiriro e slope i negative anofanira kubatwa nenzira imwechete, uye uwane mitsetse yose inogutsa mamiriro.
n-m-h2-integ-06.material: Kune parabola y=x² nemutsetse y=mx unopfuura origin (m≠0, m i integer). Ma graphs maviri anosangana pa x=0 ne x=m. Ngatitii S(m) i area yenzvimbo yakapoteredzwa.
n-m-h2-integ-06.thinking.0: Kutarisa kuti ndeipi iri pamusoro nenterval, uchishandisa graph
n-m-h2-integ-06.thinking.1: Kutarisa direction ye definite integral (muganhu wepasi, muganhu wepamusoro) nechiratidzo
n-m-h2-integ-06.prereq.1: Area pakati pema curves maviri (expression yepamusoro − expression yepasi)
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza expression yakarurama ye definite integral ye S(−2) kana m=−2.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s1.hint.0: Kana m=−2, dhonza ma graphs maviri uye utanga wanyora ma x-coordinates emapoinzi maviri ekusangana nekuti graph ipi iri pamusoro pakati pawo.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s1.hint.1: Rangarira zvinoitika kumutengo we definite integral kana muganhu wepasi i wakakura kupfuura wepamusoro kana integrand i negative.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s1.o.a: ∫₀^{−2}(−2x−x²)dx: ita integrate kubva ku 0 kusvika ku −2, uchibvisa expression yepasi kubva yepamusoro
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s1.r.a: Muganhu wepasi (0) i wakakura kupfuura muganhu wepamusoro (−2), saka chiratidzo chemutengo chinochinja. Area haigone kuva negative.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s1.o.b: ∫_{−2}^{0}(−2x−x²)dx: ita integrate kubva ku −2 kusvika ku 0, uchibvisa expression yepasi kubva yepamusoro
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s1.r.b: Iyi i fomu yakarurama, kuenda kubva kumagumo ekuruboshwe kuenda kumagumo ekurudyi uye kunyora expression yepamusoro − expression yepasi.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s1.o.c: ∫_{−2}^{0}(x²+2x)dx: ita integrate kubva ku −2 kusvika ku 0, uchibvisa expression yemutsetse kubva ye parabola
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s1.r.c: Pa interval iyi mutsetse uri pamusoro pe parabola. Kana ukabvisa expression yepamusoro kubva yepasi, mutengo i negative.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s1.o.d: ∫₀²(−2x−x²)dx: ita integrate kubva ku 0 kusvika ku 2, uchibvisa expression ye parabola kubva yemutsetse
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s1.r.d: Kana m=−2, ma graphs maviri anosangana pa x=0 ne x=−2. Interval haisi padivi rekurudyi re x-axis.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s1.explain: Kana m=−2, ma graphs maviri anosangana pa x=−2 ne x=0, uye kune −2<x<0 mutsetse y=−2x uri pamusoro pe parabola y=x². Saka S(−2)=∫_{−2}^{0}(−2x−x²)dx=4/3.

n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s2.explain: Kana m>0, S(m)=∫₀ᵐ(mx−x²)dx=m³/6. Kana m<0, uchifunga nezve symmetry pa y-axis ne −m=|m|, S(m)=|m|³/6. Saka |m|³=27, ndiko kuti, m=3 kana m=−3.

n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s3.model.2: Parabola i symmetric pa y-axis, saka kuchinja chiratidzo che slope yemutsetse chete kunongopeta chimiro kuruboshwe nekurudyi uye kusiya hukuru husina kuchinja. Saka slope i negative −3 inogonekawo.

n-m-h2-trig-01.title: Kuongorora mhinduro yakawana kuti girafu rakafambiswa zvakadini
n-m-h2-trig-01.goal: Mumhinduro inowana kuti girafu rechimiro y=a sin(bx−c) rakafambiswa zvakadini kubva pagirafu re y=a sin bx, tsvaga uye ugadzirise mutsetse wakanganisa, uye utarise kukosha kwakagadziriswa zvakananga.
n-m-h2-trig-01.material: Jiyun akagadzirisa kuti girafu re y=2sin(3x−π/2) rinofambiswa sei kubva pagirafu re y=2sin3x, seizvi pazasi. (π ndi pi uye makona ari mumaradians. 2sin3x zvinoreva nguva 2 ye sine ye 3x.)
n-m-h2-trig-01.thinking.0: Kutevedza mhinduro mutsetse nemutsetse kutsvaga mutsetse wakanganisa
n-m-h2-trig-01.thinking.1: Kubvisa coefficient ye x kuverenga kufambiswa
n-m-h2-trig-01.prereq.0: Nguva nekukosha kukuru nekudiki kwe y=a sin bx
n-m-h2-trig-01.prereq.1: Kufambisa girafu munzira ye x kunoreva kutsiva x ne x−m
n-m-h2-trig-01.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsetse wekutanga usina kururama mumhinduro yaJiyun.
n-m-h2-trig-01.s.s1.hint.0: Tarisa mutsetse nemutsetse kana mutsetse wega wega uchitevera chaizvo kubva pamutsetse uri pamberi pawo.
n-m-h2-trig-01.s.s1.hint.1: Wedzera zvakare chirevo chakabvisirwa zvinhu nemutemo wekugovera uye uchienzanise nechirevo chisati chabvisirwa zvinhu.
n-m-h2-trig-01.s.s1.line.3: Saka girafu iyi igirafu ye y=2sin3x yakatranslatewa ne π/2 munzira ye x.
n-m-h2-trig-01.s.s1.explain: Mutsara wechi3 wakaipa. Kutambanudza 3(x−π/2) kunopa 3x−3π/2, iyo yakasiyana ne3x−π/2. Sezvo 3x−π/2=3(x−π/6), shift i π/6. Mutsara wechi4 mhedziso inotevera mhedzisiro yakaipa yemutsara wechi3, uye mitsara 1 ne2 yakarurama.
n-m-h2-trig-01.s.s2.prompt: Gadzirisa mutsara wakaipa uye unyore nzira nehuwandu hwakarurama hweshift, pamwe nenzira imwe yawakaongorora kuti kukosha kwakarurama.
n-m-h2-trig-01.s.s2.hint.0: Uchitanga ne3x−π/2, funga kuti nhamba ipi inofanira kuuya pamberi pamabhurakiti kuti ugadzire x−(shift).
n-m-h2-trig-01.s.s2.hint.1: Tambanudza mutauro wakanyorwa neshift yawakawana uye utarise kuti unova 3x−π/2.
n-m-h2-trig-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakatambanudza mutauro wakagadziriswa iwe pachako here?
n-m-h2-trig-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Unogona kutaura kuti nei unofanira kufactor ne3 here?
n-m-h2-trig-01.s.s2.model.0: Muna 3x−π/2, tanga wabvisa 3 kuti uwane 3(x−π/6). Saka y=2sin3x yakashifter kurudyi ne π/6. Kuongorora: kutambanudza 3(x−π/6) kunopa 3x−π/2, kwakafanana nemutauro wekutanga.
n-m-h2-trig-01.s.s2.model.1: Unofanira kubvisa coefficient 3 ye x kuti uwane chimiro x−(shift). Sezvo π/2÷3=π/6, itranslation ne π/6 munzira yepositive ye x. Kuisa x=π/6 kunopa 3x−π/2=0, saka sin0=0, izvo zvinowirirana ne y=2sin3x iri 0 pa x=0.

n-m-h2-trig-02.title: Interval pfupi zvikuru apo sin²x inodzokororwa i chii?
n-m-h2-trig-02.goal: Ongorora chirevo che "period ye sin x i2π, saka sin²x ine period 2π futi" nekuongorora equation yeinterval yekudzokorora, uye utaure period diki zvikuru yepositive nezvikonzero.
n-m-h2-trig-02.material: Seoyeon akati, "Period ye sin x i2π, saka period ye y=sin²x i2π futi," uye Minho akati, "Iyo haisi interval pfupi zvikuru." Pano, period inoreva p diki zvikuru ipositive iyo f(x+p)=f(x) inoshanda kune x dzose. (sin²x isquare ye sin x.)
n-m-h2-trig-02.thinking.0: Kusiyanisa interval yekudzokorora neinterval diki zvikuru
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza zvirevo zvose zvakarurama pamusoro pe f(x)=sin²x.
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s1.hint.0: Mune chirevo chega chega, isa makoshero chaiwo seye 0 kana π/2 kuna x uye ufananidze kana mativi maviri akaenzana.
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s1.hint.1: Tanga wanyora kuti sin(x+π) inobatana sei ne sin x, wobva waona kuti chii chinoitika kana ukakwidza square.
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s1.o.a: Period ye sin x i2π, saka interval pfupi zvikuru apo sin²x inodzokororwa inofanirawo kuva 2π
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s1.r.a: Izvi zvinotora period yefunction yekutanga seinterval pfupi zvikuru yefunction itsva. Tarisa kuti kukwidza square kunobvisa chiratidzo.
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s1.o.b: Kune x dzose, sin²(x+π)=sin²x, saka mushure mekufamba ne π girafu inodzokororwa muchimiro chakafanana
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s1.r.b: Uku kutonga kwakaitwa mushure mekunyora kuti sin(x+π) inobatana sei ne sin x nekutarisa mhedzisiro yakakwidzwa square.
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s1.o.c: Kune x dzose, sin²(x+π/2)=sin²x, saka mushure mekufamba ne π/2 girafu inodzokororwa muchimiro chakafanana
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s1.r.c: Hauna kuongorora nekuisa makoshero chaiwo ku x. Semuenzaniso, verenga mativi ose maviri pa x=0.
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s1.o.d: Kune x dzose, sin²(x+2π)=sin²x, saka mushure mekufamba ne2π girafu inodzokororwa muchimiro chakafanana
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s1.r.d: Hauna kusiya kuti 2π iinterval yekudzokorora futi. Asi kuti ndiyo pfupi zvikuru here kunofanira kuongororwa zvakasiyana.
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s1.explain: sin(x+π)=−sin x, saka sin²(x+π)=sin²x. Saka π iinterval yekudzokorora futi, uye 2π, kaviri π, futi. Asi pa x=0, sin²0=0, uye sin²(π/2)=1, saka π/2 haisi interval yekudzokorora. 2π iinterval yekudzokorora asi haisi pfupi zvikuru.
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s2.prompt: Nyora period diki zvikuru yepositive ye y=sin²x, uye utsanangure nezvikonzero kuti chii chiri kushaikwa muchirevo chaSeoyeon. (Zvikonzero: kanenge kunyora patsva mutauro kana makoshero egirafu)
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s2.hint.0: Verenga makoshero e sin²x pa x=0 ne x=π/2, uye utsvage interval apo makoshero anova akaenzana.
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s2.hint.1: Girai kana unogona kunyora sin²x semutauro une cos2x.
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s2.placeholder: Muenzaniso: period diki zvikuru yepositive ye y=sin²x i ... nokuti ...
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakanyora patsva mutauro se sin²x=(1−cos2x)/2 kana kuisa makoshero e x zvakananga here?
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakataura kuti 2π iinterval yekudzokorora asi haisi pfupi zvikuru here?
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Wakachengeta zvinoreva izwi rekuti "diki zvikuru" here?
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s2.model.0: sin²x=(1−cos2x)/2 uye period ye cos2x i π, saka period ye sin²x i π. 2π yaSeoyeon inopawo makoshero akafanana mushure mekufamba kusvika ipapo, asi haisi interval diki zvikuru.
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s2.model.1: sin(x+π)=−sin x, saka kukwidza square kunopa sin²(x+π)=sin²x. Saka minimal period i π kana pazasi, uye gap pakati pe x=π/2 ne 3π/2, apo sin²x i1, i π, saka π ndiyo diki zvikuru. 2π iinterval yekudzokorora, asi haisi diki zvikuru.

n-m-h2-trig-03.title: Kana tan(α+β)=1, α+β i chii?
n-m-h2-trig-03.goal: Tevera kuti kutonga kwekuti kukosha kumwe chete kwe tan kunoita sekunosarudza angle kunochinja sei kana ruzivo rwerange yeangle rwauya, uye utsanangure kuti nei.
n-m-h2-trig-03.material: Kuma angles α ne β, tanα=1/2 ne tanβ=1/3. Ruzivo runoratidzwa chidimbu nechidimbu, saka tonga uchishandisa zvaziva kusvika zvino chete. (tan(α+β) i (tanα+tanβ)÷(1−tanα·tanβ).)
n-m-h2-trig-03.thinking.2: Kushandisa makoshero etrigonometric pamwe chete nerange yeangle
n-m-h2-trig-03.prereq.1: Hukama pakati pema angles ane kukosha kumwe chete kwe tan (period π)
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.prompt: Ruzivo runoratidzwa chidimbu nechidimbu. Panhanho imwe neimwe, sarudza kutonga uchishandisa ruzivo rwakapiwa kusvika zvino chete.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.hint.0: Nguva imwe neimwe kana ruzivo rutsva rwabuda, tanga wanyora range umo α+β inogona kuva.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.hint.1: Verenga kuti ma angles mangani ane tan value 1 ari murange iyoyo.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Numerator i1/2+1/3=5/6 uye denominator i1−1/6=5/6, saka tan(α+β)=1.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Izvi zvinotora huwandu hwematan seye tan yehuwandu. Tarisa zvakare kuti denominator yefomula yekuwedzera yakanyorwa sei.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Tarisa kubva pachimiro chefomula yekuwedzera kuti product inoshandiswa kupi.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Wakaisa makoshero zvakananga mufomula ukaverenga numerator 5/6 nedenominator 1−1/6=5/6.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.st.1.info: α ne β dzose dziri acute angles (dzakakura kupfuura 0° uye dzidiki kupfuura 90°).
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.st.1.after: Huwandu hwema acute angles maviri hwakakura kupfuura 0° uye hudiki kupfuura 180°. Murange iyi, 45° ndiyo angle yega ine tan value 1.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Wakashandisa kuti huwandu huri pakati pe0° ne180° uye kuti mukati meiyoyo mune angle imwe chete ine tan value 1.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Wakafunga kuti α+β inogona kuva huru kupfuura 180°. Verenga range yehuwandu hwema acute angles maviri.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Chokwadi kuti pane ma angles akawanda ane tan value imwe chete, asi hauna kushandisa range yakapiwa.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.st.2.info: Mamiriro akachinja. tanα=1/2 ne tanβ=1/3 zvinoramba zvakafanana, α iangle iri muquadrant yechitatu (huru kupfuura 180° uye diki kupfuura 270°), uye β iacute.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.st.2.after: α+β yakakura kupfuura 180° uye idiki kupfuura 360°. Murange iyi, 225° ndiyo angle yega ine tan 1. Kunyange kune tan value imwe chete, mhinduro inochinja kana range yeangle ichichinja.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Wakatarisa tan value kuva 1 chete uye wakashandisazve angle yekare.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Unoita sekufunga kuti, nokuti range yakachinja, haigoni kusarudzwa. Verenga kuti ma angles mangani murange itsva ane tan 1.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Wakawana angle ine tan 1 murange itsva 180°<α+β<360°.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.reflect: Kukosha tan(α+β)=1 kwaiva kwakafanana, asi zvichienderana neruzivo rwerange yeangle yakava 45° mune imwe nyaya uye 225° mune imwe. Angle haisarudzwi nekukosha kwetrigonometric function yoga; range yeangle inodiwawo.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s2.prompt: Tsanangura kuti nei kuziva tan(α+β)=1 kusingasarudzi α+β chete, uye kuti ruzivo rwerange yeangle runoita chii.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s2.hint.0: Tsvaga uye unyore angle yakasiyana ne45° ine tan value 1.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s2.hint.1: Fananidza huwandu hwema angles anosarudzwa pasina ruzivo rwerange nepane ruzivo.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s2.placeholder: Muenzaniso: ma angles ane tan value imwe chete i ... Kana pane range, ...
