n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakataura kuti range inoderedza sei vanosarudzwa kuita mumwe chete here?
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s2.model.0: Ma angles ane tan value 1 haasi 45° chete asi anodzokororwa 180° imwe neimwe, seye 225°, saka angle haisarudzwi yega. Kana pane range, seye acute kana muquadrant yechitatu, mumwe chete ndiye anosara mukati mayo.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s2.model.1: tan inopa kukosha kumwe chete pamakumbo e180°, saka kubva pakukosha 1 oga haugoni kuziva kana i45° kana 225°. Unofanira kuziva kuti angle iri murange ipi kuti usarudze imwe yemaviri.

n-m-h2-trig-04.thinking.2: Kugadzira mienzaniso yakati wandei inosangana nemamiriro
n-m-h2-trig-04.title: Kutsvaga kureba kwemativi matatu anoita obtuse triangle
n-m-h2-trig-04.goal: Shandisa law of cosines kunyora mamiriro ekuti angle iri kupesana nedivi rakareba zvikuru ive obtuse, uchitarisawo mamiriro ekuti triangle iripo chaizvo, uye vaka matriangle obtuse akasiyana.
n-m-h2-trig-04.material: Unoda kugadzira obtuse triangle ine kureba kwemativi matatu kwose kuri nhamba dzechisikwa. Rega c ive kureba kwedivi rakareba zvikuru uye a ne b mamwe mativi maviri, uye ushandise law of cosines kuongorora chiratidzo che cosC=(a²+b²−c²)÷(2ab), cosine yeangle C iri kupesana ne c.
n-m-h2-trig-04.thinking.0: Kushandisa chiratidzo kubva palaw of cosines kusiyanisa mhando yeangle
n-m-h2-trig-04.prereq.1: Mamiriro ekuti triangle igadzirwe kubva pakureba kwemativi matatu
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s1.prompt: Minsu akati, "Kana a=3, b=4, c=9, saka c²=81 yakakura kupfuura a²+b²=25, saka cosC<0, uye pane obtuse triangle ine mativi 3, 4, 9." Unotonga sei chirevo ichi?
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s1.hint.0: Fungidzira kana waigona kugadzira triangle kubva patsvimbo nhatu dzine kureba kwe3, 4, ne9.
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s1.hint.1: Verenga zvechokwadi kukosha kwe cosC uye ufananidze nerange yemakoshero anogona kutorwa necosine.
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s1.o.a: Zvakarurama. 9²>3²+4², saka angle iri kupesana nedivi rakareba zvikuru iobtuse
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s1.r.a: Wakatarisa chiratidzo chekukosha kwecosine chete uye haina kuongorora kana triangle ichigona kugadzirwa.
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s1.o.b: Zvakaipa. 3+4<9, saka triangle haigoni kugadzirwa nemativi ane kureba uku
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s1.r.b: Usati wawana kukosha kwecosine, wakatanga wafananidza kana mativi matatu achigadzira triangle.
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s1.o.c: Zvakaipa. Kana 9²>3²+4², angle iri kupesana nedivi rakareba zvikuru iright angle
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s1.r.c: Wakavhiringidza nyaya yeright angle nenyaya yeobtuse angle. Kune 3, 4, 5, fananidza 5² ne3²+4².
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s1.o.d: Zvakarurama. 3, 4, 9 ndekureba kwakasiyana, saka inogona kuva obtuse triangle
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s1.r.d: Kureba kwakasiyana hakuna chekuita nekuti triangle iripo here.
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s1.explain: cosC=(9+16−81)÷24 yakaenzana ne−56÷24<−1, saka haigoni kuva kukosha kwecosine. Izvi nokuti 3+4<9, saka hapana triangle inogadzirwa nemativi matatu. Kuti ive obtuse angle, square yedivi rakareba zvikuru inofanira kuva huru kupfuura huwandu hwemasquares emamwe mativi maviri, uye panguva imwe chete divi rakareba zvikuru rinofanira kuva pfupi kupfuura huwandu hwemamwe maviri.
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s2.prompt: Tsvaga matriangle 3 akasiyana eobtuse ane kureba kwemativi kwose kuri nhamba dzechisikwa dzine 20 kana pazasi uye uise kureba kwemativi matatu. (Matriangle anosiyana nekutevedzana chete anotorwa setriangle imwe chete.)
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wasarudza divi rakareba zvikuru c, wobva wasarudza a ne b murange apo a+b yakakura kupfuura c.
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s2.hint.1: Kunhamba nhatu dzawakasarudza, verenga c² ne a²+b² uye uzvifananidze, uye ufananidzewo a+b ne c.
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s2.ok.c1: Nhamba nhatu dzinhamba dzechisikwa kubva ku1 kusvika ku20.

n-m-h2-trig-07.s.s2.hint.1: Fungidzira mutengo waHarin sedecimal uye uuenzanise nerenji iyoyo.
n-m-h2-trig-07.s.s2.o.a: 75° i acute angle, saka sin75° inofanira kuva shoma kupfuura sin30°=1/2
n-m-h2-trig-07.s.s2.r.a: Izvi zvinofungidzira kuti sine inodzikira pa acute angles chete. Enzanisa mitengo ye sine ye 30° ne 75°.
n-m-h2-trig-07.s.s2.o.b: Mutengo we sine haugone kupfuura 1, asi mhedzisiro (√2+1)/2 i yakakura kupfuura 1

n-m-h2-trig-07.s.s2.r.d: Izvi zvinofungidzira kuti kuwedzera pachako hakubvumirwi. Hapana chikonzero chekuti hazvigone kuwedzerwa. Unofanira kutonga nemhedzisiro.

Kunyange usingaziva fomula, unogona kucherechedza kukanganisa kubva pa renji yemitengo oga. Fomula yakarurama i sin75°=sin45°cos30°+cos45°sin30°.

n-m-h2-integ-02.material: Ichi chigadziriso chaJimin chekuwana kukosha kwe f(1) kana f'(x)=(x+1)(x+2) ne f(0)=2. (f' inoverengwa "f prime," uye C iconstant yeintegration.)

n-m-h2-integ-02.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsara wekutanga wakaipa muchigadziriso chaJimin.
n-m-h2-integ-02.s.s1.hint.0: Edza kana mutauro usati wachinja nepashure pekuchinja uri mumwe chete chaizvo nekushandisa nzira imwe chete pamutauro wakareruka zvikuru.
n-m-h2-integ-02.s.s1.hint.1: Tarisa kana kudifferentiate mhedzisiro yemutsara wega wega maererano ne x kunodzorera integrand yemutsara wapakarepo.

n-m-h2-integ-02.s.s2.prompt: Mushure mekupedza chigadziriso, ndeipi nzira yakananga zvikuru yekuongorora yekubata kukanganisa kwakadai iwe pachako?

n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s1.r.a: Constant ye integration ye velocity yagadzirwa, asi iya yenzvimbo inoramba. Acceleration pa t=3 yatoziviswa kubva pa a(t).
n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s1.o.b: Nzvimbo pa t=0 ne acceleration pa t=3
n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s1.r.b: Constant ye integration yenzvimbo yagadzirwa, asi iya ye velocity inoramba. Acceleration pa t=3 yatoziviswa kubva pa a(t).
n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s1.o.c: Acceleration pa t=1 ne acceleration pa t=3
n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s1.r.c: Mitengo yose miviri inogona kuverengwa kubva pa a(t), saka hapana ruzivo rutsva.
n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s1.o.d: Velocity pa t=0 nenzvimbo pa t=0
n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s1.r.d: Uyu i ruzivo runogadzirisa imwe neimwe ye constants mbiri dze integration dzinoitwa nekuita integrate kaviri.
n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s1.explain: Kuita integrate a(t) kunopa v(t)=3t²−4t+C₁, uye kuita integrate kamwe zvakare kunopa x(t)=t³−2t²+C₁t+C₂. Nzvimbo inogadzirwa chete kana ma constants ose maviri e integration C₁ (initial velocity) ne C₂ (initial position) asarudzwa.
n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s2.prompt: Ngatitii v₀ i velocity pa t=0 uye x₀ i nzvimbo. Isa mapeya matatu akasiyana e integers (v₀, x₀) kuti nzvimbo pa t=3 i 10. (−20≤v₀≤20, −20≤x₀≤20)
n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s2.hint.0: Ita integrate kaviri kuwana x(t), wobva waisa t=3 uye uinyore seexpression mu v₀ ne x₀.
n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s2.hint.1: Tarisa kana kusarudza v₀ imwe inogutsa expression iyoyo kunosarudza x₀.
n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s2.fail.c1: v₀ ne x₀ dzinofanira kuva integers kubva ku −20 kusvika ku 20.
n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s2.fail.c2: Nzvimbo pa t=3 haisi 10. Isa t=3 mu x(t)=t³−2t²+v₀t+x₀.
n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s2.explain: x(3)=27−18+3v₀+x₀=9+3v₀+x₀, saka x(3)=10 kana 3v₀+x₀=1. Kune (v₀, x₀) dzisingaperi dzinogutsa equation iyi. Ndiko kuti, kunyange nenzvimbo imwechete pa t=3, kune kufamba kwakawanda ne initial velocities nenzvimbo dzekutanga dzakasiyana.
n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s3.prompt: Tsanangura nei kuziva nzvimbo imwe chete kusingakuiti kuti uzive initial velocity ne initial position zvose, uye unyore nei ruzivo rwuviri rwunodiwa kugadzirisa kufamba.
n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s3.hint.0: Verenga kuti wakaita integrate kangani kuwana nzvimbo.
n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s3.hint.1: Tarisa kana mapeya awakagadzira pakutanga ose achisvika panzvimbo imwechete, uye utaure kuti akasiyana sei.
n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s3.placeholder: semuenzaniso, Kana ukaita integrate ... ipapo ... inooneka, saka ...
n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakataura kuti kuita integrate kaviri kunogadzira ma constants maviri here?
n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakataura kuti kana pane equation imwe chete semamiriro, (v₀, x₀) haisarudzwi nenzira yega here?
n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s3.model.0: Sezvo tinoita integrate kaviri kubva pa acceleration kuenda kunzvimbo, constant ye integration imwe inooneka pa velocity neimwe panzvimbo. Nzvimbo pa t=3 inopa equation imwe chete, sa 3v₀+x₀=1, saka v₀ ne x₀ hadzisarudzwi nenzira yega uye mapeya akawanda anogoneka. Unofanira kuziva zvose initial velocity ne initial position.
n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s3.model.1: Hatizive ma constants 2 e integration, asi nzvimbo pa t=3 inopa equation imwe chete. Saka kune mabatanidzwa asingaperi e initial velocity ne initial position. Nema constants 2, unoda ruzivo rwuviri 2.
n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s3.model.2: Kuita integrate kaviri kunosiya initial velocity ne initial position imwe neimwe seconstant. Mutengo mumwe chete wenzvimbo i equation imwe chete inosunga zviviri izvi, saka kufamba kwakawanda kunogona kusvika panzvimbo imwechete.

n-m-h2-integ-01.title: Kukosha kwe definite integral nenzvimbo iri pasi pegirafu zvakafanana here?
n-m-h2-integ-01.topic: Ma definite integral nenzvimbo: nzvimbo ine chiratidzo
n-m-h2-integ-01.goal: Nzwisisa kuti definite integral ndiyo "nzvimbo ine chiratidzo," ichiverenga chikamu chiri pasi pe x-axis sechisina kunaka, gadzira nyaya apo definite integral iri 0 asi nzvimbo isiri 0, uye utsanangure chikonzero nemaitiro ekuwana nzvimbo.
n-m-h2-integ-01.material: Pane girafu re f(x)=x²−2x, x-axis, nechikamu 0≤x≤3. Hajun akati, "∫₀³ f(x)dx=0, saka nzvimbo iri pakati pegirafu ne x-axis iri 0 zvakare," uye Seoa akati, "Handifungi kuti nzvimbo ndi 0." (∫₀³ ndiyo definite integral kubva pa 0 kusvika pa 3.)
n-m-h2-integ-01.thinking.1: Kupatsanura girafu kuva zvikamu zviri pamusoro nepasi pe x-axis
n-m-h2-integ-01.thinking.2: Kuparadzanisa kukosha kwe definite integral nenzvimbo
n-m-h2-integ-01.prereq.0: Kuverenga ma definite integral emabasa epolynomial
n-m-h2-integ-01.prereq.1: Nzvimbo yegirafu rebasa kana yaenzaniswa ne x-axis
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza kutonga kwakarurama pamusoro penzvimbo iri pakati pegirafu ne x-axis pachikamu ichi.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s1.hint.0: Dhonza girafu re f(x)=x²−2x uye umake kuri pamusoro pe x-axis nekuri pasi payo mukati mechikamu.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s1.hint.1: Tsvaga ma x-coordinate emapoindi apo girafu inosangana ne x-axis, patsanura chikamu pamapoindi iwayo, verenga definite integral yechidimbu chimwe nechimwe zvakasiyana, uye uenzanise zviratidzo.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s1.o.a: Nzvimbo ndi 0: nokuti kukosha kwe definite integral ndiyo nzvimbo iri pakati pegirafu ne x-axis
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s1.r.a: Wakatora kukosha kwe definite integral nenzvimbo sezvinhu zvimwe chete. Chikamu chiri pasi pe x-axis chinoverengwa sechisina kunaka mu definite integral.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s1.o.b: Nzvimbo ndi 0: nokuti girafu inosangana ne x-axis papoindi iri mukati mechikamu
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s1.r.b: Poindi apo girafu inosangana ne x-axis ingori poindi uye haiiti kuti nzvimbo ive 0. Zvimiro zviri kumativi ese epoindi iyoyo zvine nzvimbo.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s1.o.c: Nzvimbo haisi 0: nokuti chikamu chepamusoro nechepasi zvine kukosha kune zviratidzo zvakasiyana uye zvinodzimana
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s1.r.c: Wakafunga kuti kukosha kwakanaka nekusina kunaka kunodzimana sei mukati me definite integral.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s1.o.d: Hazvigoni kuzivikanwa: nokuti kukosha kwe definite integral oga hakutauri chinhu pamusoro pechimiro chegirafu
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s1.r.d: Pano f(x) yakapiwa, saka tinogona kutarisa chimiro chegirafu zvakananga.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s1.explain: f(x)=x²−2x=x(x−2) iri pasi pe x-axis pa 0≤x≤2, saka ∫₀² f=−4/3, uye iri pamusoro pa 2≤x≤3, saka ∫₂³ f=4/3. Dzinowedzera kusvika 0, asi nzvimbo ndi 4/3+4/3=8/3. Definite integral "nzvimbo ine chiratidzo," ichiverenga chikamu chiri pasi pe x-axis sechisina kunaka.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s2.prompt: Kune f(x)=x(x−a), nyora maviri maviri akasiyana enhamba dzakazara dzakanaka (a, b) apo definite integral ∫₀ᵇ f(x)dx=0. (1≤a≤20, 1≤b≤20)
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s2.hint.0: Wedzera ∫₀ᵇ x(x−a)dx uye uinyore sechirevo che a ne b.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s2.hint.1: Shanda kuti hukama hupi pakati pe a ne b hunoita kuti chirevo ichocho chive 0.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s2.ok.c1: a ne b ndi nhamba dzakazara dzakanaka mukati mehuwandu.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s2.fail.c1: a ne b dzinofanira kuva nhamba dzakazara kubva pa 1 kusvika pa 20.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Kukosha kwe ∫₀ᵇ x(x−a)dx hakusi 0. Wedzera uye uverenge b³/3−ab²/2.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s2.explain: ∫₀ᵇ x(x−a)dx=b³/3−ab²/2=b²(2b−3a)/6, saka ndi 0 kana 2b=3a. Ipapo b=1.5a yakakura kupfuura a, saka chikamu [0,b] chine zvese chikamu chiri pasi pe x-axis (0<x<a) nechiri pamusoro payo (a<x<b). Saka kunyange definite integral iri 0, nzvimbo haisi 0.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s3.prompt: Sarudza rimwe remaviri awakangogadzira uye utsanangure kuti sei definite integral iri 0 asi nzvimbo isiri 0, uye maitiro ekuwana nzvimbo pachikamu icho.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s3.hint.0: Uchishandisa rimwe repairs yawakagadzira kare, verenga definite integrals dzechikamu chiri pazasi pe x-axis nechiri pamusoro pawo zvakasiyana uye utarise zviratidzo.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s3.hint.1: Girai kuti nzvimbo, seyekureba, haigoni kuva negative, uye funga kuti chikamu chiri pazasi chinofanira kubatwa sei.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s3.placeholder: semuenzaniso, Definite integral ... nokuti chikamu ..., uye nzvimbo ...
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakataura kuti chikamu chiri pazasi pe x-axis chinoverengwa sei mukati medefinite integral here?
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakataura kuti sezvo nzvimbo isingagone kuva negative, wakapatsanura interval apo chiratidzo chinochinja here?
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s3.model.0: Definite integral yechikamu chiri pazasi pe x-axis inegative uye yechiri pamusoro ipositive, saka kana dzakawedzerwa dzinodzimana uye dzinopa 0. Kune nzvimbo, chikamu chiri pazasi chinofanira kuverengwa sepositive futi, saka patsanura interval papoinzi apo girafu inosangana ne x-axis, wana kukosha kwega kwega, uye uwedzere absolute values dzadzo.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s3.model.1: Definite integral isigned area, saka kukosha kwepamusoro nekwepazasi (negative) kunowedzera kusvika ku0. Nzvimbo chaiyo inoverenga zvose seyepositive, saka dziwane zvakasiyana nekupatsanura kuita [0,a] ne [a,b], wobva wadzidzedzera.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s3.model.2: Kana ukapatsanura interval kuita zviviri papoinzi apo girafu inosangana ne x-axis, definite integral imwe ipositive uye imwe inegative. Kunyange kana huwandu hwadzo i0, nzvimbo i |chikamu chenegative|+|chikamu chepositive|, iri huru kupfuura 0.

n-m-h2-integ-04.prereq.2: Kuverenga ma definite integral emabasa epolynomial
n-m-h2-integ-04.title: Kutsvaga mamiriro eruzivo rweminimum yenzvimbo yefunction inotsanangurwa nedefinite integral
n-m-h2-integ-04.topic: Differentiation nemakoshero akanyanyisa efunctions anotsanangurwa nemadefinite integrals
n-m-h2-integ-04.goal: Shandisa chokwadi chekuti kukwira nekudzika nemakoshero akanyanyisa efunction F(x)=∫₀ˣ f(t)dt inotsanangurwa nedefinite integral zvinosarudzwa nechiratidzo che f(x), kuvaka mienzaniso apo local minimum value ipositive uye utsvage mamiriro.
n-m-h2-integ-04.material: f(t)=(t−a)(t−b) (a ne b dzi integers ne 0<a<b) uye F(x)=∫₀ˣ f(t)dt. (∫₀ˣ idefinite integral kubva ku0 kusvika ku x.)
n-m-h2-integ-04.thinking.0: Kuverenga kukwira nekudzika kubva ku F'(x)=f(x)
n-m-h2-integ-04.thinking.1: Kusiyanisa nzvimbo yekukosha kwakanyanyisa nehukuru hwako
n-m-h2-integ-04.prereq.1: Kukwira, kudzika, nemakoshero akanyanyisa ecubic functions
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s1.prompt: Kune x>0, F(x) inogona kuva nekukosha kwakanyanyisa pa x ipi?
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s1.hint.0: Girai kuti unowana function ipi kana ukadifferentiate function inotsanangurwa nedefinite integral.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s1.hint.1: Kana ukaongorora chiratidzo che F' pa range yega yega ye x, unogona kuziva kuti F inokwira kupi uye inodzika kupi.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s1.o.a: X apo f(x) ine kukosha kwakanyanyisa: F ine kukosha kwakanyanyisa panzvimbo imwe chete ne f
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s1.r.a: Kukwira nekudzika kwe F kunosarudzwa nechiratidzo che f, kwete nekukosha kwe f. Nzvimbo dzemakoshero akanyanyisa e f hadzina chekuita nemakoshero akanyanyisa e F.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s1.o.b: X apo f(x)=0 uye chiratidzo che f(x) chinochinja kumativi ose maviri
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s1.r.b: Wakashandisa chokwadi chekuti sezvo F'(x)=f(x), makoshero akanyanyisa anoitika apo chiratidzo che F' chinochinja.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s1.o.c: X apo F(x)=0: kukosha kwakanyanyisa kunoitika apo girafu inopfuura x-axis
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s1.r.c: Nzvimbo dzinoita F i0 nenzvimbo dzinoitika makoshero akanyanyisa zvinhu zvakasiyana.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s1.o.d: x=0: kukosha kwe F kunotanga kuchinja papoinzi apo kuintegrate kunotanga
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s1.r.d: F(0)=0 kukosha chete, uye x=0 haisi pane kukwira nekudzika kunochinja.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s1.explain: Sezvo F'(x)=f(x)=(x−a)(x−b), F inokwira kune x<a, inodzika kune a<x<b, uye inokwira kune x>b. Saka F ine local maximum pa x=a uye local minimum pa x=b.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s2.prompt: Pakati pemapairi eintegers (a, b) ane 0<a<b≤20, isa mapairi matatu akasiyana apo local minimum value ye F(x) ipositive.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wasarudza x apo F ine local minimum, wobva waratidza kukosha kwe F pa x iyoyo nenzira ye a ne b.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s2.hint.1: Tambanudza uye uverenge ∫₀ᵇ(t−a)(t−b)dt uye uwane mamiriro ekuti chiratidzo chive positive.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s2.ok.c1: a ne b dzi integers ne 0<a<b≤20.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s2.fail.c1: a ne b dzinofanira kuva integers ne 0<a<b≤20.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s2.fail.c2: Local minimum value haisi positive. Taura kukosha kwe F pa x apo local minimum inoitika nenzira ye a ne b.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s2.explain: Local minimum inoitika pa x=b, uye F(b)=∫₀ᵇ(t²−(a+b)t+ab)dt=b³/3−(a+b)b²/2+ab²=b²(3a−b)/6. Sezvo b²>0, local minimum value ipositive kana 3a−b>0, ndiko kuti, b<3a.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s3.prompt: Nyora kuti hukama hupi huripo pakati pe b ne a mumapairi awakawana, uye utsanangure kuti nei hukama uhwu hunodiwa nekuverenga local minimum value.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s3.hint.0: Tanga wasarudza kana local minimum iri pa a kana b, wobva watambanudza uye uverenge definite integral kusvika pa x iyoyo.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s3.hint.1: Mumutauro wawakaverenga, siyanisa zvinhu zvinogara zviri positive nezvinogona kuchinja chiratidzo.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s3.placeholder: semuenzaniso, b i ... kupfuura ... ye a. Local minimum value i ..., saka ...
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakatanga wasarudza x apo local minimum inoitika wobva waverenga kukosha kwayo here?
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakataura kuti chinhu chipi chinosarudza chiratidzo chelocal minimum value here?
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s3.model.0: b inofanira kuva pazasi penguva 3 ye a. Local minimum inoitika pa x=b, uye F(b)=b²(3a−b)/6, uye sezvo b² inogara iri positive, 3a−b inofanira kuva positive. Saka b<3a.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s3.model.1: Kana b<3a, local minimum value ipositive. Kuverenga F(b)=∫₀ᵇ(t−a)(t−b)dt kunopa b²(3a−b)/6, uye chiratidzo chayo chinosarudzwa ne 3a−b.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s3.model.2: Zvakakwana kuti 3a>b. Wana kukosha F(b)=b^2(3a-b)/6 pa x=b, apo local minimum inoitika, uye uwane mamiriro ekuti ive positive: 3a-b>0.

n-m-h2-integ-03.title: Kana yakadzoka pawakatangira, haina kufamba here?
n-m-h2-integ-03.topic: Velocity ne distance: shanduko yenzvimbo nedistance yakafambwa
n-m-h2-integ-03.goal: Nzwisisa, nekugadzirisa kutonga kwako nguva imwe neimwe kana ruzivo rwuchiratidzwa, kuti definite integral yevelocity ishanduko yenzvimbo uye yakasiyana nedistance yakafambwa, uye utsanangure kuti ungawana sei distance.
n-m-h2-integ-03.material: Ruzivo nezvepoinzi P inofamba panumber line runoratidzwa chidimbu nechidimbu. Shanduko yenzvimbo iintegral yevelocity, uye distance yakafambwa ihuwandu hwekureba kwose kwakafukidzwa chaizvo.
n-m-h2-integ-03.thinking.0: Kugadzirisa kutonga kwako nguva imwe neimwe kana ruzivo rutsva rwabuda
n-m-h2-integ-03.thinking.2: Kupatsanura interval apo chiratidzo chevelocity chinochinja
n-m-h2-integ-03.prereq.0: Hukama pakati pevelocity nenzvimbo (shanduko yenzvimbo = definite integral yevelocity)
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza kutonga uchishandisa ruzivo rwakaratidzwa chete.
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.hint.0: Nguva imwe neimwe kana ruzivo rutsva rwabuda, funga kana "shanduko yenzvimbo" ne "kureba kwakafukidzwa" zvichireva zvakafanana.
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.hint.1: Funga kuti kufamba kwepoinzi kunosiyana sei apo chiratidzo chevelocity chinochinja.
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.0.info: Takawana shanduko yenzvimbo yepoinzi P, yakatanga pa t=0, kusvika ku t=6, uye yaiva 0. Ndiko kuti, pa t=6, P iri panzvimbo yakatangira.
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.0.ask: Kubva paruzivo urwu oga, tinogona kutaura kuti distance yakafambwa neP i0 here?
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Shanduko yenzvimbo ikukosha kune nzira (ine chiratidzo), saka inogona kuva 0 kunyange kana poinzi ichibuda ichidzoka.
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Tinogona kutaura: nzvimbo yakafanana, saka distance yakafambwa i0 futi
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Wakatora shanduko yenzvimbo nedistance yakafambwa sechinhu chimwe chete. Kunyange ichienda ichidzoka, shanduko i0.
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Hatigoni kutaura: kana yakaenda ichidzoka, distance haisi 0 kunyange shanduko i0
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Wakafunga kuti shanduko ye0 haingoreve "haina kufamba".
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Tinogona kutaura: kana definite integral i0, velocity inofanira kugara i0
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Kunyange definite integral i0, pangava nema interval apo velocity ipositive akasanganiswa nema interval apo inegative.
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.1.ask: P inochinja nzira yekufamba panguva ipi?
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.1.after: Kana velocity inegative inofamba nenzira imwe, uye kana ipositive inofamba nenzira yakapesana. Nzira inochinja pa t=4, apo chiratidzo chinochinja.
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.1.o.a: t=2: girafu ye v(t) yakaderera zvikuru ipapo, saka nzira inochinja
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Nzvimbo apo v(t) ine minimum ndipo apo kumhanya kuri kukuru, kwete apo nzira inochinja.

n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza kutonga uchishandisa ruzivo rwakaratidzwa chete.
n-m-h2-seq-02.title: Kana induction step yakarurama, chirevo chakarurama zvakare here?
n-m-h2-seq-02.topic: Logic ye mathematical induction: induction step ne base step
n-m-h2-seq-02.goal: Nzwisisa, uchigadzirisa kutonga kwako sezvo ruzivo rwuchiratidzwa chidimbu chimwe panguva imwe, kuti mu mathematical induction "induction step" i chirevo chine mamiriro chete uye kuti mhedziso inomira chete kana mamiriro ekutanga atariswa.
n-m-h2-seq-02.material: Jia anoda kuratidza nekuita induction kuti "P(n): 2+4+6+⋯+2n = n²+n+3" inoshanda kune natural number n yega yega. Zvaakatarisa zvinoratidzwa chidimbu chimwe panguva imwe.
n-m-h2-seq-02.thinking.0: Kugadzirisa kutonga nguva imwe neimwe ruzivo rutsva rwunooneka
n-m-h2-seq-02.thinking.1: Kunzwisisa zvinoreva conditional "kana ..., ipapo inotevera ... zvakare"
n-m-h2-seq-02.thinking.2: Kusiyanisa zvinoitwa nekutarisa kumwe nekumwe kuviri mu induction
n-m-h2-seq-02.prereq.0: Huwandu hwe arithmetic sequence nechiratidzo Σ
n-m-h2-seq-02.prereq.1: Chimiro che mathematical induction (kutarisa mamiriro ekutanga nedanho kubva ku k kuenda ku k+1)
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s1.hint.0: Nguva imwe neimwe ruzivo rutsva rwunooneka, funga kana kutonga kwako kunofanira kuchinja.
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s1.hint.1: Funga kana "kana P(k), ipapo P(k+1)" ichigona kuva yechokwadi kunyange P(k) i yenhema.
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s1.st.0.info: Induction step yatarisiwa. Fungidzira P(k) inoshanda uye wedzera 2(k+1) kumativi ose maviri; divi rerudyi rinova k²+k+3+2(k+1) = (k+1)²+(k+1)+3, saka kune natural number k yega yega, "kana P(k) ichishanda, ipapo P(k+1) inoshanda" yakarurama.
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s1.st.0.ask: Kubva paruzivo urwu oga, tingataura here kuti "P(n) inoshanda kune natural number n yega yega"?
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s1.st.0.after: Induction step i chirevo chine mamiriro "kana P(k), ipapo P(k+1)." P inofanira kushanda chaizvo kwakati kuti ienderere kubva ipapo.
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Tinogona kutaura kudaro: nekuti danho kubva ku k kuenda kune inotevera ratarisiwa kune k yega yega
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Induction step yakanyorwa pagwaro rekuti "kana ichishanda," saka unoda mamiriro apo inoshanda chaizvo kwakati.
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Hatigone kusarudza zvino: nekuti mamiriro ekutanga apo inoshanda haasati atariswa
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Wakafunga nezve chokwadi chekuti kutarisa kwakaparadzana kwemamiriro ekutanga kunodiwa.
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Hatigone kutaura kudaro, uye chirevo i chenhema: nekuti kuva ne induction step chete kunoita kuti i yenhema
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Danho rakarurama uye chirevo chenhema zvinhu zvakasiyana. Hapana humbowo hwekuti i yenhema zvino.
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s1.st.1.info: Zvino mamiriro ekutanga atarisiwa. Kune n=1, divi rekuruboshwe i 2 uye divi rerudyi i 1+1+3 = 5.
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s1.st.1.ask: Nekuwedzerwa kweruzivo urwu, kutonga kwako i kupi?
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s1.st.1.after: Kana P(1) i yenhema, nzira kubva ku 1 kuenda ku 2, 3, … yakavharwa kubva pakutanga. Kunyange induction step yakarurama, hazvitevedzi kuti P(2) i yechokwadi.
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s1.st.1.o.a: P(1) chete i yenhema: kubva ku n=2, induction step inoramba ichiienderera, saka inoshanda
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Kana P(1) i yenhema, induction step haipe hwaro hwekuti P(2) i yechokwadi.
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Induction step yakanganisa, saka inofanira kutariswa zvakare
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Kuverenga mu induction step kwakarurama. Chinonyepa i P(1).
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Nzira inotanga kubva ku P(1) ichienderera yakavharwa: induction step oga haigone kuratidza chirevo ichi
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Wakafunga nezve chokwadi chekuti, nekuti P(1) i yenhema, "kana P(1) ipapo P(2)" haina chekuenderera kubva pachiri.
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s1.st.2.info: Ndakaverenga n=2, 3, 4 zvakananga. Mativi ekuruboshwe i 6, 12, 20 uye mativi ekurudyi i 9, 15, 23. Chaizvo 2+4+⋯+2n = n²+n, saka divi rerudyi rinogara rakakura ne 3.
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s1.st.2.ask: Mhedzisiro iyi inotiudza chii nezve induction step?
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s1.st.2.after: "Kana P(k), ipapo P(k+1)" i yechokwadi kune k yega yega, asi P(n) i yenhema kune n yega yega. Kunyange chirevo chine mamiriro chiri chechokwadi, kana hypothesis inogara i yenhema, mhedziso haitevedzi.
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Kunyange induction step yakarurama, chirevo chinogona kuva chenhema kune n yega yega kana kutanga i kwenhema
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Wakasiyanisa "kana P(k), ipapo P(k+1)" kuva yakarurama ne P ichishanda chaizvo.
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Induction step yakarurama, saka chirevo chinoshanda kune n dzimwe zvishoma
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Danho kuva rakarurama hakuvimbise kuti kunyange n imwe chete inogutsa chirevo.
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Chirevo chakava chenhema nekuti kuverenga mu induction step kwakanganisa
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Kuverenga mu induction step kwakarurama. Danho rakarurama nechirevo chenhema zvinogona kuvapo pamwe chete.
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s1.reflect: Pakutanga zvairatidzika sekunge kutarisa induction step oga kwakakwana, asi kana mamiriro ekutanga akatariswa, nzira yakavharwa. Mu induction, unoda zvose "kutanga i kwechokwadi" ne "kana kuri kwechokwadi, inotevera i yechokwadizve."
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s2.prompt: Nyora zvinhu zviviri zvaunofanira kutarisa kuratidza "inoshanda kune natural number n yega yega" nekuita induction, uye utsanangure mumitsara mumwe kana miviri kuti ndechipi chakawira mumamiriro aJia.
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s2.hint.0: Kufunga induction sechikwata che dominoes, nyora zvakaparadzana kuti kuwisa domino rekutanga nekuenderera kunoenderana nei.
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s2.hint.1: Tarisazve mhedzisiro yechaakatarisa Jia chinoenderana nedomino rekutanga.
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakataura kuti kutarisa kumwe nekumwe kuviri kunovimbisa chii here?
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakataura kuti ndechipi chashaikwa kana chisina kururama mugadziriso yaJia here?
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s2.model.0: Pakutanga, unofanira kutarisa kana chirevo chinoshanda kana n=1. Chechipiri, unofanira kuratidza kuti kana P(k) inoshanda, ipapo P(k+1) inoshanda. Jia akaita chechipiri zvakarurama, asi pa n=1 tine 2≠5, saka chekutanga chine nhema.
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s2.model.1: Unofanira kutarisa zvinhu zviviri: kana mamiriro ekutanga (P(1)) i echokwadi, uye kana danho kubva ku k kuenda ku k+1 rinoshanda. Kuna Jia, P(1) haishande, saka kutanga kunowira.

n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsetse wekutanga usina kururama mugadziriso yaHaeun.
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s1.hint.0: Tarisa kana mutsetse mumwe nemumwe unotevera chaizvo kubva pamutsetse wakamberi, uye kana mutsetse mumwe nemumwe uine chikonzero chakakwana.
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s1.hint.1: Dzokera uone kuti k yakatsanangurwa sei, uye funga zvinoitika kana ukaisa f(x) yawakawana pakupedzisira mu tsanangudzo iyoyo.
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s1.line.0: ∫₀¹ f(t)dt i mutengo usina x, saka kuuita k, f(x)=x²+2k.
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s1.line.1: Kusiyanisa mativi ose maviri ne x kunopa f'(x)=2x, saka k inonyangarika kana yasiyaniswa.
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s1.line.2: k i constant uye derivative ye constant i 0, saka k=0.
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s1.explain: Mutsetse 3 ndiwo wekutanga usina kururama. Zvechokwadi kuti derivative ye constant i 0, asi izvozvo hazvireve kuti mutengo we constant i 0. Mutengo we k unofanira kusarudzwa kubva pa tsanangudzo k=∫₀¹ f(t)dt. Kuisa f(t)=t²+2k kunopa k=∫₀¹(t²+2k)dt=1/3+2k, saka k=−1/3 uye f(x)=x²−2/3.
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s2.prompt: Nzira yakananga zvikuru yekusimbisa kuti mhinduro yaHaeun f(x)=x² haina kururama i ipi?
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s2.hint.0: Isa f(x)=x² mumativi ose maviri e equation yekutanga f(x)=x²+2∫₀¹ f(t)dt.
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s2.hint.1: Tarisa kana kutarisa kwega kwega "kunogara kuchibuda kwakarurama kunyange kune mhinduro isina kururama."
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s2.o.a: Siyanisa f(x)=x² ne x uye utarise kuti f'(x)=2x
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s2.r.a: Gadziriso yaHaeun yatogutsa mamiriro aya. Kutarisa uku hakuburitsi kukanganisa.
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s2.o.b: Tarisa chete kuti f(0)=0, uye uone kana inoenderana ne k=0 kubva pa f(0)=0+2k mu equation yekutanga
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s2.r.b: Kana f(0)=0, inoratidzika kuenderana ne k=0, saka hapana kupokana kunooneka. Kana usingaongorore k nemutengo we definite integral, haugone kubata kukanganisa.
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s2.o.c: Isa f(x)=x² mu ∫₀¹ f(t)dt, verenga mutengo, uye uuenzanise ne k=0
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s2.r.c: Kutarisa uku kunoverenga mutengo we definite integral zvakananga uye kunotarisa kana unoenderana netsanangudzo ye k.
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s2.o.d: Tarisa kana kushandisa tsamba yakasiyana panzvimbo ye k kunopa gadziriso imwechete
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s2.r.d: Kuchinja zita retsamba hakuchinji logic yegadziriso.
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s2.explain: Kana f(x)=x², ipapo ∫₀¹ t²dt=1/3, saka k inofanira kuva 1/3, asi Haeun akati k=0. Zvose zviri zviviri hazvienderani, saka f(x)=x² haigutsi mamiriro ekutanga.
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s3.prompt: Nyora note pfupi kuna Haeun. Sanganisira chinhu chimwe chaakaita zvakanaka, nei mutsetse usina kururama usina kururama, uye kiyi yegadziriso yakarurama nemhedzisiro yayo.
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s3.hint.0: Wana chinhu chimwe chakarurama mugadziriso yaHaeun, uye ufungidzire kuti kufunga kwakaita sei kwakaita kuti mutsetse usina kururama ubude.
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s3.hint.1: Nyora expression inodiwa kugadzirisa mutsetse usina kururama (expression inonyora k se definite integral).
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakatanga wataura zvakananga zvakaitwa zvakanaka here?
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakatsanangura kuti "derivative ye constant i 0" ne "mutengo we constant i 0" zvakasiyana here?
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s3.model.0: Haeun, kuita definite integral k yaiva pfungwa yakanaka! Asi "derivative ye constant i 0" zvinoreva kuti mhedzisiro yekusiyanisa i 0, kwete kuti mutengo we k i 0. Unofanira kuwana k kubva patsanangudzo yayo, k=∫₀¹(t²+2k)dt=1/3+2k, saka k=−1/3, uye f(x)=x²−2/3.
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s3.model.1: Zvakanaka zvikuru kuti wakatanga nekuita mutengo usina hukama ne x k. Asi k kuva constant, saka derivative yayo i 0, zvakasiyana nekuti k ine mutengo 0. Kana ukaverenga definite integral zvakananga, kugadzirisa k=1/3+2k kunopa k=-1/3, saka f(x)=x²-2/3.
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s3.model.2: Haeun, basa rakanaka. Kana ukaisa f(x)=x² yawakawana pakupedzisira mu ∫₀¹ f(t)dt, unowana 1/3, izvo zvisingaenderane ne k=0. Unofanira kuverenga mutengo we definite integral kusarudza k, uye ipapo k=−1/3 uye f(x)=x²−2/3.

n-m-h2-integ-08.title: Kana tikacheka pakati pe interval, area inogovaniswawo kuita hafu here?
n-m-h2-integ-08.topic: Kugovanisa area kuita hafu nema definite integrals
n-m-h2-integ-08.goal: Tarisa uye utsanangure, nekuverenga definite integral nemuenzaniso wawakagadzira iwe pachako, kuti kucheka pakati pe interval hakugovanisi area kuita hafu, uye kuti nzvimbo yekucheka inofambiswa kuenda kudivi apo function i hombe.
n-m-h2-integ-08.material: Kune chimiro chakapoteredzwa nemutsetse y=2x, x-axis, nemitsetse miviri x=1 ne x=7. Sua akati, "Kana ukadhonza mutsetse wakamira pa x=4, pakati pe interval 1≤x≤7, area inogovaniswa kuita hafu," uye Dohyeon akati, "Ngatitarisei ne definite integral."
n-m-h2-integ-08.thinking.1: Kuwana mutemo wakafanana kubva pamienzaniso yakati wandei
n-m-h2-integ-08.thinking.2: Kubatanidza chimiro che graph nekugoverwa kwe area
n-m-h2-integ-08.prereq.1: Kuwana mitengo inogutsa equation mukati me integers
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s1.prompt: Mutsetse wakamira x=4 unogovanisa sei area yechimiro?
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s1.hint.0: Enzanisa hurefu hwechikamu chekuruboshwe nechekurudyi chechimiro nekutora x=4 semutsetse wekugovanisa.
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s1.hint.1: Verenga uye uenzanise ma definite integrals ezvikamu zviviri, ∫₁⁴ 2x dx ne ∫₄⁷ 2x dx.
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s1.o.a: Inogovaniswa kuita hafu: nekuti ma interval ekuruboshwe nekurudyi ane upamhi hwakafanana
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s1.r.a: Kunyange nehupamhi hwakafanana, kana hurefu hwakasiyana, ma areas anosiyana. Pa interval yekurudyi mutsetse uri wakakwirira.
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s1.o.b: Inogovaniswa kuita hafu: nekuti i mutsetse, saka hurefu hwakagara pa interval ipi neipi
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s1.r.b: Hurefu hwe y=2x hunochinja ne x. Hurefu hwakagara chete kune y=constant.
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s1.o.c: Haigovaniswi kuita hafu: nekuti chikamu chekurudyi chiri pasi, saka chekuruboshwe chine area hombe
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s1.r.c: Mutsetse unokwira kurudyi, saka divi rekurudyi rine area hombe.
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s1.o.d: Haigovaniswi kuita hafu: nekuti hurefu hunowedzera kurudyi, saka chikamu chekurudyi chikuru
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s1.r.d: Wakashandisa chokwadi chekuti area yakawanda inounganidzwa padivi apo hurefu hwakakura.
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s1.explain: ∫₁⁴ 2x dx=16−1=15 ne ∫₄⁷ 2x dx=49−16=33. Kuruboshwe i 15 uye kurudyi i 33, saka haigovaniswi kuita hafu, uye kurudyi i hombe.
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s2.prompt: Isa mapeya matatu e integers akasiyana (a, b, k) kuti mutsetse wakamira x=k ugovanise zvakaenzana area pakati pe y=2x, x-axis, nemitsetse miviri yakamira x=a ne x=b. (1≤a<k<b≤50)
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora ma definite integrals echikamu chekuruboshwe nechekurudyi che x=k maererano ne a, b, k.
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s2.hint.1: Ita equation inoti mitengo miviri yakaenzana nyore uye uedze mabatanidzwa e integers.
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s2.ok.c2: Ma areas ekuruboshwe nekurudyi kwe x=k akaenzana.
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s2.fail.c2: Area yekuruboshwe neyekurudyi hazvienzani. Taura ∫ₐᵏ 2x dx ne ∫ₖᵇ 2x dx maererano ne a, b, k.
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s2.explain: ∫ₐᵏ 2x dx=k²−a² ne ∫ₖᵇ 2x dx=b²−k², saka k²−a²=b²−k², ndiko kuti, 2k²=a²+b². Semuenzaniso, (1, 7, 5) inopa 25−1=24=49−25.
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s3.prompt: Mumapeya matatu awakawana, k i yakakura kana diki kupfuura pakati (avhareji) ye a ne b? Tsanangura nei, uchibatanidza ne chimiro che y=2x.
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s3.hint.0: Kune peya rega rega rawakawana, wana avhareji (a+b)/2 uye uienzanise ne k.
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s3.hint.1: Rangarira kuti divi ripi rine nzvimbo huru kana ukacheka pakati.
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s3.placeholder: semuenzaniso, k ... kupfuura pakati. Izvi ndezvekuti ...
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakaenzanisa nzvimbo dzechikamu chekuruboshwe nechekurudyi pakati here?
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakataura, nechikonzero, kuti nzvimbo yekupatsanura hafu yakatsvedza kunzira ipi here?
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s3.model.0: k yakakura kupfuura average. Mutsetse unokwira kurudyi, saka kana ukacheka pakati, nzvimbo yekurudyi yakakura. Saka kupatsanura nzvimbo kuita hafu, unofanira kufambisa mutsetse wekucheka kurudyi rwepakati.
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s3.model.1: Mu (1,7,5), average ndi4 asi k=5, saka k yakakura. Nzvimbo yakawanda inounganidzwa padivi apo kukwira kuri kukuru, saka mutsetse wekupatsanura hafu unotsvedzera kurudyi.
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s3.model.2: k inopatsanura hafu iri kurudyi rwepoinzi yepakati ya a ne b. Izvi ndezvekuti y=2x iri pamusoro kurudyi, saka kana ukacheka pakati, chikamu chekurudyi chakakura.

n-m-h2-integ-09.title: Tinogona kutsvaga nzvimbo nyore kunyangwe chimiro chakaomarara here?
n-m-h2-integ-09.topic: Nzvimbo iri pakati pema curve maviri: musiyano wekukwira
n-m-h2-integ-09.goal: Nzwisisa kuti nzvimbo iri pakati pema curve maviri, imwe iri imwe yakakwidzwa, inotarwa chete nemusiyano wekukwira nehupamhi hwe interval, uye nenzira imwechete gadzira mienzaniso inosangana nemamiriro nedambudziko idzva.
n-m-h2-integ-09.material: Pane curve y=x³−3x ne curve y=x³−3x+4, iyo ndiyo curve iyoyo yakakwidzwa ne4. Tinoda kutsvaga nzvimbo iri pakati pema curve maviri pa interval 0≤x≤3. (Pa interval iyi, curve yekutanga ine chikamu chinodzika pasi pe x-axis.)
n-m-h2-integ-09.thinking.0: Kuderedza kuverenga nekutarisa chimiro (musiyano) we ma expression
n-m-h2-integ-09.thinking.2: Kugadzira dambudziko rinosangana nemamiriro iwe pachako
n-m-h2-integ-09.prereq.0: Nzvimbo iri pakati pema curve maviri = ∫(expression yepamusoro − expression yepasi)
n-m-h2-integ-09.prereq.1: Ma definite integral e polynomial function
n-m-h2-integ-09.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza kutonga kwakarurama nezvenzvimbo iri pakati pema curve maviri.
n-m-h2-integ-09.s.s1.hint.0: Sarudza kuti curve ipi iri pamusoro, uye ubvise expression yepasi kubva pa expression yepamusoro.
n-m-h2-integ-09.s.s1.hint.1: Pfupisa expression mushure mekubvisa uye utarise kuti unowana expression ipi.
n-m-h2-integ-09.s.s1.o.a: 12: musiyano wekukwira unogara uri 4 kwose kwose, saka wedzera ne upamhi 3
n-m-h2-integ-09.s.s1.r.a: Wakashandisa chimiro chekuti expression yepamusoro kubvisa expression yepasi inogara iri 4.
n-m-h2-integ-09.s.s1.o.b: 4: ma curve maviri ari 4 kure, saka kukosha uko ndiko nzvimbo
n-m-h2-integ-09.s.s1.r.b: Musiyano wekukwira ndi4, asi kune nzvimbo unofanira kuwedzerawo ne upamhi we interval.
n-m-h2-integ-09.s.s1.o.c: 0: curve yekutanga inodzika pasi pe x-axis, inova negative, uye inobvisana
n-m-h2-integ-09.s.s1.r.c: Nzvimbo iri pakati pema curve maviri inotarwa ne expression yepamusoro − expression yepasi, kwete nehukama ne x-axis. Musiyano uyu unogara uri positive.
n-m-h2-integ-09.s.s1.o.d: Hazvigoni kuzivikanwa: tinofanira kuverenga definite integral ye x³−3x kutanga
n-m-h2-integ-09.s.s1.r.d: Mu expression yepamusoro − expression yepasi, x³−3x inobvisana, saka hapana kuverenga kunodiwa.
n-m-h2-integ-09.s.s1.explain: Kubvisa curve yepasi kubva pa curve yepamusoro kunopa (x³−3x+4)−(x³−3x)=4. Saka nzvimbo ndi∫₀³ 4 dx=12. Nzvimbo yema curve zvichienzaniswa ne x-axis haina basa.
n-m-h2-integ-09.s.s2.prompt: Isa mapeya matatu akasiyana e natural number (k, w) akadai kuti nzvimbo iri pakati pe curve y=x² ne curve y=x²+k, iyo ndiyo yakakwidzwa ne k, ndi24 chaizvo pa interval 0≤x≤w. (1≤k≤24, 1≤w≤24)
n-m-h2-integ-09.s.s2.hint.0: Kutanga nyora musiyano wekukwira pakati pema curve maviri se expression.
n-m-h2-integ-09.s.s2.hint.1: Integrate musiyano uyu kubva ku0 kusvika ku w, unyore nenzira ye k ne w, uye uuenzanise ne24.
n-m-h2-integ-09.s.s2.ok.c1: Ndedze natural number ari mukati merenji.
n-m-h2-integ-09.s.s2.fail.c1: k ne w zvinofanira kuva ma natural number kubva ku1 kusvika ku24.
n-m-h2-integ-09.s.s2.ok.c2: Nzvimbo iri pakati pema curve maviri ndi24.
n-m-h2-integ-09.s.s2.fail.c2: Nzvimbo haisi 24. Kutanga pfupisa (expression yepamusoro − expression yepasi).
n-m-h2-integ-09.s.s2.explain: Sezvo (x²+k)−x²=k, nzvimbo ndi∫₀ʷ k dx=kw. Mapeya e natural number ane kw=24 ndi(1,24), (2,12), (3,8), (4,6), (6,4), (8,3), (12,2), (24,1). Chimiro che curve x² hachikanganisi mhinduro.
n-m-h2-integ-09.s.s3.prompt: Panguva ino, sarudza curve y=g(x) iwe pachako. Nyora, mumutsara mumwe, dambudziko rine nzvimbo iri pakati pema curve maviri ndi18, uye utsanangure kuti nei dambudziko iroro rinogona kugadziriswa pasina kutsvaga definite integral ye g(x).
n-m-h2-integ-09.s.s3.hint.0: Zviri nyore kugadzira dambudziko kana wakatanga wasarudza nhamba mbiri dzine product (musiyano wekukwira nguva upamhi we interval) ndi18, wobva wasarudza curve.
n-m-h2-integ-09.s.s3.hint.1: Bvisa ma expression ema curve maviri uye utarise kuti chii chinoitika ku g(x).
n-m-h2-integ-09.s.s3.placeholder: semuenzaniso, Dambudziko: ... Mhinduro: musiyano wekukwira ndi... uye upamhi ndi..., saka ...
n-m-h2-integ-09.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Dambudziko rako rine ma curve ose maviri ne interval here?
n-m-h2-integ-09.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakataura here kuti kana ukabvisa ma expression maviri, g(x) inonyangarika?
n-m-h2-integ-09.s.s3.model.0: Dambudziko: Tsvaga nzvimbo iri pakati pema curve y=x³−x ne y=x³−x+3 pa 0≤x≤6. Musiyano wekukwira pakati pema curve maviri unogara uri 3 kwose kwose uye upamhi we interval ndi6, saka nzvimbo ndi3×6=18, uye hapana chikonzero chekuintegrate x³−x.
n-m-h2-integ-09.s.s3.model.1: Dambudziko: Nzvimbo yakakomberedzwa ne y=2x² ne y=2x²+2 pa 1≤x≤10 ndeyei? Kubvisa expression yepasi kubva yepamusoro kunosiya 2 chete, saka musiyano wekukwira unogara uri 2. Kuwedzera ne upamhi 9 kunopa 18, saka hauna kudikanwa kuintegrate g(x).
n-m-h2-integ-09.s.s3.model.2: Kana ukasarudza g(x)=x³−5x ugogadzira dambudziko rinobvunza nzvimbo iri pakati payo ne curve yakakwidzwa ne1 pa 0≤x≤18, musiyano wekukwira ndi1 nguva dzose uye upamhi ndi18, saka nzvimbo ndi18. Izvi ndezvekuti g inonyangarika kana ukabvisa.

n-m-h2-seq-01.title: Kutarisa gadziriso yaHayoon ye common ratio
n-m-h2-seq-01.topic: Huwandu hwe geometric sequence nekuwana common ratio
n-m-h2-seq-01.goal: Mugadziriso inoshandisa fomula ye geometric sum, tsvaga kutonga kunorasa mhinduro, wobva wagadzirisa nekunyora sequence chaiyo ine mutengo wakarasirwa uye kutarisa mamiriro.
n-m-h2-seq-01.material: Iyi i gadziriso yaHayoon yekuwana common ratio ye geometric sequence {aₙ} ine term yekutanga 2 uye huwandu hwayo kubva pa term yekutanga kusvika yechitatu i 6. (aₙ i "a sub n," r i common ratio, uye S₃ i huwandu hwema terms 3 ekutanga.)
n-m-h2-seq-01.thinking.0: Kutarisa kuti mutsetse mumwe nemumwe wakanyorwa pagwaro rei
n-m-h2-seq-01.thinking.1: Kutarisa nekuisa mutengo wakarasirwa zvakananga mumamiriro
n-m-h2-seq-01.thinking.2: Kupatsanura kuita mamiriro usati washandisa fomula
n-m-h2-seq-01.prereq.0: General term ye geometric sequence nefomula yehuwandu hwema terms n ekutanga
n-m-h2-seq-01.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsetse mumwe mugadziriso yaHayoon une kutonga kusina kururama. (Kana mitsetse inopfuura mumwe isina kururama, kusarudza chero ipi pazvo zvakanaka.)
n-m-h2-seq-01.s.s1.hint.0: Pamutsetse mumwe nemumwe, tarisa kana expression inogona kushandiswa kune r yega yega kana inova isina zvainoreva kune dzimwe r.
n-m-h2-seq-01.s.s1.hint.1: Kune mutengo wega wega we r unooneka mugadziriso, nyora sequence ine common ratio iyoyo uye utarise kana huwandu hwema terms 3 ekutanga i 6.
n-m-h2-seq-01.s.s1.line.0: Ngatitii common ratio i r. Nefomula ye geometric sum, S₃ = 2(r³−1)/(r−1) = 6.
n-m-h2-seq-01.s.s1.line.1: Sezvo (r³−1)/(r−1) = r²+r+1, tinowana r²+r+1 = 3, ndiko kuti, r²+r−2 = 0.
n-m-h2-seq-01.s.s1.line.3: Asi kana r = 1, denominator r−1 i 0 uye expression haishande, saka tinorasa r = 1. Saka common ratio i −2 chete.
n-m-h2-seq-01.s.s1.explain: Kana common ratio i 1, fomula yehuwandu a(rⁿ−1)/(r−1) haigone kushandiswa. Mutsetse wekutanga wakashandisa fomula pasina kubata mamiriro iwayo zvakaparadzana, uye mutsetse wekupedzisira wakarasa r=1 nechikonzero che "haigone kuiswa mufomula." Asi kana r=1, sequence i 2, 2, 2, … uye huwandu hwema terms 3 ekutanga i 6, saka inogutsa mamiriro. Saka common ratio i −2 kana 1.
n-m-h2-seq-01.s.s2.prompt: Ratidza nei kurasa r=1 kusina kururama nekunyora sequence ye r=1, uye unyore ma common ratios ose akarurama.
n-m-h2-seq-01.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora ma terms matatu ekutanga e sequence ine common ratio i mutengo we r wakarasirwa.
n-m-h2-seq-01.s.s2.hint.1: Wedzera ma terms matatu aya uye uaenzanise nehuwandu mumamiriro, wobva wafunga kuti mamiriro api aifanira kutariswa zvakaparadzana usati washandisa fomula.
n-m-h2-seq-01.s.s2.placeholder: Muenzaniso: kana common ratio i 1, sequence i ..., saka ...
n-m-h2-seq-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakanyora sequence ye common ratio 1 here?

Muenzaniso wese mu renji iyi imultiple ye integer ye (−2, 1, 4) kana kurongeka kwayo kwakapesana. Nemhedzisiro yehanho yekutanga, yekuti nhamba nhatu dzakasiyana hadzigoni kuita arithmetic sequence ne geometric sequence nenzira imwe chete, middle term ye geometric sequence yakachinjanisirwa kurongeka iri x kana z.

Harin: aₙ = 2 + Σ(k=1 kusvika n−1)(3k−1) = (3n²−5n+6)/2
Doyun: aₙ = 2 + Σ(k=1 kusvika n)(3k−1) = (3n²+n+4)/2
